## List all activity logs

<a id="opIdfindAllActivityLogs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/activity_logs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /activity_logs`

This endpoint retrieves all existing activity logs that represent actions performed on application resources.

<h3 id="list-all-activity-logs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|from_date|query|string(date)|false|Filter activity logs logged at or after this date. A date or a full ISO 8601 datetime is accepted.|
|to_date|query|string(date)|false|Filter activity logs logged at or before this date. A date or a full ISO 8601 datetime is accepted.|
|activity_types[]|query|[string]|false|Filter results by activity types.|
|activity_sources[]|query|[string]|false|Filter results by activity sources.|
|user_emails[]|query|[string]|false|Filter results by the email of the user who performed the activity.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|Unique identifier assigned to the customer in your application.|
|external_subscription_id|query|string|false|External subscription ID|
|resource_ids[]|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Filter results by the unique identifiers of the resources the actions were applied to.|
|resource_types[]|query|[string]|false|Filter results by resource types.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|activity_sources[]|api|
|activity_sources[]|front|
|activity_sources[]|system|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "activity_logs": [
    {
      "activity_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
      "user_email": "dinesh@piedpiper.example",
      "activity_type": "billable_metric.created",
      "activity_source": "api",
      "activity_object": {
        "lago_id": "dad68bc7-c01a-4ad8-a87b-13e78693a5bc",
        "plan_id": "b9155544-e261-4e92-b54e-f65d7609294c"
      },
      "activity_object_changes": {
        "plan_id": "[null,\"b9155544-e261-4e92-b54e-f65d7609294c\"]"
      },
      "external_customer_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
      "external_subscription_id": "external_id",
      "resource_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
      "resource_type": "BillableMetric",
      "logged_at": "2025-03-31T12:31:44Z",
      "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "current_page": 2,
    "next_page": 3,
    "prev_page": 1,
    "total_pages": 4,
    "total_count": 70
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "Forbidden",
  "code": "feature_unavailable"
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|List of activity logs|[ActivityLogsPaginated](#schemaactivitylogspaginated)|

## Retrieve an activity log

<a id="opIdfindActivityLog"></a>

> Code samples

```bash

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
```

`GET /activity_logs/{activity_id}`

## List gross revenue

<a id="opIdfindAllGrossRevenues"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/analytics/gross_revenue \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /analytics/gross_revenue`

Gross revenue is the monthly sum of the totals of `finalized` invoices and of the amounts of the fees paid in advance that are not attached to an invoice. Invoice totals include taxes, are net of coupons, and are reduced by the amounts refunded through credit notes. Self-billed invoices and invoices with a lost payment dispute are excluded.

<h3 id="list-gross-revenue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|currency|query|object|false|Currency of revenue analytics. Format must be ISO 4217.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application). Use it to filter revenue analytics at the customer level.|
|billing_entity_code|query|string|false|Restrict the analytics to a single billing entity, identified by its code. An unknown code is ignored and the analytics cover the whole organization.|
|months|query|integer|false|Show data only for given number of months.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "gross_revenues": [
    {
      "month": "2023-11-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "amount_cents": 50000,
      "currency": "USD",
      "invoices_count": 10,
      "billing_entity_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "Forbidden",
  "code": "feature_unavailable"
}
```

<h3 id="list-gross-revenue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Gross revenue|[GrossRevenues](#schemagrossrevenues)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[ApiErrorForbidden](#schemaapierrorforbidden)|

## List of finalized invoices

<a id="opIdfindAllInvoiceCollections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/analytics/invoice_collection \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /analytics/invoice_collection`

Represents a monthly aggregation, detailing both the total count and the cumulative amount of invoices that have been marked as `finalized`. This report sorts invoices categorically based on their `payment_status`. Self-billed invoices and invoices with a lost payment dispute are excluded.
This is a premium feature.

<h3 id="list-of-finalized-invoices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|currency|query|object|false|The currency of revenue analytics. Format must be ISO 4217.|
|billing_entity_code|query|string|false|Restrict the analytics to a single billing entity, identified by its code. An unknown code is ignored and the analytics cover the whole organization.|
|months|query|integer|false|Show data only for given number of months.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "invoice_collections": [
    {
      "month": "2023-11-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "payment_status": "succeeded",
      "invoices_count": 10,
      "amount_cents": 50000,
      "currency": "USD"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,

}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "status": 403,

```

## List usage revenue

<a id="opIdfindAllInvoicedUsages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/analytics/invoiced_usage \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /analytics/invoiced_usage`

Reports the monthly revenue generated by usage-based fees, broken down by billable metric. It only counts usage that has already been invoiced, so the usage of the current billing period is not included. Amounts exclude taxes and are net of coupons. Fees on self-billed invoices and on invoices with a lost payment dispute are left out.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|currency|query|object|false|The currency of invoiced usage analytics. Format must be ISO 4217.|
|billing_entity_code|query|string|false|Restrict the analytics to a single billing entity, identified by its code. An unknown code is ignored and the analytics cover the whole organization.|
|months|query|integer|false|Show data only for given number of months.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{

}
```

## List MRR

<a id="opIdfindAllMrrs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/analytics/mrr \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /analytics/mrr`

Quantifies the revenue generated from `subscription` fees on a monthly basis. This figure is calculated post-application of applicable taxes and deduction of any applicable discounts. The method of calculation varies based on the subscription billing cycle:

- Revenue from `monthly` subscription invoices is included in the MRR for the month in which the invoice is issued.
- Revenue from `quarterly` subscription invoices is distributed evenly over three months. This distribution applies to fees paid in advance (allocated to the next remaining months depending on calendar or anniversary billing) as well as to fees paid in arrears (allocated to the preceding months depending on calendar or anniversary billing).
- Revenue from `yearly` subscription invoices is distributed evenly over twelve months. This allocation is applicable for fees paid in advance (spread over the next remaining months depending on calendar or anniversary billing) and for fees paid in arrears (spread over the previous months depending on calendar or anniversary billing).
- Revenue from `semiannual` subscription invoices is distributed evenly over six months. This allocation is applicable for fees paid in advance (spread over the next remaining months depending on calendar or anniversary billing) and for fees paid in arrears (spread over the previous months depending on calendar or anniversary billing).
- Revenue from `weekly` subscription invoices, the total revenue from all invoices issued within a month is summed up. This total is then divided by the number of invoices issued during that month, and the result is multiplied by 4.33, representing the average number of weeks in a month.

<h3 id="list-mrr-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|currency|query|object|false|The currency of MRR analytics. Format must be ISO 4217.|
|billing_entity_code|query|string|false|Restrict the analytics to a single billing entity, identified by its code. An unknown code is ignored and the analytics cover the whole organization.|
|months|query|integer|false|Show data only for given number of months.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "mrrs": [
    {
      "month": "2023-11-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "amount_cents": 50000,
      "currency": "USD"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "Forbidden",
  "code": "feature_unavailable"
}
```

<h3 id="list-mrr-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|MRR|[Mrrs](#schemamrrs)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[ApiErrorForbidden](#schemaapierrorforbidden)|

## List overdue balance

<a id="opIdfindAllOverdueBalances"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/analytics/overdue_balance \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /analytics/overdue_balance`

Overdue balance is the amount still due on invoices that are past their payment due date. Each entry covers one month of payment due dates and sums the invoice totals minus the amounts already paid and minus the credits applied by finalized credit notes. Self-billed invoices are excluded.

<h3 id="list-overdue-balance-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|currency|query|object|false|Filter the overdue balances by the currency of the invoices. Format must be ISO 4217.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application). Use it to restrict the overdue balances to a single customer.|
|billing_entity_code|query|string|false|Restrict the analytics to a single billing entity, identified by its code. An unknown code is ignored and the analytics cover the whole organization.|
|months|query|integer|false|Show data only for given number of months.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "overdue_balances": [
    {
      "month": "2023-11-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "amount_cents": 50000,
      "currency": "USD",
      "lago_invoice_ids": [
        "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba"
      ],
      "billing_entity_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,

```

## List usage

<a id="opIdfindAllUsages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/analytics/usage \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /analytics/usage`

Returns the usage billed by each billable metric, aggregated over the requested period and time granularity.
This is a premium feature. On a non-premium license the response always covers the last 30 days with a daily granularity, and only the `billable_metric_code` filter is applied.

<h3 id="list-usage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|time_granularity|query|string|false|The time granularity of usage analytics. Possible values are 'daily', 'weekly' and 'monthly'. Defaults to 'daily'.|
|currency|query|object|false|The currency of usage analytics. Format must be ISO 4217.|
|from_date|query|string(date)|false|The start date of the period for which the usage analytics is calculated.|
|to_date|query|string(date)|false|The end date of the period for which the usage analytics is calculated.|
|customer_type|query|string|false|The type of customer for which the usage analytics is calculated. Possible values are 'individual', 'company'.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|The external identifier of the customer for which the usage analytics is calculated.|
|customer_country|query|object|false|The country of the customer for which the usage analytics is calculated.|
|external_subscription_id|query|string|false|The external identifier of the subscription for which the usage analytics is calculated.|
|is_billable_metric_recurring|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether the billable metric associated with the usage is recurring.|
|plan_code|query|string|false|The code of the plan for which the usage analytics is calculated.|
|billable_metric_code|query|string|false|The code of the usage-based billable metrics for which the usage analytics is calculated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|time_granularity|daily|
|time_granularity|weekly|
|time_granularity|monthly|
|customer_type|individual|
|customer_type|company|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "usages": [
    {
      "organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
      "start_of_period_dt": "2023-11-01",
      "end_of_period_dt": "2023-11-30",
      "amount_currency": "USD",
      "amount_cents": 50000,
      "billable_metric_code": "code1",
      "units": "1.0",
      "is_billable_metric_deleted": false
    }
  ]
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

<h3 id="list-usage-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Usage|[Usages](#schemausages)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h1 id="lago-api-documentation-apilogs">api_logs</h1>

Everything about API logs

<a href="https://getlago.com/docs/api-reference/audit-logs/api-logs-object">Find out more</a>

## List all API logs

<a id="opIdfindAllApiLogs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/api_logs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api_logs`

This endpoint retrieves all existing API logs, which represent the requests made to Lago's API. Logs older than the retention period of your organization are left out. The retention period is 30 days unless another one was set for your organization.

<h3 id="list-all-api-logs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|from_date|query|string(date)|false|Filter API logs logged at or after this date.|
|to_date|query|string(date)|false|Filter API logs logged at or before this date.|
|http_methods[]|query|[string]|false|Filter results by HTTP methods.|
|http_statuses[]|query|[string \| integer]|false|Filter results by HTTP status or by generic request status. When `succeeded` or `failed` is passed, the numeric values of the filter are ignored.|
|api_version|query|string|false|Filter results by API version.|
|request_paths[]|query|[string]|false|Filter results by the path of the request. A value containing `*` is matched as a wildcard, otherwise the path must match exactly.|
|clients[]|query|[string]|false|Filter results by the client that issued the request, as reported by its user agent.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|http_methods[]|post|
|http_methods[]|put|
|http_methods[]|patch|
|http_methods[]|delete|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "api_logs": [
    {
      "api_version": "v1",
      "client": "Lago Ruby v1.26.0",
      "http_method": "post",
      "http_status": 200,
      "logged_at": "2025-03-31T12:31:44Z",
      "request_body": {
        "billable_metric": "{\"name\":\"Storage\",\"code\":\"storage\"}"
      },
      "request_origin": "https://api.getlago.com",
      "request_path": "/api/v1/billable_metrics",
      "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z",
      "request_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
```

## Evaluate an expression for a billable metric

<a id="opIdevaluateBillableMetricExpression"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/billable_metrics/evaluate_expression \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "expression": "round((event.properties.ended_at - event.properties.started_at) * event.properties.units)",
    "event": {
      "code": "storage",
      "timestamp": "1651240791",
      "properties": {
        "gb": 10
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /billable_metrics/evaluate_expression`

Evaluate an expression for a billable metric creation by providing the expression and test data

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "expression": "round((event.properties.ended_at - event.properties.started_at) * event.properties.units)",
  "event": {
    "code": "storage",
    "timestamp": "1651240791",
    "properties": {
      "gb": 10
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="evaluate-an-expression-for-a-billable-metric-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[BillableMetricEvaluateExpressionInput](#schemabillablemetricevaluateexpressioninput)|true|Billable metric expression evaluation payload|
|» expression|body|string|true|Expression used to calculate the event units. The expression is evaluated for each event and the result is then used to calculate the total aggregated units.<br>Event values are read with `event.code`, `event.timestamp` and `event.properties.<name>`.<br>Accepted functions are `ceil`, `concat`, `floor`, `greatest`, `least` and `round` as well as `+`, `-`, `/` and `*` operations.<br>`ceil`, `floor` and `round` accept an optional second parameter to specify the number of decimals.<br>|
|» event|body|object|true|none|
|» » code|body|string|true|The code that identifies a targeted billable metric.|
|» » timestamp|body|integer \| string|false|This field captures the Unix timestamp in seconds indicating the occurrence of the event in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).<br>If this timestamp is not provided, the API will automatically set it to the time of event reception.<br>|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » properties|body|object|true|This field represents additional properties associated with the event. They can be used when evaluating the expression.|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| integer \| number|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|number|false|none|

> Example responses

```json

  "expression_result": {
    "value": "2.0"
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
  "status": 400,
  "error": "Bad request"
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "status": 422,
  "error": "Unprocessable entity",
  "code": "validation_errors",
  "error_details": {}
}
```

`PUT /features/{code}`

This endpoint updates an existing feature representing an entitlement component of your application. Only the fields present in the payload are updated. Privileges are matched by their code, an unknown code adds a new privilege and a known one updates its name and adds the select options of the payload to the existing ones. The value type of an existing privilege cannot be changed. Privileges left out of the payload are kept, use the delete privilege endpoint to remove one.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "feature": {
    "name": "Number of seats",
    "description": "Number of users of the account",
    "privileges": [
      {
        "code": "max",
        "name": "Maximum",
        "value_type": "integer"
      },

        "value_type": "select",

}
```

## Create an entitlement

<a id="opIdcreateEntitlement"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/plans/startup/entitlements \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "entitlements": {
      "seats": {
        "max": 20,
        "max_admins": 10,
        "root": false
      },
      "sso": {
        "provider": "okta"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /plans/{code}/entitlements`

This endpoint creates new entitlements by adding features to a plan. Note that all existing entitlements will be deleted and replaced by the ones provided. Sending an empty `entitlements` object, or omitting the key, therefore removes every entitlement of the plan. To add a new entitlement without removing the existing ones, use PATCH. The feature must exist and all privileges must be valid for the feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "entitlements": {
    "seats": {
      "max": 20,
      "max_admins": 10,
      "root": false
    },
    "sso": {
      "provider": "okta"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-entitlement-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|Code of the existing plan.|
|body|body|[EntitlementUpdateInput](#schemaentitlementupdateinput)|true|Entitlement payload|
|» entitlements|body|object|false|Feature entitlements with their privilege values. Each key is a feature code, and the value is an object containing privilege codes with their associated values. The key is optional and defaults to an empty object. On the replacing endpoints (POST) an omitted or empty object removes every entitlement. On the partial update endpoints (PATCH) it changes nothing.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Privilege values for this feature. All privileges must exist on the feature.|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|integer \| boolean \| string|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|boolean|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|

```bash
      "sso": {
        "provider": "okta"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /plans/{code}/entitlements`

This accepts a list of entitlements to update. If the feature isn't part of the plan yet, it's added with all the privileges from the payload. If the feature is already part of the plan, the privilege and values are updated or added. All privileges must be valid for the feature. All features and privileges not part of the payload are left untouched. To remove privileges or features, use the DELETE endpoints.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "entitlements": {
    "seats": {
      "max": 20,
      "max_admins": 10,
      "root": false
    },
    "sso": {
      "provider": "okta"
    }
  }
}
```

|» entitlements|body|object|false|Feature entitlements with their privilege values. Each key is a feature code, and the value is an object containing privilege codes with their associated values. The key is optional and defaults to an empty object. On the replacing endpoints (POST) an omitted or empty object removes every entitlement. On the partial update endpoints (PATCH) it changes nothing.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|Privilege values for this feature. All privileges must exist on the feature.|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|integer \| boolean \| string|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|boolean|false|none|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|

`PATCH /subscriptions/{external_id}/entitlements`

This accepts a list of entitlements to update. If the feature isn't part of the subscription yet, it's added with all the privileges from the payload. If the feature is already part of the subscription (via plan or via override), the privilege and values are updated or added. All privileges must be valid for the feature. All features and privileges not part of the payload are left untouched. To remove privileges or features, use the DELETE endpoints.

On the partial update endpoints (PATCH) it changes nothing.|

## Create a billing entity

<a id="opIdcreateBillingEntity"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/billing_entities \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "billing_entity": {
      "code": "acme_corp",
      "name": "Acme Corp",
      "default_currency": "USD",
      "document_numbering": "per_customer",
      "document_number_prefix": "ABC-123",
      "finalize_zero_amount_invoice": true,
      "billing_configuration": {
        "invoice_footer": "Thank you for your business",
        "document_locale": "en",
        "invoice_grace_period": 0,
        "subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor": "next_period_start",
        "subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment": "align_with_finalization_date"
      },
      "net_payment_term": 0,
      "address_line1": "5230 Penfield Ave",
      "address_line2": "Suite 100",
      "phone": "1-171-883-3711 x245",
      "city": "Woodland Hills",
      "state": "CA",
      "country": "US",
      "zipcode": "91364",
      "email": "billing@acme.com",
      "legal_name": "Acme Corporation",
      "legal_number": "US123456789",
      "tax_identification_number": "EU123456789",
      "timezone": "UTC",
      "email_settings": [
        "invoice.finalized"
      ],
      "eu_tax_management": false,
      "einvoicing": false,
      "logo": "data:image/png;base64,..."
    }
  }'
```

`POST /billing_entities`

This endpoint is used to create a new billing entity

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "billing_entity": {
    "code": "acme_corp",
    "name": "Acme Corp",
    "default_currency": "USD",
    "document_numbering": "per_customer",
    "document_number_prefix": "ABC-123",
    "finalize_zero_amount_invoice": true,
    "billing_configuration": {
      "invoice_footer": "Thank you for your business",
      "document_locale": "en",
      "invoice_grace_period": 0,
      "subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor": "next_period_start",
      "subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment": "align_with_finalization_date"
    },
    "net_payment_term": 0,
    "address_line1": "5230 Penfield Ave",
    "address_line2": "Suite 100",
    "phone": "1-171-883-3711 x245",
    "city": "Woodland Hills",
    "state": "CA",
    "country": "US",
    "zipcode": "91364",
    "email": "billing@acme.com",
    "legal_name": "Acme Corporation",
    "legal_number": "US123456789",
    "tax_identification_number": "EU123456789",
    "timezone": "UTC",
    "email_settings": [
      "invoice.finalized"
    ],
    "eu_tax_management": false,
    "einvoicing": false,
    "logo": "data:image/png;base64,..."
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-billing-entity-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[BillingEntityCreateInput](#schemabillingentitycreateinput)|true|The billing entity payload|
|» billing_entity|body|object|true|none|
|» » code|body|string|true|The unique code of the billing entity|
|» » name|body|string|true|The name of the billing entity|
|» » default_currency|body|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|false|The default currency of the billing entity|
|» » document_numbering|body|string|false|The type of document numbering for this billing entity:<br>- `per_customer`: document numbers are unique per customer<br>- `per_billing_entity`: document numbers are unique per billing entity|
|» » document_number_prefix|body|string \| null|false|The prefix used in document numbers for this billing entity (1 to 10 characters). It is upper cased. When it is not provided, Lago builds one from the first three letters of the name and the last four characters of the identifier.|
|» » finalize_zero_amount_invoice|body|boolean|false|Whether to finalize invoices with zero amount for this billing entity|
|» » billing_configuration|body|object|false|none|
|» » » invoice_footer|body|string|false|The footer text to be displayed on invoices for this billing entity (600 characters max).|
|» » » document_locale|body|string|false|The language of the documents generated for this billing entity, in the ISO 639-1 format.|
|» » » invoice_grace_period|body|integer|false|The grace period (in days) for invoice finalization. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » » subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor|body|string|false|Defines whether the issuing date follows the current billing period's end date or the next period starting date.|
|» » » subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment|body|string|false|The logic applied on top of the subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor rule. You can opt to use the invoice finalization date, that includes any configured grace period.|
|» » net_payment_term|body|integer|false|The net payment term (in days) for this billing entity|
|» » address_line1|body|string \| null|false|The first line of the billing address|
|» » address_line2|body|string \| null|false|The second line of the billing address|
|» » phone|body|string \| null|false|The phone number of the billing entity|
|» » city|body|string \| null|false|The city of the billing address|
|» » state|body|string \| null|false|The state of the billing address|
|» » country|body|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|false|The country code of the billing address|
|» » zipcode|body|string \| null|false|The zipcode of the billing address|
|» » email|body|string \| null(email)|false|The email address of the billing entity|
|» » legal_name|body|string \| null|false|The legal name of the billing entity|
|» » legal_number|body|string \| null|false|The legal registration number of the billing entity|
|» » tax_identification_number|body|string \| null|false|The tax identification number of the billing entity|
|» » timezone|body|[Timezone](#schematimezone)|false|The timezone of the billing entity. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » email_settings|body|[string]|false|The email notification settings for this billing entity. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » eu_tax_management|body|boolean|false|Whether EU tax management is enabled for this billing entity. It can only be enabled when the billing entity country is in the European Union.|
|» » einvoicing|body|boolean|false|Whether e-invoicing is enabled for this billing entity. It can only be enabled when the billing entity country is `FR` or `DE`.|
|» » logo|body|string \| null(uri)|false|The base64 encoded logo image for the billing entity. Accepted formats are PNG, JPG and JPEG, up to 800 kB.|

## Update a billing entity

<a id="opIdupdateBillingEntity"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/billing_entities/acme_corp \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "billing_entity": {
      "name": "Acme Corp",
      "default_currency": "USD",
      "document_numbering": "per_customer",
      "document_number_prefix": "ABC-123",
      "finalize_zero_amount_invoice": true,
      "billing_configuration": {
        "invoice_footer": "Thank you for your business",
        "document_locale": "en",
        "invoice_grace_period": 0,
        "subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor": "next_period_start",
        "subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment": "align_with_finalization_date"
      },
      "net_payment_term": 0,
      "address_line1": "5230 Penfield Ave",
      "address_line2": "Suite 100",
      "phone": "1-171-883-3711 x245",
      "city": "Woodland Hills",
      "state": "CA",
      "country": "US",
      "zipcode": "91364",
      "email": "billing@acme.com",
      "legal_name": "Acme Corporation",
      "legal_number": "US123456789",
      "tax_identification_number": "EU123456789",
      "timezone": "UTC",
      "tax_codes": [
        "french_standard_vat"
      ],
      "email_settings": [
        "invoice.finalized"
      ],
      "eu_tax_management": false,
      "einvoicing": false,
      "logo": "data:image/png;base64,...",
      "invoice_custom_section_codes": [
        "custom_section_1",
        "custom_section_2"
      ]
    }
  }'
```

<h3 id="update-a-billing-entity-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|The unique code of the billing entity|
|body|body|[BillingEntityUpdateInput](#schemabillingentityupdateinput)|true|The billing entity update payload|
|» billing_entity|body|object|true|none|
|» » name|body|string|false|The name of the billing entity|
|» » default_currency|body|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|false|The default currency of the billing entity|
|» » document_numbering|body|string|false|The type of document numbering for this billing entity:<br>- `per_customer`: document numbers are unique per customer<br>- `per_billing_entity`: document numbers are unique per billing entity|
|» » document_number_prefix|body|string|false|The prefix used in document numbers for this billing entity (1 to 10 characters). It is upper cased. It cannot be removed once the billing entity exists, and sending `null` returns a `422` error.|
|» » finalize_zero_amount_invoice|body|boolean|false|Whether to finalize invoices with zero amount for this billing entity|
|» » billing_configuration|body|object|false|none|
|» » » invoice_footer|body|string|false|The footer text to be displayed on invoices for this billing entity (600 characters max).|
|» » » document_locale|body|string|false|The language of the documents generated for this billing entity, in the ISO 639-1 format.|
|» » » invoice_grace_period|body|integer|false|The grace period (in days) for invoice finalization. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » » subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor|body|string|false|Defines whether the issuing date follows the current billing period's end date or the next period starting date.|
|» » » subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment|body|string|false|The logic applied on top of the subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor rule. You can opt to use the invoice finalization date, that includes any configured grace period.|
|» » net_payment_term|body|integer|false|The net payment term (in days) for this billing entity|
|» » address_line1|body|string \| null|false|The first line of the billing address|
|» » address_line2|body|string \| null|false|The second line of the billing address|
|» » phone|body|string \| null|false|The phone number of the billing entity|
|» » city|body|string \| null|false|The city of the billing address|
|» » state|body|string \| null|false|The state of the billing address|
|» » country|body|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|false|The country code of the billing address|
|» » zipcode|body|string \| null|false|The zipcode of the billing address|
|» » email|body|string \| null(email)|false|The email address of the billing entity|
|» » legal_name|body|string \| null|false|The legal name of the billing entity|
|» » legal_number|body|string \| null|false|The legal registration number of the billing entity|
|» » tax_identification_number|body|string \| null|false|The tax identification number of the billing entity|
|» » timezone|body|[Timezone](#schematimezone)|false|The timezone of the billing entity. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|The tax codes that should be associated with this billing entity. Codes are matched without case sensitivity, and two codes that differ only by case count as one. An unknown code returns a `404` error.|
|» » email_settings|body|[string]|false|The email notification settings for this billing entity. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » eu_tax_management|body|boolean|false|Whether EU tax management is enabled for this billing entity. It can only be enabled when the billing entity country is in the European Union.|
|» » einvoicing|body|boolean|false|Whether e-invoicing is enabled for this billing entity. It can only be enabled when the billing entity country is `FR` or `DE`.|
|» » logo|body|string \| null(uri)|false|The base64 encoded logo image for the billing entity. Accepted formats are PNG, JPG and JPEG, up to 800 kB. Sending "null" removes the current logo.|
|» » invoice_custom_section_codes|body|[string]|false|The codes of the invoice custom section that should be associated with this billing entity|

<h3 id="update-a-billing-entity-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Billing entity updated|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request error|[ApiErrorBadRequest](#schemaapierrorbadrequest)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|
|404|Not Found|Not Found error|[ApiErrorNotFound](#schemaapierrornotfound)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity error|[ApiErrorUnprocessableEntity](#schemaapierrorunprocessableentity)|

<h3 id="update-a-billing-entity-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billing_entity|[BillingEntityObjectExtended](#schemabillingentityobjectextended)|true|none|none|

<h1 id="lago-api-documentation-customers">customers</h1>

Everything about Customer collection

<a href="https://getlago.com/docs/api-reference/customers/object">Find out more</a>

## List all customers

<a id="opIdfindAllCustomers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers`

This endpoint retrieves all existing customers.

<h3 id="list-all-customers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|external_id|query|string|false|Filter customers by external ID.|
|account_type[]|query|[string]|false|Filter customers by account type.|
|billing_entity_codes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter customers by billing entity codes.|
|search_term|query|string|false|Filter customers by search term. This will filter all customers whose name, firstname, lastname, legal name, external id or email contain the search term.|
|countries[]|query|[[Country](#schemacountry)]|false|Filter customers by countries. Possible values are the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.|
|states[]|query|[string]|false|Filter customers by states.|
|zipcodes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter customers by zipcodes.|
|currencies[]|query|[[Currency](#schemacurrency)]|false|Filter customers by currencies.|
|has_tax_identification_number|query|boolean|false|Filter customers by whether they have a tax identification number or not.|
|metadata[key]|query|string|false|Filter customers by metadata. Replace `key` with the actual metadata key you want to match, and provide the corresponding value. Providing empty value will search for customers without given metadata key. For example, `metadata[is_synced]=true&metadata[last_synced_at]=`.|
|customer_type|query|string|false|Filter customers by customer type.|
|has_customer_type|query|boolean|false|Filter customers by whether they have a customer type or not.|

`POST /customers`

This endpoint creates a customer. When a customer with the same `external_id` already exists, it is updated instead, and only the fields present in the payload are changed.

<h3 id="create-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CustomerCreateInput](#schemacustomercreateinput)|true|Customer payload|
|» customer|body|object|true|none|
|» » external_id|body|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|» » billing_entity_code|body|string \| null|false|The unique code of the billing entity to associate with the customer. If not provided, the default billing entity will be used.|
|» » address_line1|body|string \| null|false|The first line of the billing address (500 characters max).|
|» » address_line2|body|string \| null|false|The second line of the billing address (500 characters max).|
|» » city|body|string \| null|false|The city of the customer's billing address (255 characters max).|
|» » country|body|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|false|Country code of the customer's billing address. Format must be ISO 3166 (alpha-2)|
|» » currency|body|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|false|Currency of the customer. Format must be ISO 4217|
|» » email|body|string \| null(email)|false|The email of the customer|
|» » legal_name|body|string \| null|false|The legal company name of the customer (255 characters max).|
|» » legal_number|body|string \| null|false|The legal company number of the customer|
|» » logo_url|body|string \| null|false|The logo URL of the customer|
|» » name|body|string \| null|false|The full name of the customer (255 characters max).|
|» » firstname|body|string \| null|false|First name of the customer (255 characters max).|
|» » lastname|body|string \| null|false|Last name of the customer (255 characters max).|
|» » account_type|body|string|false|The type of the account. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `customer`: the account is a customer, default value.<br>- `partner`: the account is a partner.<br><br>This field is only applied when revenue share is enabled on your organization and the customer has no subscription, invoice, add-on, fixed-amount coupon or wallet yet; otherwise it is ignored.|
|» » customer_type|body|string \| null|false|The type of the customer. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `company`: the customer is a company.<br>- `individual`: the customer is an individual.|
|» » phone|body|string \| null|false|The phone number of the customer|
|» » state|body|string \| null|false|The state of the customer's billing address (255 characters max).|
|» » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » tax_identification_number|body|string \| null|false|The tax identification number of the customer (255 characters max).|
|» » timezone|body|[TimezoneOrNull](#schematimezoneornull)|false|The customer's timezone, used for billing purposes in their local time. Overrides the organization's timezone. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » url|body|string \| null|false|The custom website URL of the customer|
|» » zipcode|body|string \| null|false|The zipcode of the customer's billing address (255 characters max).|
|» » net_payment_term|body|integer \| null|false|The net payment term, expressed in days, specifies the duration within which a customer is expected to remit payment after the invoice is finalized.|
|» » external_salesforce_id|body|string \| null|false|The customer ID within the Salesforce system|
|» » finalize_zero_amount_invoice|body|string|false|Specifies how invoices with a zero total amount should be handled:<br>- `inherit`: (Default) Follows the organization-level configuration.<br>- `finalize`: Invoices are issued and finalized even if the total amount is zero.<br>- `skip`: Invoices with a total amount of zero are not finalized.|
|» » billing_configuration|body|[CustomerBillingConfiguration](#schemacustomerbillingconfiguration)|false|Configuration specific to the payment provider, utilized for billing the customer. This object contains settings and parameters necessary for processing payments and invoicing the customer.|
|» » shipping_address|body|object|false|The shipping address of the customer. The address lines accept up to 500 characters, the city, state and zipcode up to 255.|
|» » » address_line1|body|string \| null|false|The first line of the shipping address|
|» » » address_line2|body|string \| null|false|The second line of the shipping address|
|» » » city|body|string \| null|false|The city of the customer's shipping address|
|» » » country|body|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|false|Country code of the customer's shipping address. Format must be ISO 3166 (alpha-2)|
|» » » state|body|string \| null|false|The state of the customer's shipping address|
|» » » zipcode|body|string \| null|false|The zipcode of the customer's shipping address|
|» » » address_line1|body|object|false|none|
|» » » address_line2|body|object|false|none|
|» » » city|body|object|false|none|
|» » » state|body|object|false|none|
|» » » zipcode|body|object|false|none|
|» » integration_customers|body|[object]|false|The integration customers to create or update for this customer. Only one entry per `integration_type` is accepted; sending two entries with the same type returns a `422` error with `invalid_count_per_integration_type` on `integration_customers`.|
|» » » id|body|string(uuid)|false|A unique identifier for the integration customer object in the Lago application.|
|» » » integration_type|body|string|false|The integration type used for accounting, tax and CRM syncs.<br>Accepted values: `netsuite`, `anrok`, `avalara`, `xero`, `hubspot`, `salesforce`.|
|» » » integration_code|body|string|false|Unique code used to identify an integration connection.|
|» » » code|body|string|false|Unique code identifying this integration customer. If it is not provided, the code of the integration connection is used.|
|» » » external_customer_id|body|string|false|The customer ID within the integration's system. If this field is not provided, Lago has the option to create a new customer record within the integration's system on behalf of the customer.|
|» » » sync_with_provider|body|boolean|false|Set this field to `true` if you want to create a customer record in the integration's system. This option is applicable only when the `external_customer_id` is null and the `sync_with_provider` field is set to `true`. By default, the value is set to `false`|
|» » » subsidiary_id|body|string|false|This optional field is needed only when working with `netsuite` connection.|
|» » » targeted_object|body|string \| null|false|This optional field is needed only when working with `hubspot` connection.|
|» » metadata|body|[object]|false|Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to a customer. This can be useful for storing additional information about the customer in a structured format. A customer can hold up to 5 key-value pairs.|
|» » » id|body|string(uuid)|false|Identifier for the metadata object, only required when updating a key-value pair|
|» » » key|body|string|true|The metadata object key (20 characters max). It must be unique for the customer.|
|» » » value|body|string|true|The metadata object value (100 characters max).|
|» » » display_in_invoice|body|boolean|false|Determines whether the item or information should be displayed in the invoice. If set to true, the item or information will be included and visible in the generated invoice. If set to false, the item or information will be excluded and not displayed in the invoice.|
|» » skip_invoice_custom_sections|body|boolean|false|Set to `true` to exclude all invoice custom sections from PDF generation for this customer only. False by default|

## List all customer's applied coupons

<a id="opIdfindAllCustomerAppliedCoupons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/applied_coupons \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/applied_coupons`

This endpoint is used to list all applied coupons for a customer.

<h3 id="list-all-customers-applied-coupons-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|status|query|string|false|The status of the coupon. Can be either `active` or `terminated`.|
|coupon_code[]|query|[string]|false|The code of the coupon applied to the customer. Use it to filter applied coupons by their code.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|terminated|

> Example responses

A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|issuing_date_from|query|string(date)|false|Filter credit notes starting from a specific date.|
|issuing_date_to|query|string(date)|false|Filter credit notes up to a specific date.|
|search_term|query|string|false|Search credit notes by id, number, customer name, customer external_id or customer email.|
|currency|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by currency. Possible values ISO 4217 currency codes.|
|reason|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by reasons. Possible values are `product_unsatisfactory`, `order_change`, `order_cancellation`, `fraudulent_charge`, `duplicated_charge` or `other`.|
|credit_status|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by credit status. Possible values are `available`, `consumed` or `voided`.|
|refund_status|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by refund status. Possible values are `pending`, `succeeded` or `failed`.|
|invoice_number|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by their related invoice number.|
|purchase_order_number|query|string|false|Filter by the invoice purchase order number. The match is exact but case-insensitive.|
|amount_from|query|integer|false|Filter credit notes of at least a specific amount. This parameter must be defined in cents to ensure consistent handling for all currency types.|
|amount_to|query|integer|false|Filter credit notes up to a specific amount. This parameter must be defined in cents to ensure consistent handling for all currency types.|
|types[]|query|[string]|false|Filter credit notes by the kind of amount they carry. `credit` matches credit notes with a credited amount, `refund` those with a refunded amount and `offset` those with an amount deducted from the invoice balance. A credit note can match several types.|
|self_billed|query|boolean|false|Filter credit notes belonging to a self billed invoice. Possible values are `true` or `false`.|
|billing_entity_codes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter credit notes by billing entity codes.|

## List all customer's invoices

<a id="opIdfindAllCustomerInvoices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/invoices \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/invoices`

This endpoint is used for retrieving all invoices of a customer.

<h3 id="list-all-customers-invoices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|amount_from|query|integer|false|Filter invoices of at least a specific amount. This parameter must be defined in cents to ensure consistent handling for all currency types.|
|amount_to|query|integer|false|Filter invoices up to a specific amount. This parameter must be defined in cents to ensure consistent handling for all currency types.|
|issuing_date_from|query|string(date)|false|Filter invoices starting from a specific date.|
|issuing_date_to|query|string(date)|false|Filter invoices up to a specific date.|
|status|query|string|false|Filter invoices by status. Possible values are `draft`, `failed`, `finalized`, `pending` and `voided`.|
|statuses[]|query|[string]|false|Filter invoices by statuses. Possible values are `draft`, `failed`, `finalized`, `pending` and `voided`.|
|payment_status|query|string|false|Filter invoices by payment status. Possible values are `pending`, `failed` or `succeeded`.|
|payment_statuses[]|query|[string]|false|Filter invoices by payment statuses. Possible values are `pending`, `failed` or `succeeded`.|
|payment_overdue|query|boolean|false|Filter invoices by payment_overdue. Possible values are `true` or `false`.|
|search_term|query|string|false|Search the customer's invoices by id or number. Customer attributes are not searched here, because the list is already scoped to one customer.|
|payment_dispute_lost|query|boolean|false|Filter invoices with a payment dispute lost. Possible values are `true` or `false`.|
|invoice_type|query|string|false|Filter invoices by invoice type. Possible values are `subscription`, `add_on`, `credit`, `one_off`, `advance_charges` or `progressive_billing`.|
|self_billed|query|boolean|false|Filter invoices by self billed. Possible values are `true` or `false`.|
|currency|query|string|false|Filter invoices by currency. Possible values ISO 4217 currency codes.|
|partially_paid|query|boolean|false|Filter invoices that are partially paid. When `true`, only invoices with a non-zero amount paid that is below the total due are returned. When `false`, those invoices are excluded.|
|settlements[]|query|[string]|false|Filter invoices settled by at least one of the given settlement types. `payment` matches invoices settled by a payment, `credit_note` matches invoices settled by a credit note.|
|billing_entity_codes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter invoices by billing entity codes. Possible values are the billing entity codes you have created.|
|metadata[key]|query|string|false|Filter invoices by metadata. Replace `key` with the actual metadata key you want to match, and provide the corresponding value. Providing empty value will search for invoice without given metadata key. For example, `metadata[color]=blue`.|
|purchase_order_number|query|string|false|Filter by the invoice purchase order number. The match is exact but case-insensitive.|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|status|draft|
|status|finalized|
|status|failed|
|status|pending|
|status|voided|
|statuses[]|draft|
|statuses[]|finalized|

|statuses[]|pending|

|payment_statuses[]|succeeded|
|invoice_type|subscription|
|invoice_type|add_on|
|invoice_type|credit|
|invoice_type|one_off|
|invoice_type|advance_charges|
|invoice_type|progressive_billing|
|settlements[]|payment|
|settlements[]|credit_note|

## List all customer's payments

<a id="opIdfindAllCustomerPayments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/payments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/payments`

This endpoint is used to list all payments of a customer

<h3 id="list-all-customers-payments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|invoice_id|query|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the invoice's record within the Lago system.|

## List all customer's payment requests

<a id="opIdfindAllCustomerPaymentRequests"></a>

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/payment_requests \

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/payment_requests`

This endpoint is used to list all existing payment requests of a customer.

<h3 id="list-all-customers-payment-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|currency|query|string|false|Filter the results by currency, expressed as an ISO 4217 code.|
|payment_status|query|string|false|Filter by payment status. Possible values are `pending`, `failed` or `succeeded`.|
|billing_entity_codes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter payment requests by billing entity codes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|payment_status|pending|
|payment_status|failed|
|payment_status|succeeded|

## Get a customer portal URL

<a id="opIdgetCustomerPortalUrl"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/portal_url \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/portal_url`

Retrieves an embeddable link for displaying a customer portal.

This endpoint allows you to fetch the URL that can be embedded to provide customers access to a dedicated portal.

The portal lets the customer update their information and top up their wallets, so when API key permissions are enabled, the API key needs the `write` permission on `customer`.

<h3 id="get-a-customer-portal-url-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing customer|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "customer": {
    "portal_url": "https://app.lago.com/customer-portal/1234567890"
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "Forbidden",
  "code": "feature_unavailable"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "status": 404,
  "error": "Not Found",
  "code": "object_not_found"
}
```

<h3 id="get-a-customer-portal-url-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Portal URL|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[ApiErrorForbidden](#schemaapierrorforbidden)|
|404|Not Found|Not Found error|[ApiErrorNotFound](#schemaapierrornotfound)|

<h3 id="get-a-customer-portal-url-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer|object|true|none|none|
|» portal_url|string|true|none|An embeddable link for displaying a customer portal|

bearerAuth
</aside>

## List all customer's subscriptions

<a id="opIdfindAllCustomerSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/subscriptions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/subscriptions`

This endpoint retrieves all active subscriptions for a customer.

<h3 id="list-all-customers-subscriptions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|currency|query|string|false|Filter the results by currency, expressed as an ISO 4217 code.|
|external_id|query|string|false|The subscription external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|plan_code|query|string|false|The unique code representing the plan to be attached to the customer. This code must correspond to the code property of one of the active plans.|
|overridden|query|boolean|false|When set, filters subscriptions by whether their plan is an override of a parent plan. `true` returns only subscriptions on overridden plans; `false` returns only those on standard (non-overridden) plans.|
|status[]|query|[string]|false|If the field is not defined, Lago will return only `active` subscriptions. However, if you wish to fetch subscriptions by different status you can define them in a status[] query param. Available filter values: `pending`, `canceled`, `terminated`, `active`, `incomplete`.|
|billing_entity_codes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter subscriptions by billing entity codes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status[]|pending|
|status[]|canceled|
|status[]|terminated|
|status[]|active|
|status[]|incomplete|

## Retrieve customer current usage

<a id="opIdfindCustomerCurrentUsage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/current_usage?external_subscription_id=sub_1234567890' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/current_usage`

This endpoint enables the retrieval of the usage-based billing data for a customer within the current period.

<h3 id="retrieve-customer-current-usage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|external_subscription_id|query|string|true|The unique identifier of the subscription within your application.|
|apply_taxes|query|boolean|false|Optional flag to determine if taxes should be applied. Defaults to `true` if not provided or if null.<br>|
|charge_id|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter usage to a specific charge by its Lago ID (UUID). Replaces deprecated `filter_by_charge_id`.|
|charge_code|query|string|false|Filter usage to a specific charge by its code. Replaces deprecated `filter_by_charge_code`.|
|billable_metric_code|query|string|false|Filter usage to a specific billable metric by its code.|
|group|query|object|false|Filter usage by pricing group. Pass key/value pairs as query parameters, e.g. `group[cloud]=aws`. Replaces deprecated `filter_by_group`.<br>|
|filter_by_charge_id|query|string(uuid)|false|**Deprecated.** **Deprecated.** Filter usage to a specific charge by its Lago ID (UUID).|
|filter_by_charge_code|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** **Deprecated.** Filter usage to a specific charge by its code.|
|filter_by_group|query|object|false|**Deprecated.** **Deprecated.** Filter usage by pricing group. Pass key/value pairs as query parameters, e.g. `filter_by_group[cloud]=aws`.<br>|
|full_usage|query|boolean|false|When `true`, returns usage since the subscription started instead of the current billing period. It requires the granular lifetime usage add-on, at least one of `charge_id`, `charge_code`, `billable_metric_code` or `group` (or their deprecated `filter_by_*` equivalents), and a subscription without prorated charges. The request returns `405` when one of these conditions is not met.<br>|
|filter_by_presentation|query|string|false|Filter `presentation_breakdowns` by a JSON-encoded array of presentation group key values. Only breakdowns matching the provided values will be returned. Pass an empty array to disable `presentation_breakdowns` entirely.<br>|

|charge_id|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter usage to a specific charge by its Lago ID (UUID).|
|charge_code|query|string|false|Filter usage to a specific charge by its code.|
|billable_metric_code|query|string|false|Filter usage to a specific billable metric by its code.|
|group|query|object|false|Filter usage by pricing group. Pass key/value pairs as query parameters, e.g. `group[cloud]=aws`.<br>|
|filter_by_presentation|query|string|false|Filter `presentation_breakdowns` by a JSON-encoded array of presentation group key values. Only breakdowns matching the provided values will be returned. Pass an empty array to disable `presentation_breakdowns` entirely.<br>|

`GET /customers/{external_customer_id}/past_usage`

This endpoint enables the retrieval of the usage-based billing data for a customer within past periods.

<h3 id="retrieve-customer-past-usage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|external_subscription_id|query|string|true|The unique identifier of the subscription within your application.|
|billable_metric_code|query|string|false|Billable metric code filter to apply to the charge usage|
|periods_count|query|integer|false|Number of past billing period to returns in the result|

<h3 id="list-all-plans-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|

`POST /plans`

This endpoint creates a plan with subscription and usage-based charges. It supports flexible billing cadence (in-advance or in-arrears) and allows for both recurring and metered charges.

<h3 id="create-a-plan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PlanCreateInput](#schemaplancreateinput)|true|Plan payload|
|» plan|body|object|true|none|
|» » name|body|string|true|The name of the plan.|
|» » invoice_display_name|body|string \| null|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the plan will be used as the default display name.|
|» » code|body|string|true|The code of the plan. It serves as a unique identifier associated with a particular plan. The code is typically used for internal or system-level identification purposes, like assigning a subscription, for instance.|
|» » interval|body|string|true|The interval used for recurring billing. It represents the frequency at which subscription billing occurs. The interval can be one of the following values: `yearly`, `semiannual`, `quarterly`, `monthly`, or `weekly`.|
|» » description|body|string \| null|false|The description on the plan.|
|» » amount_cents|body|integer|true|The base cost of the plan, excluding any applicable taxes, that is billed on a recurring basis. This value is defined at 0 if your plan is a pay-as-you-go plan.|
|» » amount_currency|body|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|The currency of the plan. It indicates the monetary unit in which the plan's cost, including taxes and usage-based charges, is expressed.|
|» » trial_period|body|number \| null|false|The duration in days during which the base cost of the plan is offered for free.|
|» » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|true|This field determines the billing timing for the plan. When set to `true`, the base cost of the plan is due at the beginning of each billing period. Conversely, when set to `false`, the base cost of the plan is due at the end of each billing period.|
|» » bill_charges_monthly|body|boolean \| null|false|This field, when set to `true`, enables to invoice usage-based charges on monthly basis, even if the cadence of the plan is `yearly` or `semiannual`. This allows customers to pay charges overage on a monthly basis. This can be set to true only if the plan's interval is `yearly` or `semiannual`.|
|» » bill_fixed_charges_monthly|body|boolean \| null|false|This field, when set to `true`, enables to invoice fixed charges on monthly basis, even if the cadence of the plan is `yearly` or `semiannual`. This allows customers to pay fixed charges on a monthly basis. This can be set to true only if the plan's interval is `yearly` or `semiannual`.|
|» » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » minimum_commitment|body|[MinimumCommitmentInput](#schemaminimumcommitmentinput)|false|Minimum commitment for this plan.|
|» » charges|body|[object]|false|Additional usage-based charges for this plan.|
|» » » billable_metric_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the billable metric created by Lago.|
|» » » code|body|string|false|Unique code identifying the charge within the plan. If not provided, it is generated from the code of the billable metric.|
|» » » charge_model|body|[ChargeModelEnum](#schemachargemodelenum)|true|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the final fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - [`dynamic`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/dynamic)<br>  - [`graduated_percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated-percentage)<br>  - [`graduated`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated)<br>  - [`package`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/package)<br>  - [`percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/percentage)<br>  - [`standard`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/standard)<br>  - [`volume`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/volume)<br>|
|» » » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for this specific usage-based charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately. Conversely, when set to false, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of each billing period.|
|» » » invoiceable|body|boolean|false|This field specifies whether the charge should be included in a proper invoice. If set to false, no invoice will be issued for this charge. You can only set it to `false` when `pay_in_advance` is `true`.|
|» » » regroup_paid_fees|body|string \| null|false|This setting can only be configured if `pay_in_advance` is `true` and `invoiceable` is `false`.<br>This field determines whether and when the charge fee should be included in<br>the invoice. If `null`, no invoice will be issued for this charge fee.<br>If `invoice`, an invoice will be generated at the end of the period,<br>consolidating all charge fees with a succeeded payment status.|
|» » » invoice_display_name|body|string|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the actual charge will be used as the default display name.|
|» » » prorated|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether a charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.<br>- If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|
|» » » min_amount_cents|body|integer|false|The minimum spending amount required for the charge, measured in cents and excluding any applicable taxes. It indicates the minimum amount that needs to be charged for each billing period.|
|» » » properties|body|[ChargeObjectProperties](#schemachargeobjectproperties)|false|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the charge.|
|» » » filters|body|[[ChargeFilterInput](#schemachargefilterinput)]|false|List of filters used to apply differentiated pricing based on additional event properties.|
|» » » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » » applied_pricing_unit|body|object|false|The pricing unit to apply to the charge.|
|» » » » code|body|string|false|The code of the pricing unit.|
|» » » » conversion_rate|body|string|false|The conversion rate from pricing units to the plan's currency.<br>This rate determines how many currency units (in the plan's base currency) equal one pricing unit.<br>For example, if the plan uses USD and the conversion rate is 0.5, then 1 pricing unit = $0.50.|
|» » » accepts_target_wallet|body|boolean \| null|false|Specifies whether the charge accepts a target wallet for prepaid credits deduction.|
|» » fixed_charges|body|[object]|false|Additional fixed charges for this plan.|
|» » » add_on_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the add-on associated with this fixed charge.|
|» » » code|body|string|false|Unique code for the fixed charge. If not provided, it will be automatically generated based on the add-on code.|
|» » » invoice_display_name|body|string|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the actual charge will be used as the default display name.|
|» » » units|body|number|false|The number of units for the fixed charge. Defaults to 0 if not provided.|
|» » » charge_model|body|string|true|The charge model for the fixed charge. Only `standard`, `graduated`, and `volume` models are supported for fixed charges.|
|» » » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for this specific fixed charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately. Conversely, when set to false, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of each billing period. Defaults to `false` if not provided.|
|» » » prorated|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether a fixed charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.<br>- Defaults to `false` if not provided.<br><br>Note: Prorated fixed charges with `graduated` model and `pay_in_advance` are not allowed.<br>|
|» » » properties|body|[FixedChargeProperties](#schemafixedchargeproperties)|false|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the fixed charge.|
|» » » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of taxes applied to the fixed charge.|
|» » » apply_units_immediately|body|boolean|false|When set to `true`, the fixed charge units are applied immediately for active subscriptions. When set to `false`, the units are applied at the next billing period.|
|» » usage_thresholds|body|[[UsageThresholdInput](#schemausagethresholdinput)]|false|List of usage thresholds to apply to the plan.|
|» » metadata|body|[MetadataInput](#schemametadatainput)|false|Metadata to set as key-value pairs. Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

`GET /plans/{code}`

This endpoint retrieves a specific plan.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-plan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|The code of the plan. It serves as a unique identifier associated with a particular plan. The code is typically used for internal or system-level identification purposes, like assigning a subscription, for instance.|

`PUT /plans/{code}`

This endpoint updates a specific plan with subscription and usage-based charges. It supports flexible billing cadence (in-advance or in-arrears) and allows for both recurring and metered charges.
