<h3 id="update-a-plan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|The code of the plan. It serves as a unique identifier associated with a particular plan. The code is typically used for internal or system-level identification purposes, like assigning a subscription, for instance.|
|body|body|[PlanUpdateInput](#schemaplanupdateinput)|true|Plan payload|
|» plan|body|object|true|none|
|» » name|body|string|false|The name of the plan.|
|» » invoice_display_name|body|string \| null|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the plan will be used as the default display name.|
|» » code|body|string|false|The code of the plan. It serves as a unique identifier associated with a particular plan. The code is typically used for internal or system-level identification purposes, like assigning a subscription, for instance.|
|» » interval|body|string|false|The interval used for recurring billing. It represents the frequency at which subscription billing occurs. The interval can be one of the following values: `yearly`, `semiannual`, `quarterly`, `monthly`, or `weekly`.|
|» » description|body|string \| null|false|The description on the plan.|
|» » amount_cents|body|integer|false|The base cost of the plan, excluding any applicable taxes, that is billed on a recurring basis. This value is defined at 0 if your plan is a pay-as-you-go plan.|
|» » amount_currency|body|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|false|The currency of the plan. It indicates the monetary unit in which the plan's cost, including taxes and usage-based charges, is expressed.|
|» » trial_period|body|number \| null|false|The duration in days during which the base cost of the plan is offered for free.|
|» » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for the plan. When set to `true`, the base cost of the plan is due at the beginning of each billing period. Conversely, when set to `false`, the base cost of the plan is due at the end of each billing period.|
|» » bill_charges_monthly|body|boolean \| null|false|This field, when set to `true`, enables to invoice usage-based charges on monthly basis, even if the cadence of the plan is yearly or semiannual. This allows customers to pay charges overage on a monthly basis. This can be set to true only if the plan's interval is `yearly` or `semiannual`.|
|» » bill_fixed_charges_monthly|body|boolean \| null|false|This field, when set to `true`, enables to invoice fixed charges on monthly basis, even if the cadence of the plan is `yearly` or `semiannual`. This allows customers to pay fixed charges on a monthly basis. This can be set to true only if the plan's interval is `yearly` or `semiannual`.|
|» » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » minimum_commitment|body|[MinimumCommitmentInput](#schemaminimumcommitmentinput)|false|Minimum commitment for this plan.|
|» » charges|body|[object]|false|Additional usage-based charges for this plan.|
|» » » id|body|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier of the charge created by Lago.|
|» » » billable_metric_id|body|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier of the billable metric created by Lago.|
|» » » code|body|string|false|Unique code identifying the charge within the plan. On a new charge, if not provided, it is generated from the code of the billable metric.|
|» » » charge_model|body|[ChargeModelEnum](#schemachargemodelenum)|false|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the final fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - [`dynamic`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/dynamic)<br>  - [`graduated_percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated-percentage)<br>  - [`graduated`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated)<br>  - [`package`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/package)<br>  - [`percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/percentage)<br>  - [`standard`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/standard)<br>  - [`volume`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/volume)<br>|
|» » » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for this specific usage-based charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately. Conversely, when set to false, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of each billing period.|
|» » » invoiceable|body|boolean|false|This field specifies whether the charge should be included in a proper invoice. If set to false, no invoice will be issued for this charge. You can only set it to `false` when `pay_in_advance` is `true`.|
|» » » regroup_paid_fees|body|string \| null|false|This setting can only be configured if `pay_in_advance` is `true` and `invoiceable` is `false`.<br>This field determines whether and when the charge fee should be included in<br>the invoice. If `null`, no invoice will be issued for this charge fee.<br>If `invoice`, an invoice will be generated at the end of the period,<br>consolidating all charge fees with a succeeded payment status.|
|» » » invoice_display_name|body|string|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the actual charge will be used as the default display name.|
|» » » prorated|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether a charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.<br>- If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|
|» » » min_amount_cents|body|integer|false|The minimum spending amount required for the charge, measured in cents and excluding any applicable taxes. It indicates the minimum amount that needs to be charged for each billing period.|
|» » » properties|body|[ChargeObjectProperties](#schemachargeobjectproperties)|false|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the charge.|
|» » » filters|body|[[ChargeFilterInput](#schemachargefilterinput)]|false|List of filters used to apply differentiated pricing based on additional event properties.|
|» » » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » » applied_pricing_unit|body|object|false|The pricing unit of the charge. For an existing charge, only `conversion_rate` is updated, and only if the charge already has an applied pricing unit. For a new charge (no `id`), `code` selects the pricing unit to apply.|
|» » » » code|body|string|false|The code of the pricing unit. Only used when the charge is created by this request.|
|» » » » conversion_rate|body|string|false|The conversion rate from pricing units to the plan's currency.<br>This rate determines how many currency units (in the plan's base currency) equal one pricing unit.<br>For example, if the plan uses USD and the conversion rate is 0.5, then 1 pricing unit = $0.50 USD.|
|» » » accepts_target_wallet|body|boolean \| null|false|Specifies whether the charge accepts a target wallet for prepaid credits deduction.|
|» » fixed_charges|body|[object]|false|Additional fixed charges for this plan.|
|» » » id|body|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier of the fixed charge created by Lago (required for updates).|
|» » » add_on_id|body|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier of the add-on associated with this fixed charge.|
|» » » code|body|string|false|Unique code for the fixed charge. If not provided, it will be automatically generated based on the add-on code.|
|» » » invoice_display_name|body|string|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the actual charge will be used as the default display name.|
|» » » units|body|number|false|The number of units for the fixed charge. Defaults to 0 if not provided.|
|» » » charge_model|body|string|false|The charge model for the fixed charge. Only `standard`, `graduated`, and `volume` models are supported for fixed charges.|
|» » » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for this specific fixed charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately. Conversely, when set to false, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of each billing period. Defaults to `false` if not provided.|
|» » » prorated|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether a fixed charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.<br>- Defaults to `false` if not provided.<br><br>Note: Prorated fixed charges with `graduated` model and `pay_in_advance` are not allowed.<br>|
|» » » properties|body|[FixedChargeProperties](#schemafixedchargeproperties)|false|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the fixed charge.|
|» » » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of taxes applied to the fixed charge.|
|» » » apply_units_immediately|body|boolean|false|Determines if the units should be applied immediately upon assignment or deferred to the next billing cycle.|
|» » usage_thresholds|body|[[UsageThresholdInput](#schemausagethresholdinput)]|false|List of usage thresholds to apply to the plan.|
|» » cascade_updates|body|boolean|false|This field determines whether the changes made to the plan should be cascaded to the children plans. When set to `true`, the changes will be cascaded into children. Conversely, when set to `false`, the changes will only be applied to the plan itself. If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|
|» » metadata|body|[MetadataInput](#schemametadatainput)|false|Metadata to set as key-value pairs. Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

## Delete a plan

<a id="opIddestroyPlan"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/plans/startup \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /plans/{code}`

This endpoint deletes a specific plan. Note that this plan could be associated with active subscriptions.

<h3 id="delete-a-plan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|The code of the plan. It serves as a unique identifier associated with a particular plan. The code is typically used for internal or system-level identification purposes, like assigning a subscription, for instance.|

## Replace plan metadata

<a id="opIdreplacePlanMetadata"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/plans/startup/metadata \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "metadata": {
      "external_id": "ext-123",
      "synced_at": "2024-01-15",
      "source": null
    }
  }'
```

`POST /plans/{code}/metadata`

This endpoint replaces all existing metadata on a plan with the provided key-value pairs.
Any existing metadata keys not included in the request will be removed.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "external_id": "ext-123",
    "synced_at": "2024-01-15",
    "source": null
  }
}
```

<h3 id="replace-plan-metadata-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|The code of the plan.|
|body|body|[PlanMetadataResponse](#schemaplanmetadataresponse)|true|none|
|» metadata|body|[MetadataObject](#schemametadataobject)|true|Custom metadata stored as key-value pairs.<br>Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "external_id": "ext-123",
    "synced_at": "2024-01-15",
    "source": null
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "status": 404,
  "error": "Not Found",
  "code": "object_not_found"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "status": 422,
  "error": "Unprocessable entity",
  "code": "validation_errors",
  "error_details": {}
}
```

<h3 id="replace-plan-metadata-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Plan metadata replaced|[PlanMetadataResponse](#schemaplanmetadataresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|
|404|Not Found|Not Found error|[ApiErrorNotFound](#schemaapierrornotfound)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity error|[ApiErrorUnprocessableEntity](#schemaapierrorunprocessableentity)|

bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="create-a-charge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|Code of the existing plan.|
|body|body|[ChargeCreateInput](#schemachargecreateinput)|true|Charge payload|
|» charge|body|object|true|none|
|» » invoice_display_name|body|string|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the actual charge will be used as the default display name.|
|» » min_amount_cents|body|integer|false|The minimum spending amount required for the charge, measured in cents and excluding any applicable taxes. It indicates the minimum amount that needs to be charged for each billing period.|
|» » properties|body|[ChargeObjectProperties](#schemachargeobjectproperties)|false|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the charge.|
|» » filters|body|[[ChargeFilterInput](#schemachargefilterinput)]|false|List of filters used to apply differentiated pricing based on additional event properties.|
|» » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » applied_pricing_unit|body|object|false|The pricing unit to apply to the charge.|
|» » » code|body|string|false|The code of the pricing unit.|
|» » » conversion_rate|body|string|false|The conversion rate from pricing units to the plan's currency.<br>This rate determines how many currency units (in the plan's base currency) equal one pricing unit.<br>For example, if the plan uses USD and the conversion rate is 0.5, then 1 pricing unit = $0.50.|
|» » billable_metric_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the billable metric created by Lago.|
|» » code|body|string|true|Unique code identifying the charge within the plan.|
|» » charge_model|body|[ChargeModelEnum](#schemachargemodelenum)|true|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the final fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - [`dynamic`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/dynamic)<br>  - [`graduated_percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated-percentage)<br>  - [`graduated`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated)<br>  - [`package`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/package)<br>  - [`percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/percentage)<br>  - [`standard`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/standard)<br>  - [`volume`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/volume)<br>|
|» » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for this specific usage-based charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately. Conversely, when set to false, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of each billing period.|
|» » invoiceable|body|boolean|false|This field specifies whether the charge should be included in a proper invoice. If set to false, no invoice will be issued for this charge. You can only set it to `false` when `pay_in_advance` is `true`.|
|» » regroup_paid_fees|body|string \| null|false|This setting can only be configured if `pay_in_advance` is `true` and `invoiceable` is `false`.<br>This field determines whether and when the charge fee should be included in<br>the invoice. If `null`, no invoice will be issued for this charge fee.<br>If `invoice`, an invoice will be generated at the end of the period,<br>consolidating all charge fees with a succeeded payment status.|
|» » prorated|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether a charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.<br>- If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|
|» » accepts_target_wallet|body|boolean \| null|false|Specifies whether the charge accepts a target wallet for prepaid credits deduction.<br>When set to `true`, events may include a `target_wallet_code` in their `properties` to direct credit deduction to a specific wallet.<br>If no `target_wallet_code` is provided on the event, the standard wallet selection logic is applied.<br>If the `target_wallet_code` does not match an existing wallet, no credits will be applied for that event.<br><br>This field requires a premium integration.|
|» » cascade_updates|body|boolean|false|This field determines whether the creation of the charge should be cascaded to the children plans. When set to `true`, the charge will be created in children plans. Conversely, when set to `false`, the charge will only be created in the plan itself. If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|» » charge_model|dynamic|
|» » charge_model|graduated|
|» » charge_model|graduated_percentage|
|» » charge_model|package|
|» » charge_model|percentage|
|» » charge_model|standard|
|» » charge_model|volume|
|» » regroup_paid_fees|null|
|» » regroup_paid_fees|invoice|

`PUT /plans/{code}/charges/{charge_code}`

This endpoint updates a specific charge for a plan.

The payload replaces the charge configuration: `charge_model` must be sent on every update, and `invoice_display_name` is cleared when it is left out.

Once the plan is attached to a subscription, only `invoice_display_name`, `properties`, `filters`, `tax_codes`, `applied_pricing_unit` and `accepts_target_wallet` are applied. The other fields are ignored.

<h3 id="update-a-charge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|Code of the existing plan.|
|charge_code|path|string|true|Code of the existing charge.|
|body|body|[ChargeUpdateInput](#schemachargeupdateinput)|true|Charge payload|
|» charge|body|object|true|none|
|» » invoice_display_name|body|string|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the actual charge will be used as the default display name.|
|» » min_amount_cents|body|integer|false|The minimum spending amount required for the charge, measured in cents and excluding any applicable taxes. It indicates the minimum amount that needs to be charged for each billing period.|
|» » properties|body|[ChargeObjectProperties](#schemachargeobjectproperties)|false|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the charge.|
|» » filters|body|[[ChargeFilterInput](#schemachargefilterinput)]|false|List of filters used to apply differentiated pricing based on additional event properties.|
|» » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » applied_pricing_unit|body|object|false|The pricing unit to apply to the charge.|
|» » » code|body|string|false|The code of the pricing unit.|
|» » » conversion_rate|body|string|false|The conversion rate from pricing units to the plan's currency.<br>This rate determines how many currency units (in the plan's base currency) equal one pricing unit.<br>For example, if the plan uses USD and the conversion rate is 0.5, then 1 pricing unit = $0.50.|
|» » billable_metric_id|body|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier of the billable metric created by Lago.|
|» » code|body|string|false|Unique code identifying the charge within the plan.|
|» » charge_model|body|[ChargeModelEnum](#schemachargemodelenum)|false|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the final fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - [`dynamic`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/dynamic)<br>  - [`graduated_percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated-percentage)<br>  - [`graduated`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated)<br>  - [`package`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/package)<br>  - [`percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/percentage)<br>  - [`standard`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/standard)<br>  - [`volume`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/volume)<br>|
|» » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for this specific usage-based charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately. Conversely, when set to false, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of each billing period.|
|» » invoiceable|body|boolean|false|This field specifies whether the charge should be included in a proper invoice. If set to false, no invoice will be issued for this charge. You can only set it to `false` when `pay_in_advance` is `true`.|
|» » regroup_paid_fees|body|string \| null|false|This setting can only be configured if `pay_in_advance` is `true` and `invoiceable` is `false`.<br>This field determines whether and when the charge fee should be included in<br>the invoice. If `null`, no invoice will be issued for this charge fee.<br>If `invoice`, an invoice will be generated at the end of the period,<br>consolidating all charge fees with a succeeded payment status.|
|» » prorated|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether a charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.<br>- If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|
|» » accepts_target_wallet|body|boolean \| null|false|Specifies whether the charge accepts a target wallet for prepaid credits deduction.<br>When set to `true`, events may include a `target_wallet_code` in their `properties` to direct credit deduction to a specific wallet.<br>If no `target_wallet_code` is provided on the event, the standard wallet selection logic is applied.<br>If the `target_wallet_code` does not match an existing wallet, no credits will be applied for that event.<br><br>This field requires a premium integration.|
|» » cascade_updates|body|boolean|false|This field determines whether the changes made to the charge should be cascaded to the children plans. When set to `true`, the changes will be cascaded into children. Conversely, when set to `false`, the changes will only be applied to the plan itself. If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » charge_model|dynamic|
|» » charge_model|graduated|
|» » charge_model|graduated_percentage|
|» » charge_model|package|
|» » charge_model|percentage|
|» » charge_model|standard|
|» » charge_model|volume|
|» » regroup_paid_fees|null|
|» » regroup_paid_fees|invoice|

<h3 id="create-a-fixed-charge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|Code of the existing plan.|
|body|body|[FixedChargeCreateInput](#schemafixedchargecreateinput)|true|Fixed charge payload|
|» fixed_charge|body|object|true|none|
|» » invoice_display_name|body|string \| null|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the add-on will be used as the default display name.|
|» » units|body|string|false|The quantity of units for the fixed charge.|
|» » apply_units_immediately|body|boolean|false|When set to `true`, the fixed charge units are applied immediately for active subscriptions. When set to `false`, the units are applied at the next billing period.|
|» » properties|body|[ChargeProperties](#schemachargeproperties)|false|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the fixed charge.|
|» » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » add_on_id|body|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier of the add-on. Either add_on_id or add_on_code is required.|
|» » add_on_code|body|string|false|Unique code identifying an add-on. Either add_on_id or add_on_code is required.|
|» » code|body|string|true|Unique code identifying the fixed charge within the plan.|
|» » charge_model|body|[FixedChargeModelEnum](#schemafixedchargemodelenum)|true|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the fixed charge fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `standard`<br>  - `graduated`<br>  - `volume`<br>|
|» » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for this fixed charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately at the beginning of the billing period. When set to `false`, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of the billing period.|
|» » prorated|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether a fixed charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.|
|» » cascade_updates|body|boolean|false|This field determines whether the creation of the fixed charge should be cascaded to the children plans. When set to `true`, the fixed charge will be created in children plans. Conversely, when set to `false`, the fixed charge will only be created in the plan itself. If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » charge_model|standard|
|» » charge_model|graduated|
|» » charge_model|volume|

`PUT /plans/{code}/fixed_charges/{fixed_charge_code}`

This endpoint updates a specific fixed charge for a plan.

The payload replaces the fixed charge configuration: `units` and `charge_model` must be sent on every update, and `invoice_display_name` is cleared when it is left out.

Once the plan is attached to a subscription, `code` and `charge_model` are ignored.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "fixed_charge": {
    "invoice_display_name": "Setup Fee",
    "units": "1.0",
    "apply_units_immediately": false,
    "properties": {
      "grouped_by": [
        "agent_name"
      ],
      "pricing_group_keys": [
        "agent_name"
      ],
      "graduated_ranges": [
        {
          "from_value": 0,
          "to_value": 10,
          "flat_amount": "10",
          "per_unit_amount": "0.5"
        }
      ],
      "graduated_percentage_ranges": [
        {
          "from_value": 0,
          "to_value": 10,
          "rate": "1",
          "flat_amount": "10"
        }
      ],
      "amount": "30",
      "free_units": 100,
      "package_size": 1000,
      "rate": "1",
      "fixed_amount": "0.5",
      "free_units_per_events": 5,
      "free_units_per_total_aggregation": "500",
      "per_transaction_max_amount": "3.75",
      "per_transaction_min_amount": "1.75",
      "volume_ranges": [
        {
          "from_value": 0,
          "to_value": 10,
          "flat_amount": "10",
          "per_unit_amount": "0.5"
        }
      ]
    },
    "tax_codes": [
      "french_standard_vat"
    ],
    "add_on_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "add_on_code": "setup_fee",
    "code": "setup_fee_charge",
    "charge_model": "standard",
    "pay_in_advance": true,
    "prorated": false,
    "cascade_updates": true
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-fixed-charge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|path|string|true|Code of the existing plan.|
|fixed_charge_code|path|string|true|Code of the existing fixed charge.|
|body|body|[FixedChargeUpdateInput](#schemafixedchargeupdateinput)|true|Fixed charge payload|
|» fixed_charge|body|object|true|none|
|» » invoice_display_name|body|string \| null|false|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the add-on will be used as the default display name.|
|» » units|body|string|false|The quantity of units for the fixed charge.|
|» » apply_units_immediately|body|boolean|false|When set to `true`, the fixed charge units are applied immediately for active subscriptions. When set to `false`, the units are applied at the next billing period.|
|» » properties|body|[ChargeProperties](#schemachargeproperties)|false|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the fixed charge.|
|» » tax_codes|body|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|» » add_on_id|body|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier of the add-on. Either add_on_id or add_on_code is required.|
|» » add_on_code|body|string|false|Unique code identifying an add-on. Either add_on_id or add_on_code is required.|
|» » code|body|string|false|Unique code identifying the fixed charge within the plan.|
|» » charge_model|body|[FixedChargeModelEnum](#schemafixedchargemodelenum)|false|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the fixed charge fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `standard`<br>  - `graduated`<br>  - `volume`<br>|
|» » pay_in_advance|body|boolean|false|This field determines the billing timing for this fixed charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately at the beginning of the billing period. When set to `false`, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of the billing period.|
|» » prorated|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether a fixed charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.|
|» » cascade_updates|body|boolean|false|This field determines whether the changes made to the fixed charge should be cascaded to the children plans. When set to `true`, the changes will be cascaded into children. Conversely, when set to `false`, the changes will only be applied to the plan itself. If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » charge_model|standard|
|» » charge_model|graduated|
|» » charge_model|volume|

## List all subscriptions

<a id="opIdfindAllSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/subscriptions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /subscriptions`

This endpoint retrieves all active subscriptions.

<h3 id="list-all-subscriptions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|currency|query|string|false|Filter the results by currency, expressed as an ISO 4217 code.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|external_id|query|string|false|Filter subscriptions by their external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|plan_code|query|string|false|The unique code representing the plan to be attached to the customer. This code must correspond to the code property of one of the active plans.|
|overridden|query|boolean|false|When set, filters subscriptions by whether their plan is an override of a parent plan. `true` returns only subscriptions on overridden plans; `false` returns only those on standard (non-overridden) plans.|
|status[]|query|[string]|false|If the field is not defined, Lago will return only `active` subscriptions. However, if you wish to fetch subscriptions by different status you can define them in a status[] query param. Available filter values: `pending`, `canceled`, `terminated`, `active`, `incomplete`.|
|billing_entity_codes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter subscriptions by billing entity codes. A code that does not match a billing entity of the organization returns a `404` error.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status[]|active|
|status[]|canceled|
|status[]|incomplete|
|status[]|pending|
|status[]|terminated|

> Example responses

`POST /subscriptions`

This endpoint assigns a plan to a customer, creating or modifying a subscription. Ideal for initial subscriptions or plan changes (upgrades/downgrades).

<h3 id="assign-a-plan-to-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SubscriptionCreateInput](#schemasubscriptioncreateinput)|true|Subscription payload|
|» authorization|body|object|false|Optionally, you can create a pre-authorization on the customer's card before creating a subscription. This process places a temporary hold (capture) for a specified amount on the customer's account, but does not actually withdraw the funds.<br><br>Important notes:<br>  - The final amount due for the subscription is not known at the time of creation; it is determined only after the invoice is finalized.<br>  - The payment intent generated for pre-authorization cannot be reused, as the final invoice amount may exceed the authorized amount.<br>  - The payment intent is canceled immediately after creation, but this cancellation occurs asynchronously.<br>  - For these reasons, it is recommended to use a small amount (such as $1) for pre-authorization. While this does not guarantee sufficient funds for the final payment, it helps reduce the likelihood of payment errors.<br>|
|» » amount_cents|body|integer|true|The amount of the authorization in cents.|
|» » amount_currency|body|string|true|The currency of the authorization.|
|» subscription|body|object|true|none|
|» » billing_entity_code|body|string|false|The code of the billing entity to be used for the subscription. If not provided, the default billing entity will be used.|
|» » external_customer_id|body|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|» » plan_code|body|string|true|The unique code representing the plan to be attached to the customer. This code must correspond to the `code` property of one of the active plans.|
|» » name|body|string|false|The display name of the subscription on an invoice. This field allows for customization of the subscription's name for billing purposes, especially useful when a single customer has multiple subscriptions using the same plan.|
|» » external_id|body|string|true|The unique external identifier for the subscription. This identifier serves as an idempotency key, ensuring that each subscription is unique.|
|» » billing_time|body|string|false|The billing time for the subscription, which can be set as either `anniversary` or `calendar`. If not explicitly provided, it will default to `calendar`. The billing time determines the timing of recurring billing cycles for the subscription. By specifying `anniversary`, the billing cycle will be based on the specific date the subscription started (billed fully), while `calendar` sets the billing cycle at the first day of the week/month/year (billed with proration).|
|» » ending_at|body|string(date-time)|false|The effective end date of the subscription. If this field is set to null, the subscription will automatically renew. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format, and use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|» » subscription_at|body|string(date-time)|false|The start date for the subscription, allowing for the creation of subscriptions that can begin in the past or future. Please note that it cannot be used to update the start date of a pending subscription or schedule an upgrade/downgrade. The start_date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|» » plan_overrides|body|[PlanOverridesObject](#schemaplanoverridesobject)|false|Overrides applied to the plan for this subscription. A units-only `fixed_charges` override is recorded as a per-subscription unit override without creating a plan override; any other override creates a plan override for the subscription. See `fixed_charges` for the exact rule.|
|» » invoice_custom_section|body|[InvoiceCustomSectionInput](#schemainvoicecustomsectioninput)|false|Configuration for invoice custom sections to apply to invoices generated by this resource.|
|» » payment_method|body|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|false|Optional payment method to use for processing subscription payments.|
|» » consolidate_invoice|body|boolean|false|Defines whether this subscription should be grouped with other subscriptions of the same customer when generating recurring invoices.<br><br>- `true` (default): the subscription is included in the customer's standard invoice grouping (by billing entity, currency and payment method).<br>- `false`: the subscription is excluded from consolidation and always billed on its own dedicated invoice.<br>|
|» » purchase_order_number|body|string \| null|false|The purchase order number associated with the subscription. It will be added to invoices generated for this subscription.|
|» » progressive_billing_disabled|body|boolean|false|Disables progressive billing for this subscription, regardless of any usage thresholds defined on the plan (including thresholds inherited from a parent plan when the subscription runs on a plan override).<br><br>Set to `true` to switch progressive billing off for this subscription specifically, without changing the plan's thresholds.<br>|
|» » usage_thresholds|body|[[UsageThresholdInput](#schemausagethresholdinput)]|false|Usage thresholds managed directly on the subscription. This is the recommended way to set progressive billing thresholds per subscription; when present, they take precedence over the thresholds defined on the plan.<br><br>This field cannot be combined with `plan_overrides.usage_thresholds` in the same request.<br>|
|» » activation_rules|body|[[SubscriptionActivationRuleInput](#schemasubscriptionactivationruleinput)]|false|Optional list of activation rules that gate the subscription activation. When a `payment` rule is provided and the plan is paid in advance (and the subscription is not in a trial), the subscription is created in the `incomplete` state and is only activated once the gating payment succeeds. If the payment fails or the rule's `timeout_hours` elapses, the subscription is canceled.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » billing_time|calendar|
|» » billing_time|anniversary|

<h3 id="assign-a-plan-to-a-customer-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Subscription created|[SubscriptionExtended](#schemasubscriptionextended)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request error|[ApiErrorBadRequest](#schemaapierrorbadrequest)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[ApiErrorForbidden](#schemaapierrorforbidden)|
|404|Not Found|Not Found error|[ApiErrorNotFound](#schemaapierrornotfound)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity error|[ApiErrorUnprocessableEntity](#schemaapierrorunprocessableentity)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Retrieve a subscription

<a id="opIdfindSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/subscriptions/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /subscriptions/{external_id}`

This endpoint retrieves a specific subscription.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|query|string|false|By default, this endpoint only returns `active` subscriptions. If you want to retrieve a subscription with a different `status`, you can specify it here.<br><br>_Note: As there may exist multiple `canceled` or `terminated` subscriptions for the same `external_id`, it is recommended to use the "List all subscriptions" endpoint to retrieve those subscriptions._<br>|
|external_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing subscription|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|terminated|
|status|pending|
|status|canceled|
|status|incomplete|

<h3 id="update-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|query|string|false|By default, this endpoint only updates `active` subscriptions. If you want to update a subscription with a different `status`, you can specify it here.<br>|
|external_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing subscription|
|body|body|[SubscriptionUpdateInput](#schemasubscriptionupdateinput)|true|Update an existing subscription|
|» status|body|string|false|If the field is not defined and multiple `active` and `pending` subscriptions exists, Lago will update the `active` subscription. However, if you wish to update a `pending` subscription, please ensure that you include the `status` attribute with the `pending` value in your request body.|
|» subscription|body|object|true|none|
|» » name|body|string \| null|false|The display name of the subscription on an invoice. This field allows for customization of the subscription's name for billing purposes, especially useful when a single customer has multiple subscriptions using the same plan.|
|» » ending_at|body|string \| null(date-time)|false|The effective end date of the subscription. If this field is set to null, the subscription will automatically renew. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format, and use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|» » subscription_at|body|string(date-time)|false|The start date and time of the subscription. This field can only be modified for pending subscriptions that have not yet started. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|» » plan_overrides|body|[PlanOverridesObject](#schemaplanoverridesobject)|false|Overrides applied to the plan for this subscription. A units-only `fixed_charges` override is recorded as a per-subscription unit override without creating a plan override; any other override creates a plan override for the subscription. See `fixed_charges` for the exact rule.|
|» » invoice_custom_section|body|[InvoiceCustomSectionInput](#schemainvoicecustomsectioninput)|false|Configuration for invoice custom sections to apply to invoices generated by this resource.|
|» » payment_method|body|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|false|Optional payment method to use for processing subscription payments.|
|» » consolidate_invoice|body|boolean|false|Defines whether this subscription should be grouped with other subscriptions of the same customer when generating recurring invoices.<br><br>- `true`: the subscription is included in the customer's standard invoice grouping (by billing entity, currency and payment method).<br>- `false`: the subscription is excluded from consolidation and always billed on its own dedicated invoice.<br>|
|» » billing_entity_code|body|string|false|The code of the billing entity associated with the subscription. Updates take effect on future invoices only.|
|» » on_termination_credit_note|body|string|false|Sets the default credit note behaviour applied when this subscription is later terminated before the end of its billing period:<br><br>- `credit`: a credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. The unused amount is credited back to the customer.<br>- `refund`: a credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. If the invoice is paid or partially paid, the unused paid amount is refunded; any unpaid unused amount is credited back to the customer.<br>- `offset`: a credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. If the invoice is paid or partially paid, the unused paid amount is refunded; any unpaid unused amount is applied to the invoice reducing its amount due.<br>- `skip`: no credit note is generated for the unused subscription time.<br><br>_Note: This field is only applied to pay-in-advance plans and is ignored for pay-in-arrears plans._<br>|
|» » on_termination_invoice|body|string|false|Sets the default invoice behaviour applied when this subscription is later terminated before the end of its billing period:<br><br>- `generate`: an invoice is generated for the unbilled usage.<br>- `skip`: no invoice is generated for the unbilled usage.<br>|
|» » purchase_order_number|body|string \| null|false|The purchase order number associated with the subscription. It will be added to invoices generated for this subscription.|
|» » progressive_billing_disabled|body|boolean|false|Disables progressive billing for this subscription, regardless of any usage thresholds defined on the plan (including thresholds inherited from a parent plan when the subscription runs on a plan override).<br><br>Set to `true` to switch progressive billing off for this subscription specifically. This is the recommended way to stop progressive billing on a subscription that inherits thresholds from its plan, since clearing `usage_thresholds` only removes subscription-level thresholds and does not remove those defined on (or inherited from) the plan.<br>|
|» » usage_thresholds|body|[[UsageThresholdInput](#schemausagethresholdinput)]|false|Usage thresholds managed directly on the subscription. This is the recommended way to set progressive billing thresholds per subscription; when present, they take precedence over the thresholds defined on the plan.<br><br>Sending an empty array removes all subscription-level thresholds. This field cannot be combined with `plan_overrides.usage_thresholds` in the same request. To fully disable progressive billing on a subscription that inherits thresholds from its plan, use `progressive_billing_disabled` instead.<br>|
|» » activation_rules|body|[[SubscriptionActivationRuleInput](#schemasubscriptionactivationruleinput)]|false|Optional list of activation rules that gate the subscription activation. Activation rules can only be set or modified while the subscription is `pending` (future-dated and not yet activated); the request is rejected for `incomplete`, `active`, or `terminated` subscriptions.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|pending|
|» status|active|
|» status|pending|
|» » on_termination_credit_note|credit|
|» » on_termination_credit_note|refund|
|» » on_termination_credit_note|offset|
|» » on_termination_credit_note|skip|
|» » on_termination_invoice|generate|
|» » on_termination_invoice|skip|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Subscription updated|[SubscriptionExtended](#schemasubscriptionextended)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request error|[ApiErrorBadRequest](#schemaapierrorbadrequest)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[ApiErrorForbidden](#schemaapierrorforbidden)|

bearerAuth

## Terminate a subscription

<a id="opIddestroySubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/subscriptions/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /subscriptions/{external_id}`

This endpoint allows you to terminate a subscription.

<h3 id="terminate-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|query|string|false|Selects which subscription to terminate for the given `external_id`, based on its status. If the field is not defined, Lago targets only `active` subscriptions.<br><br>- `pending`: cancel a subscription scheduled for a future activation (include `status=pending`).<br>- `incomplete`: cancel a payment-gated subscription that is still awaiting its activation payment (include `status=incomplete`). The subscription is canceled with `cancellation_reason: manual`, its invoice is closed and nothing is billed, and any pending payment is canceled on a best-effort basis with the payment provider (some provider statuses cannot be canceled). Applied coupons, credit notes and wallet credits are recredited. Termination behaviours (`on_termination_credit_note`, `on_termination_invoice`) are ignored, as an incomplete subscription has never been billed.<br>|
|on_termination_credit_note|query|string|false|When a pay-in-advance subscription is terminated before the end of its billing period, we generate a credit note for the unused subscription time by default.<br>This field allows you to control the behavior of the credit note generation:<br><br>- `credit`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. The unused amount is credited back to the customer.<br>- `refund`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. If the invoice is paid or partially paid, the unused paid amount is refunded; any unpaid unused amount is credited back to the customer.<br>- `offset`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. If the invoice is paid or partially paid, the unused paid amount is refunded; any unpaid unused amount is applied to the invoice reducing its amount due.<br>- `skip`: No credit note is generated for the unused subscription time.<br><br>_Note: This field is only applicable to pay-in-advance plans and is ignored for pay-in-arrears plans._<br>|
|on_termination_invoice|query|string|false|When a subscription is terminated before the end of its billing period, we generate an invoice for the unbilled usage.<br>This field allows you to control the behavior of the invoice generation:<br><br>- `generate`: An invoice is generated for the unbilled usage.<br>- `skip`: No invoice is generated for the unbilled usage.<br>|
|external_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing subscription|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|on_termination_credit_note|credit|
|on_termination_credit_note|refund|
|on_termination_credit_note|offset|
|on_termination_credit_note|skip|
|on_termination_invoice|generate|
|on_termination_invoice|skip|

## Update a subscription lifetime usage

<a id="opIdupdateSubscriptionLifetimeUsage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/subscriptions/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/lifetime_usage \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "lifetime_usage": {
      "external_historical_usage_amount_cents": 100
    }
  }'
```

## List subscription alerts

<a id="opIdgetSubscriptionAlerts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/subscriptions/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/alerts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /subscriptions/{external_id}/alerts`

This endpoint enables the retrieval of all alerts for a subscription.

<h3 id="list-subscription-alerts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscription_status|query|string|false|Filter by subscription status. When provided, the subscription is looked up with this status instead of the default `active` status. Possible values are `pending`, `active`, `terminated`, `canceled`, or `incomplete`.<br>|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|external_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing subscription|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|subscription_status|pending|
|subscription_status|active|
|subscription_status|terminated|
|subscription_status|canceled|
|subscription_status|incomplete|

## Create subscription alert(s)

<a id="opIdcreateSubscriptionAlert"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/subscriptions/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/alerts \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "alert": {
      "code": "storage_threshold_alert",
      "name": "Storage Usage Alert",
      "thresholds": [
        {
          "code": "warn",
          "notify_on": [
            "triggered",
            "resolved"
          ],
          "recurring": false,
          "value": 99
        }
      ],
      "alert_type": "billable_metric_current_usage_amount",
      "billable_metric_code": "storage_usage"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /subscriptions/{external_id}/alerts`

This endpoint allows you to create alerts for a subscription. Send a single alert object wrapped in `alert` key to create one alert, or an array of alert objects wrapped in `alerts` key to create multiple alerts atomically.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "alert": {
    "code": "storage_threshold_alert",
    "name": "Storage Usage Alert",
    "thresholds": [
      {
        "code": "warn",
        "notify_on": [
          "triggered",
          "resolved"
        ],
        "recurring": false,
        "value": 99
      }
    ],
    "alert_type": "billable_metric_current_usage_amount",
    "billable_metric_code": "storage_usage"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-subscription-alerts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscription_status|query|string|false|Filter by subscription status. When provided, the subscription is looked up with this status instead of the default `active` status. Possible values are `pending`, `active`, `terminated`, `canceled`, or `incomplete`.<br>|
|external_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing subscription|
|body|body|[AlertCreateInput](#schemaalertcreateinput) \| [AlertBatchCreateInput](#schemaalertbatchcreateinput)|true|Create one or more alerts for a subscription|

## Update a subscription alert

<a id="opIdupdateSubscriptionAlert"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/subscriptions/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/alerts/storage_threshold_alert \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "alert": {
      "code": "storage_threshold_alert",
      "name": "Storage Usage Alert",
      "thresholds": [
        {
          "code": "warn",
          "notify_on": [
            "triggered",
            "resolved"
          ],
          "recurring": false,
          "value": 99
        }
      ],
      "billable_metric_code": "storage_usage"
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /subscriptions/{external_id}/alerts/{code}`

This endpoint allows you to update an existing alert for a subscription. A non-empty `thresholds` array replaces the whole set of thresholds on the alert. When `thresholds` is left out, or sent as an empty array, the thresholds already on the alert are kept. A threshold sent with a `code` it already had, and without `notify_on`, keeps the `notify_on` it had.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "alert": {
    "code": "storage_threshold_alert",
    "name": "Storage Usage Alert",
    "thresholds": [
      {
        "code": "warn",
        "notify_on": [
          "triggered",
          "resolved"
        ],
        "recurring": false,
        "value": 99
      }
    ],
    "billable_metric_code": "storage_usage"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-subscription-alert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscription_status|query|string|false|Filter by subscription status. When provided, the subscription is looked up with this status instead of the default `active` status. Possible values are `pending`, `active`, `terminated`, `canceled`, or `incomplete`.<br>|
|external_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing subscription|
|code|path|string|true|Unique code of the alert|
|body|body|[AlertUpdateInput](#schemaalertupdateinput)|true|Update an existing alert for a subscription|
|» alert|body|object|true|none|
|» » code|body|string|false|Unique code used to identify the alert.|
|» » name|body|string \| null|false|The name of the alert.|
|» » thresholds|body|[[AlertThresholdInput](#schemaalertthresholdinput)]|false|Array of thresholds associated with the alert. An alert accepts at most 20 thresholds, and a larger array returns a `422` error with `too_many_thresholds` on `thresholds`. Two thresholds cannot share the same value and the same `recurring` flag. The value of a recurring threshold must be positive.|
|» » billable_metric_code|body|string \| null|false|The code of the billable metric associated with the alert. Only for alerts based on a billable metric.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|subscription_status|pending|
|subscription_status|active|
|subscription_status|terminated|
|subscription_status|canceled|
|subscription_status|incomplete|

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /subscriptions/{external_id}/fixed_charges`

This endpoint retrieves all effective fixed charges for a specific subscription.
The `units` of each fixed charge reflect any per-subscription unit override applied to the subscription; when no override exists, the plan-level units are returned.

<h3 id="list-all-fixed-charges-for-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|subscription_status|query|string|false|Filter by subscription status. When provided, the subscription is looked up with this status instead of the default `active` status. Possible values are `pending`, `active`, `terminated`, `canceled`, or `incomplete`.<br>|
|external_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing subscription.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|

|subscription_status|pending|

|subscription_status|terminated|
|subscription_status|canceled|
|subscription_status|incomplete|

`PUT /subscriptions/{external_id}/charges/{charge_code}`

This endpoint creates or updates a charge override for a specific subscription.
If the subscription does not have a plan override yet, one will be created automatically.
The charge override allows customizing specific charge properties (invoice_display_name, min_amount_cents, properties, filters, taxes, applied_pricing_unit) without affecting the original plan charge.
This is a premium feature.

`GET /subscriptions/{external_id}/fixed_charges/{fixed_charge_code}`

`PUT /subscriptions/{external_id}/fixed_charges/{fixed_charge_code}`

This endpoint creates or updates a fixed charge override for a subscription, without affecting the original plan fixed charge.
When the body contains only `units` (and optionally `apply_units_immediately`), the change is recorded as a per-subscription unit override. When the body also sets `invoice_display_name`, `properties`, or `tax_codes`, it is applied as a full plan override for the subscription instead.
With `apply_units_immediately: true` on a pay-in-advance fixed charge the change is billed mid-period; otherwise it takes effect at the next billing period.
This is a premium feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "fixed_charge": {
    "invoice_display_name": "Setup Fee",
    "units": "1.0",
    "apply_units_immediately": false,
    "properties": {
      "grouped_by": [
        "agent_name"
      ],
      "pricing_group_keys": [
        "agent_name"
      ],
      "graduated_ranges": [
        {
          "from_value": 0,
          "to_value": 10,
          "flat_amount": "10",
          "per_unit_amount": "0.5"
        }
      ],
      "graduated_percentage_ranges": [
        {
          "from_value": 0,
          "to_value": 10,
          "rate": "1",
          "flat_amount": "10"
        }
      ],
      "amount": "30",
      "free_units": 100,
      "package_size": 1000,
      "rate": "1",
      "fixed_amount": "0.5",
      "free_units_per_events": 5,
      "free_units_per_total_aggregation": "500",
      "per_transaction_max_amount": "3.75",
      "per_transaction_min_amount": "1.75",
      "volume_ranges": [
        {
          "from_value": 0,
          "to_value": 10,
          "flat_amount": "10",
          "per_unit_amount": "0.5"
        }
      ]
    },
    "tax_codes": [
      "french_standard_vat"
    ]
  }
}
```

|subscription_status|query|string|false|Filter by subscription status. When provided, the subscription is looked up with this status instead of the default `active` status. Possible values are `pending`, `active`, `terminated`, `canceled`, or `incomplete`.<br>|
|external_id|path|string|true|External ID of the existing subscription.|
|fixed_charge_code|path|string|true|Code of the existing fixed charge.|
|body|body|[SubscriptionFixedChargeOverride](#schemasubscriptionfixedchargeoverride)|true|Fixed charge override payload|
|» fixed_charge|body|[FixedChargeOverridableInput](#schemafixedchargeoverridableinput)|true|Properties of a fixed charge that can be overridden at the subscription level.|

## List all events

`GET /events`

This endpoint is used for retrieving all events.

<h3 id="list-all-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|external_subscription_id|query|string|false|External subscription ID|
|code|query|string|false|Filter events by code.|
|timestamp_from_started_at|query|boolean|false|Requires `external_subscription_id` to be set, and cannot be combined with `timestamp_from`. Filter events by timestamp after the subscription started at datetime.|
|timestamp_from|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter events by timestamp starting from a specific date.|
|timestamp_to|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter events by timestamp up to a specific date.|

## Estimate fees for a pay in advance charge

<a id="opIdeventEstimateFees"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/events/estimate_fees \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "event": {
      "code": "storage",
      "external_subscription_id": "sub_1234567890",
      "precise_total_amount_cents": "1234.56",
      "properties": {
        "target_wallet_code": "main_wallet"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /events/estimate_fees`

Estimate the fees that would be created after reception of an event for a billable metric attached to one or multiple pay in advance charges

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "event": {
    "code": "storage",
    "external_subscription_id": "sub_1234567890",
    "precise_total_amount_cents": "1234.56",
    "properties": {
      "target_wallet_code": "main_wallet"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="estimate-fees-for-a-pay-in-advance-charge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[EventEstimateFeesInput](#schemaeventestimatefeesinput)|true|Event estimate payload|
|» event|body|object|true|none|
|» » code|body|string|true|The code that identifies a targeted billable metric. It is essential that this code matches the `code` property of one of your active billable metrics. If the provided code does not correspond to any active billable metric, it will be ignored during the process.|
|» » external_subscription_id|body|string|true|The unique identifier of the subscription within your application.|
|» » precise_total_amount_cents|body|string \| null|false|The precise total amount in cents with precision used by the `dynamic` pricing model to compute the estimated usage amount. Defaults to `0` when omitted.|
|» » properties|body|object|false|This field represents additional properties associated with the event, which are utilized in the calculation of the final fee. This object becomes mandatory when the targeted billable metric employs a `sum_agg`, `max_agg`, or `unique_count_agg` aggregation method. However, when using a simple `count_agg`, this object is not required. Any property of the targeted billable metric can be sent here, in addition to the documented fields below.|
|» » » target_wallet_code|body|string \| null|false|The code of the wallet targeted by this event for prepaid credits deduction.<br>When provided, credits are drawn from this specific wallet instead of following the standard wallet selection logic.<br>If the code does not match an existing wallet, no credits will be applied for the event.<br>This field is only taken into account when the targeted charge has `accepts_target_wallet` set to `true`.<br>This field requires a premium integration.|

```json
    {
```

## Retrieve a specific event

<a id="opIdfindEvent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/events/transaction_1234567890 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /events/{transaction_id}`

This endpoint is used for retrieving a specific usage measurement event that has been sent to a subscription.

Note that transaction_id is unique per external_subscription_id so multiple subscriptions can share the same transaction_id. This endpoint will only return the first event found with the given transaction_id.

WARNING: If your Lago organization is configured to use the Clickhouse-based event pipeline, multiple events can share the same `transaction_id` (with different timestamps). This endpoint will only return the first event found.


<h3 id="retrieve-a-specific-event-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|transaction_id|path|string|true|This field represents the unique identifier sent for this specific event (must be URL encoded).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "event": {
    "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "transaction_id": "transaction_1234567890",
    "lago_customer_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "code": "storage",
    "timestamp": "2022-04-29T08:59:51.123Z",
    "precise_total_amount_cents": "1234.56",
    "properties": {
      "gb": 10
    },
    "lago_subscription_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "external_subscription_id": "sub_1234567890",
    "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z"
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

```json
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "Forbidden",
  "code": "feature_unavailable"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "status": 404,
  "error": "Not Found",
  "code": "object_not_found"
```
```json
}
```

<h3 id="update-your-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|» organization|body|object|true|none|
|» » webhook_url|body|string|false|Sets the URL of the first webhook endpoint of your organization. This URL allows your organization to receive important messages, notifications, or data from the Lago system. When your organization has no webhook endpoint yet, this creates one.|
|» » country|body|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|false|The country of your organization.|
|» » default_currency|body|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|false|The default currency of an organization.|
|» » address_line1|body|string \| null|false|The first line of your organization's billing address.|
|» » address_line2|body|string \| null|false|The second line of your organization's billing address.|
|» » state|body|string \| null|false|The state of your organization's billing address.|
|» » zipcode|body|string \| null|false|The zipcode of your organization's billing address.|
|» » email|body|string \| null(email)|false|The email address of your organization used to bill your customers.|
|» » city|body|string \| null|false|The city of your organization's billing address.|
|» » legal_name|body|string \| null|false|The legal name of your organization.|
|» » legal_number|body|string \| null|false|The legal number of your organization.|
|» » document_numbering|body|string|false|This parameter configures the method of incrementing invoice numbers for your customers.<br><br>- `per_customer`: Invoice numbers are incremented individually for each customer. This means every customer will have their own unique sequence of invoice numbers, separate from other customers. It ensures that each customer's invoice numbers follow a distinct and isolated numbering pattern.<br>- `per_organization`: Invoice number incrementation is made across your entire organization. Rather than individual sequences for each customer, all invoices within the organization follow a single, unified numbering system. This creates a continuous and organization-wide sequence for all invoice numbers. Invoices are incremented per month (dynamic value used is YYYYMM), and invoice numbers are reset at the end of each month.<br><br>The default value for `document_numbering` is set to `per_customer`, meaning that, unless changed, invoice numbers will increment uniquely for each customer.|
|» » document_number_prefix|body|string|false|Sets the prefix for invoices and credit notes. Default is the first three letters of your organization name plus the last four characters of your organization ID. Customizable within 1-10 characters, and automatically capitalized by Lago.|
|» » net_payment_term|body|integer|false|The net payment term, expressed in days, specifies the duration within which a customer is expected to remit payment after the invoice is finalized.|
|» » tax_identification_number|body|string \| null|false|The tax identification number of your organization.|
|» » timezone|body|[Timezone](#schematimezone)|false|Your organization's timezone, used for billing purposes in your own local time. Can be overwritten by the customer's timezone. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » email_settings|body|[string]|false|Represents the email settings of the organization. It allows you to define which documents are sent by email. The field value determines the types of documents that trigger email notifications. Possible values are `invoice.finalized`, `credit_note.created` and `payment_receipt.created`. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|» » billing_configuration|body|[OrganizationBillingConfiguration](#schemaorganizationbillingconfiguration)|false|The custom billing settings for your organization.|
|» » finalize_zero_amount_invoice|body|boolean|false|Determines whether invoices with a zero total amount should be finalized. If set to true, zero amount invoices will be finalized. If set to false, zero amount invoices will not be finalized.|
|» » slug|body|string|false|A concise and unique identifier for your organization. It must contain between 3 and 40 characters, limited to lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and it must start and end with a letter or a digit. Lago trims it and converts it to lowercase before saving it. A value already taken by another organization, or one of the names Lago reserves for its own routes, is rejected.|

<h1 id="lago-api-documentation-taxes">taxes</h1>

Everything about Tax collection

<a href="https://getlago.com/docs/api-reference/taxes/tax-object">Find out more</a>

## List all taxes

<a id="opIdfindAllTaxes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/taxes \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /taxes`

This endpoint retrieves all existing taxes representing a customizable tax rate applicable to either a billing entity or a specific customer.

<h3 id="list-all-taxes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
```

## List all applied coupons

<a id="opIdfindAllAppliedCoupons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/applied_coupons \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /applied_coupons`

This endpoint is used to list all applied coupons. You can filter by coupon status and by customer.

<h3 id="list-all-applied-coupons-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|status|query|string|false|The status of the coupon. Can be either `active` or `terminated`.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|coupon_code[]|query|[string]|false|The code of the coupon applied to the customer. Use it to filter applied coupons by their code.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|terminated|

## Apply a coupon to a customer

<a id="opIdapplyCoupon"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/applied_coupons \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "applied_coupon": {
      "external_customer_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
      "coupon_code": "startup_deal",
      "frequency": "recurring",
      "frequency_duration": 3,
      "amount_cents": 2000,
      "amount_currency": "EUR",
      "percentage_rate": null
    }
  }'
```

`POST /applied_coupons`

This endpoint is used to apply a specific coupon to a customer, before or during a subscription.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "applied_coupon": {
    "external_customer_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
    "coupon_code": "startup_deal",
    "frequency": "recurring",
    "frequency_duration": 3,
    "amount_cents": 2000,
    "amount_currency": "EUR",
    "percentage_rate": null
  }
}
```

<h3 id="apply-a-coupon-to-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AppliedCouponInput](#schemaappliedcouponinput)|true|Apply coupon payload|
|» applied_coupon|body|object|true|none|
|» » external_customer_id|body|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|» » coupon_code|body|string|true|Unique code used to identify the coupon.|
|» » frequency|body|string \| null|false|The type of frequency for the coupon. It can have three possible values: `once`, `recurring` or `forever`.<br><br>- If set to `once`, the coupon is applicable only for a single use.<br>- If set to `recurring`, the coupon can be used multiple times for recurring billing periods.<br>- If set to `forever`, the coupon has unlimited usage and can be applied indefinitely.<br><br>If it is not set, the frequency of the coupon is used.|
|» » frequency_duration|body|integer \| null|false|The number of billing periods to which the coupon applies. If it is not set, the frequency duration of the coupon is used. A `recurring` applied coupon must end up with a frequency duration greater than 0.|
|» » amount_cents|body|integer \| null|false|The amount of the coupon in cents. If it is not set, the amount of the coupon is used.|
|» » amount_currency|body|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|false|The currency of the coupon amount. If it is not set, the currency of the coupon is used.|
|» » percentage_rate|body|string \| null|false|The percentage rate of the coupon. If it is not set, the percentage rate of the coupon is used.|
