## Top up a wallet

<a id="opIdcreateWalletTransaction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/wallet_transactions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "wallet_transaction": {
      "wallet_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
      "name": "Tokens for models '\''high-fidelity-boost'\''",
      "paid_credits": "20.0",
      "granted_credits": "10.0",
      "voided_credits": "5.0",
      "voided_transaction_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
      "priority": 50,
      "invoice_requires_successful_payment": false,
      "ignore_paid_top_up_limits": false,
      "purchase_order_number": "PO-123",
      "invoice_custom_section": {
        "skip_invoice_custom_sections": false,
        "invoice_custom_section_codes": [
          "eu_bank_details"
        ]
      },
      "payment_method": {
        "payment_method_type": "provider",
        "payment_method_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
      },
      "metadata": [
        {
          "key": "example key",
          "value": "example value"
        },
        {
          "key": "another key",
          "value": "another value"
        }
      ]
    }
  }'
```

`POST /wallet_transactions`

This endpoint is used to top-up an active wallet.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "wallet_transaction": {
    "wallet_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "name": "Tokens for models 'high-fidelity-boost'",
    "paid_credits": "20.0",
    "granted_credits": "10.0",
    "voided_credits": "5.0",
    "voided_transaction_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "priority": 50,
    "invoice_requires_successful_payment": false,
    "ignore_paid_top_up_limits": false,
    "purchase_order_number": "PO-123",
    "invoice_custom_section": {
      "skip_invoice_custom_sections": false,
      "invoice_custom_section_codes": [
        "eu_bank_details"
      ]
    },
    "payment_method": {
      "payment_method_type": "provider",
      "payment_method_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
    },
    "metadata": [
      {
        "key": "example key",
        "value": "example value"
      },
      {
        "key": "another key",
        "value": "another value"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<h3 id="top-up-a-wallet-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[WalletTransactionCreateInput](#schemawallettransactioncreateinput)|true|Wallet transaction payload|
|» wallet_transaction|body|object|true|none|
|» » wallet_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the wallet within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the wallet's record within the Lago system.|
|» » name|body|string \| null|false|The name of the wallet transaction. It will appear on the invoice as the label for the fee. If not set, the label on the invoice will fallback to either `Prepaid credits - {{wallet_name}}` if the wallet name is set, or `Prepaid credits`.<br><br>Note that this name will apply to all transactions (`paid_credits`, `granted_credits` and `voided_credits`) created by this action.<br>|
|» » paid_credits|body|string \| null|false|The number of paid credits.|
|» » granted_credits|body|string \| null|false|The number of free granted credits.|
|» » voided_credits|body|string \| null|false|The number of voided credits.|
|» » voided_transaction_id|body|string \| null(uuid)|false|Unique identifier of the inbound wallet transaction to void. Only available on traceable wallets, and the target transaction must still have a remaining amount.|
|» » priority|body|integer|false|The priority of the wallet transaction. It drives the order in which credits are consumed. Allowed values: 1-50, where 1 is highest priority and 50 is lowest. Defaults to 50.|
|» » invoice_requires_successful_payment|body|boolean|false|A boolean setting that, when set to true, delays issuing an invoice for a wallet top-up until a successful payment is made; if false, the invoice is issued immediately upon wallet top-up, regardless of the payment status. Default value of false.|
|» » ignore_paid_top_up_limits|body|boolean|false|When true, allows topping up the wallet with transactions that exceed the paid top-up limits. Defaults to false.|
|» » purchase_order_number|body|string \| null|false|The purchase order number associated with this wallet transaction. It will be added to invoices generated for the resulting wallet top-up. If not set, falls back to the wallet's `purchase_order_number`.|
|» » invoice_custom_section|body|[InvoiceCustomSectionInput](#schemainvoicecustomsectioninput)|false|Configuration for invoice custom sections to apply to invoices generated by this resource.|
|» » payment_method|body|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|false|Optional payment method to use for processing the wallet transaction payment.|
|» » metadata|body|[object]|false|This optional field allows you to store a list of key-value pairs that hold additional information or custom attributes related to the data.|
|» » » key|body|string|false|The unique identifier for the attribute.|
|» » » value|body|string|false|The value associated with the key.|

## List all consumptions for a wallet transaction

<a id="opIdfindAllWalletTransactionConsumptions"></a>

> Code samples


`GET /wallet_transactions/{lago_id}/consumptions`

This endpoint is used to list all consumption records for an inbound wallet transaction. It shows how the credits from this inbound transaction were consumed by outbound transactions. Only available for traceable wallets.

<h3 id="list-all-consumptions-for-a-wallet-transaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|

## List all wallet transactions

<a id="opIdfindAllWalletTransactions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/wallets/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/wallet_transactions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /wallets/{lago_id}/wallet_transactions`

This endpoint is used to list all wallet transactions.

<h3 id="list-all-wallet-transactions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the wallet within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the wallet's record within the Lago system.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|status|query|string|false|The status of the wallet transaction. Possible values are `pending`, `settled` or `failed`.|
|transaction_status|query|string|false|The transaction status of the wallet transaction. Possible values are `purchased` (with pending or settled status), `granted` (without invoice_id), `voided` or `invoiced`.|
|transaction_type|query|string|false|The transaction type of the wallet transaction. Possible values are `inbound` (increasing the wallet balance) or `outbound` (decreasing the wallet balance).|
|metadata[key]|query|string|false|Filter wallet transactions by metadata. Replace `key` with the actual metadata key you want to match, and provide the corresponding value. For example, `metadata[color]=blue`.|

## List all credit notes

<a id="opIdfindAllCreditNotes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/credit_notes \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /credit_notes`

This endpoint lists all existing credit notes.

<h3 id="list-all-credit-notes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|Unique identifier assigned to the customer in your application.|
|issuing_date_from|query|string(date)|false|Filter credit notes starting from a specific date.|
|issuing_date_to|query|string(date)|false|Filter credit notes up to a specific date.|
|search_term|query|string|false|Search credit notes by id, number, customer name, customer external_id or customer email.|
|currency|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by currency. Possible values ISO 4217 currency codes.|
|reason|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by reasons. Possible values are `product_unsatisfactory`, `order_change`, `order_cancellation`, `fraudulent_charge`, `duplicated_charge` or `other`.|
|credit_status|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by credit status. Possible values are `available`, `consumed` or `voided`.|
|refund_status|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by refund status. Possible values are `pending`, `succeeded` or `failed`.|
|invoice_number|query|string|false|Filter credit notes by their related invoice number.|
|purchase_order_number|query|string|false|Filter by the invoice purchase order number. The match is exact but case-insensitive.|
|amount_from|query|integer|false|Filter credit notes of at least a specific amount. This parameter must be defined in cents to ensure consistent handling for all currency types.|
|amount_to|query|integer|false|Filter credit notes up to a specific amount. This parameter must be defined in cents to ensure consistent handling for all currency types.|
|types[]|query|[string]|false|Filter credit notes by the kind of amount they carry. `credit` matches credit notes with a credited amount, `refund` those with a refunded amount and `offset` those with an amount deducted from the invoice balance. A credit note can match several types.|
|self_billed|query|boolean|false|Filter credit notes belonging to a self billed invoice. Possible values are `true` or `false`.|
|billing_entity_codes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter credit notes by billing entity codes.|

## Create a credit note

<a id="opIdcreateCreditNote"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/credit_notes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "credit_note": {
      "invoice_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
      "reason": "duplicated_charge",
      "description": "description",
      "credit_amount_cents": 100,
      "refund_amount_cents": 500,
      "offset_amount_cents": 200,
      "items": [
        {
          "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
          "amount_cents": 100
        },
        {
          "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a91",
          "amount_cents": 500
        },
        {
          "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a92",
          "amount_cents": 200
        }
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "external_id": "ext-123",
        "synced_at": "2024-01-15"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /credit_notes`

This endpoint creates a new credit note.
This is a premium feature.
A credit note cannot be issued on an invoice in a `pending` or `failed` status. In that case the endpoint returns a `405` error with the `invalid_type_or_status` code.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "credit_note": {
    "invoice_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "reason": "duplicated_charge",
    "description": "description",
    "credit_amount_cents": 100,
    "refund_amount_cents": 500,
    "offset_amount_cents": 200,
    "items": [
      {
        "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
        "amount_cents": 100
      },
      {
        "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a91",
        "amount_cents": 500
      },
      {
        "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a92",
        "amount_cents": 200
      }
    ],
    "metadata": {
      "external_id": "ext-123",
      "synced_at": "2024-01-15"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-credit-note-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreditNoteCreateInput](#schemacreditnotecreateinput)|true|Credit note payload|
|» credit_note|body|object|true|none|
|» » invoice_id|body|string(uuid)|true|The invoice unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|» » reason|body|string \| null|false|The reason of the credit note creation.<br>Possible values are `duplicated_charge`, `product_unsatisfactory`, `order_change`, `order_cancellation`, `fraudulent_charge` or `other`.|
|» » description|body|string|false|The description of the credit note.|
|» » credit_amount_cents|body|integer \| null|false|The total amount to be credited to the customer balance for discounts on future invoices. For a total or partial refund, credit or offset, the amount in cents must include both the item amount and the applicable tax. The refunded, credited and offsetted amounts should always balance. The total, including taxes, cannot exceed the invoice's total fees.|
|» » refund_amount_cents|body|integer \| null|false|The total amount to be refunded immediately to the payment method used by the customer. For a total or partial refund, credit or offset, the amount in cents must include both the item amount and the applicable tax. The refunded, credited and offsetted amounts should always balance. The total, including taxes, cannot exceed the invoice's total fees.|
|» » offset_amount_cents|body|integer \| null|false|The total amount to be immediately deducted from the invoice balance. For a total or partial refund, credit or offset, the amount in cents must include both the item amount and the applicable tax. The refunded, credited and offsetted amounts should always balance. The total, including taxes, cannot exceed the invoice's total fees.|
|» » items|body|[object]|true|The list of credit note's items.|
|» » » fee_id|body|string(uuid)|true|The fee unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|» » » amount_cents|body|integer|true|This is the amount of the credit note item excluding taxes, expressed in cents.|
|» » metadata|body|[MetadataInput](#schemametadatainput)|false|Metadata to set as key-value pairs. Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » reason|duplicated_charge|
|» » reason|product_unsatisfactory|
|» » reason|order_change|
|» » reason|order_cancellation|
|» » reason|fraudulent_charge|
|» » reason|other|
|» » reason|null|

## Update a credit note

<a id="opIdupdateCreditNote"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/credit_notes/12345 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "credit_note": {
      "refund_status": "succeeded",
      "metadata": {
        "external_id": "ext-123",
        "synced_at": "2024-01-15"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /credit_notes/{lago_id}`

This endpoint updates an existing credit note.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "credit_note": {
    "refund_status": "succeeded",
    "metadata": {
      "external_id": "ext-123",
      "synced_at": "2024-01-15"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-credit-note-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string|true|The credit note unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|body|body|[CreditNoteUpdateInput](#schemacreditnoteupdateinput)|true|Credit note update payload|
|» credit_note|body|object|true|none|
|» » refund_status|body|string|false|The status of the refund portion of the credit note. It indicates the current state or condition of the refund associated with the credit note. The possible values for this field are:<br><br>- `pending`: this status indicates that the refund is pending execution. The refund request has been initiated but has not been processed or completed yet.<br>- `succeeded`: this status indicates that the refund has been successfully executed. The refund amount has been processed and returned to the customer or the designated recipient.<br>- `failed`: this status indicates that the refund failed to execute. The refund request encountered an error or unsuccessful processing, and the refund amount could not be returned.|
|» » metadata|body|[MetadataInput](#schemametadatainput)|false|Metadata to set as key-value pairs. Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » refund_status|pending|
|» » refund_status|succeeded|
|» » refund_status|failed|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "credit_note": {
    "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Credit note updated|[CreditNoteExtended](#schemacreditnoteextended)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request error|[ApiErrorBadRequest](#schemaapierrorbadrequest)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized error|[ApiErrorUnauthorized](#schemaapierrorunauthorized)|

|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity error|[ApiErrorUnprocessableEntity](#schemaapierrorunprocessableentity)|

## Download a credit note PDF

<a id="opIddownloadCreditNote"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/credit_notes/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/download \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /credit_notes/{lago_id}/download`

This endpoint downloads the PDF of an existing credit note. Only `finalized` credit notes can be downloaded; any other credit note returns a `404` error.
When the PDF has already been generated, the credit note object is returned and its `file_url` points to the document. When it has not been generated yet, the response is a `200` with an empty body and the generation starts in the background. Call the endpoint again to get the credit note object with its `file_url`.

<h3 id="download-a-credit-note-pdf-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The credit note unique identifier, created by Lago.|

## Estimate amounts for a new credit note

<a id="opIdestimateCreditNote"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/credit_notes/estimate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "credit_note": {
      "invoice_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
      "items": [
        {
          "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
          "amount_cents": 10
        },
        {
          "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a91",
          "amount_cents": 5
        }
      ]
    }
  }'
```

`POST /credit_notes/estimate`

This endpoint allows you to retrieve amounts for a new credit note creation.
This is a premium feature.
Amounts cannot be estimated on an invoice in a `pending` or `failed` status. In that case the endpoint returns a `405` error with the `invalid_type_or_status` code.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "credit_note": {
    "invoice_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "items": [
      {
        "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
        "amount_cents": 10
      },
      {
        "fee_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a91",
        "amount_cents": 5
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<h3 id="estimate-amounts-for-a-new-credit-note-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreditNoteEstimateInput](#schemacreditnoteestimateinput)|true|Credit note estimate payload|
|» credit_note|body|object|true|none|
|» » invoice_id|body|string(uuid)|true|The invoice unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|» » items|body|[object]|true|The list of credit note's items.|
|» » » fee_id|body|string(uuid)|true|The fee unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|» » » amount_cents|body|integer|true|The amount of the credit note item, expressed in cents.|

## Replace credit note metadata

<a id="opIdreplaceCreditNoteMetadata"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/credit_notes/1f615414-ceb0-11f0-94bf-0f2d5b311aba/metadata \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "metadata": {
      "external_id": "ext-123",
      "synced_at": "2024-01-15",
      "source": null
    }
  }'
```

`POST /credit_notes/{lago_id}/metadata`

This endpoint replaces all existing metadata on a credit note with the provided key-value pairs.
Any existing metadata keys not included in the request will be removed.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "external_id": "ext-123",
    "synced_at": "2024-01-15",
    "source": null
  }
}
```

<h3 id="replace-credit-note-metadata-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The credit note unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|body|body|[CreditNoteMetadataResponse](#schemacreditnotemetadataresponse)|true|none|
|» metadata|body|[MetadataObject](#schemametadataobject)|true|Custom metadata stored as key-value pairs.<br>Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "external_id": "ext-123",
    "synced_at": "2024-01-15",
    "source": null
  }
}
```

```json
  "status": 401,
  "error": "Unauthorized"
}
```

```json
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
}
```

<h3 id="replace-credit-note-metadata-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|

## Merge credit note metadata

<a id="opIdmergeCreditNoteMetadata"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/credit_notes/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/metadata \

      "source": null
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /credit_notes/{lago_id}/metadata`

This endpoint merges the provided metadata with existing metadata on the credit note.
Existing keys not in the request are preserved. New keys are added, existing keys are updated.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "external_id": "ext-123",
    "synced_at": "2024-01-15",
    "source": null
  }
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The credit note unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|body|body|[CreditNoteMetadataResponse](#schemacreditnotemetadataresponse)|true|none|
|» metadata|body|[MetadataObject](#schemametadataobject)|true|Custom metadata stored as key-value pairs.<br>Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "external_id": "ext-123",

  }
```

`POST /webhook_endpoints`

This endpoint is used to create a webhook endpoint.

```json
{
  "webhook_endpoint": {
    "webhook_url": "https://foo.bar",
    "signature_algo": "hmac",
    "name": "EC2-production",

      "invoice.voided",
      "customer.created"
    ]
  }
}
```

This endpoint is used to list all existing payment receipts.

<h3 id="list-all-payment-receipts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|invoice_id|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter payment receipts by invoice. It returns the receipts of the payments made on this invoice, including the payments made through a payment request that covers it.|

## List all payment requests

<a id="opIdfindAllPaymentRequests"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/payment_requests \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /payment_requests`

This endpoint is used to list all existing payment requests.

<h3 id="list-all-payment-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|currency|query|string|false|Filter the results by currency, expressed as an ISO 4217 code.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|Unique identifier assigned to the customer in your application.|
|payment_status|query|string|false|Filter by payment status. Possible values are `pending`, `failed` or `succeeded`.|
|billing_entity_codes[]|query|[string]|false|Filter payment requests by billing entity codes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|payment_status|pending|
|payment_status|failed|
|payment_status|succeeded|

## Create a payment request

<a id="opIdcreatePaymentRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/payment_requests \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "payment_request": {
      "external_customer_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
      "email": "dinesh@piedpiper.example",
      "lago_invoice_ids": [
        "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
      ],
      "payment_method": {
        "payment_method_type": "provider",
        "payment_method_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /payment_requests`

This endpoint is used to create a payment request to collect the payment of the overdue invoices of a customer.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "payment_request": {
    "external_customer_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
    "email": "dinesh@piedpiper.example",
    "lago_invoice_ids": [
      "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
    ],
    "payment_method": {
      "payment_method_type": "provider",
      "payment_method_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-payment-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PaymentRequestCreateInput](#schemapaymentrequestcreateinput)|true|Payment request payload|
|» payment_request|body|object|true|none|
|» » external_customer_id|body|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|» » email|body|string(email)|false|The email address used for sending dunning notifications. When omitted, the customer's own email address is used.|
|» » lago_invoice_ids|body|[string(uuid)]|true|A list of Lago IDs for the customer's overdue invoices to start the dunning process.|
|» » payment_method|body|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|false|Optional payment method to use for processing the payment request.|

## List all payments

<a id="opIdfindAllPayments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/payments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /payments`

This endpoint is used to list all payments

<h3 id="list-all-payments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|external_customer_id|query|string|false|Unique identifier assigned to the customer in your application.|
|invoice_id|query|string(uuid)|false|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the invoice's record within the Lago system.|

## Create a payment

<a id="opIdcreatePayment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/payments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "payment": {
      "invoice_id": "486b147a-02a1-4ccf-8603-f3541fc25e7a",
      "amount_cents": 100,
      "reference": "ref1",
      "paid_at": "2025-02-20"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /payments`

This endpoint is used to create a manual payment

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "payment": {
    "invoice_id": "486b147a-02a1-4ccf-8603-f3541fc25e7a",
    "amount_cents": 100,
    "reference": "ref1",
    "paid_at": "2025-02-20"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-payment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PaymentCreateInput](#schemapaymentcreateinput)|true|Payment payload|
|» payment|body|object|true|none|
|» » invoice_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the invoice the payment is recorded on, created by Lago.|
|» » amount_cents|body|integer|true|The payment amount in cents. It must be greater than zero.|
|» » reference|body|string|true|Reference for the payment, such as the bank transfer or cheque number.|
|» » paid_at|body|string(date)|false|The date the payment was made. It is returned as the payment's `created_at`. When omitted, the date and time of the request is used.|

## Set the payment method as default

<a id="opIdpaymentMethodSetAsDefault"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/customers/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/payment_methods/5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba/set_as_default \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /customers/{external_customer_id}/payment_methods/{lago_id}/set_as_default`

This endpoint sets a payment method as the customer's default one. It is the payment method Lago uses when a payment is triggered without an explicit one. Any other default payment method of the customer is unset.

<h3 id="set-the-payment-method-as-default-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|The payment method unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|external_customer_id|path|string|true|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "payment_method": {
```

## List all quotes

<a id="opIdfindAllQuotes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/quotes \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /quotes`

This endpoint is used to list all existing quotes.
Quotes are ordered by creation date, from the most recent to the oldest.
This is a premium feature.

<h3 id="list-all-quotes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number. Defaults to 1. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the first page.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of records per page. Defaults to 100. The maximum is 200, unless another maximum is configured for your organization. A value above the maximum returns a `422` error with `value_is_out_of_range` on `per_page`. A value that is not a positive integer, such as `0`, returns the default number of records.|
|status[]|query|[string]|false|Filter quotes by the status of their current version. Possible values are `draft`, `approved` and `voided`.|
|order_type[]|query|[string]|false|Filter quotes by order type. Possible values are `subscription_creation`, `subscription_amendment` and `one_off`.|
|number[]|query|[string]|false|Filter quotes by their number, as assigned by Lago.|
|owner_id[]|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Filter quotes by the Lago identifiers of the users owning them.|
|external_customer_id[]|query|[string]|false|Filter quotes by the external unique identifiers of their customers (provided by your own application).|
|from_date|query|string(date)|false|Filter quotes created from a specific date.|
|to_date|query|string(date)|false|Filter quotes created up to a specific date.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status[]|draft|
|status[]|approved|
|status[]|voided|
|order_type[]|subscription_creation|
|order_type[]|subscription_amendment|
|order_type[]|one_off|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

## Approve a quote version

<a id="opIdapproveQuoteVersion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/quote_versions/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/approve \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "expires_at": "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z"
  }'
```

`POST /quote_versions/{lago_id}/approve`

This endpoint approves a quote version and generates the order form to send to the customer for signature.
Only a `draft` version can be approved, and its `billing_items` must be complete: approval validates them against the catalog and against the customer, and returns a `422` when the deal cannot be executed as quoted.
The `expires_at` of the generated order form is bounded by the deal's own term, so a signing window reaching beyond the day the deal stops being executable is rejected.
A concurrent write on the same quote is reported as a `422` rather than retried, so a duplicated call can fail while the first one is still in flight.
This is a premium feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "expires_at": "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z"
}
```

<h3 id="approve-a-quote-version-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the quote version within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the quote version's record within the Lago system.|
|body|body|[QuoteVersionApproveInput](#schemaquoteversionapproveinput)|false|Approve quote version payload|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time)|false|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order form generated by the approval expires. It must be in the future, and must fall strictly before the day the quoted deal stops being executable, otherwise the approval is rejected with a `422`. That boundary is the earliest of the `endDate` of any quoted plan and the `expirationAt` of any quoted wallet credit or recurring top-up rule. A `one_off` quote carries none of them, so its signing window is never bounded. When `expires_at` is omitted, the order form never expires.|

## Void a quote version

<a id="opIdvoidQuoteVersion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/quote_versions/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/void \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /quote_versions/{lago_id}/void`

This endpoint voids a quote version, which makes it definitive: a voided version can neither be edited nor approved again.
Only a `draft` version can be voided through this endpoint, and the resulting `void_reason` is `manual`. An `approved` version is voided by Lago itself, through the order form generated from it.
A concurrent write on the same quote is reported as a `422` rather than retried, so a duplicated call can fail while the first one is still in flight.
This is a premium feature.

<h3 id="void-a-quote-version-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the quote version within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the quote version's record within the Lago system.|

## Clone a quote version

<a id="opIdcloneQuoteVersion"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/quote_versions/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/clone \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /quote_versions/{lago_id}/clone`

This endpoint copies a quote version into a new `draft` version of the same quote, so that the deal can be renegotiated.
Any version of the quote can be cloned, but a quote can only carry one active version: the draft the quote currently holds, if any, is voided with the `superseded` reason. Cloning is therefore rejected with a `422` once a version of the quote has been approved.
A concurrent write on the same quote is reported as a `422` rather than retried, so a duplicated call can fail while the first one is still in flight.
This is a premium feature.

<h3 id="clone-a-quote-version-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the quote version within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the quote version's record within the Lago system.|

## Mark an order form as signed

<a id="opIdmarkOrderFormAsSigned"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/order_forms/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/mark_as_signed \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "order_form": {
      "signed_document": "data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQKJcfs...",
      "execution_mode": "execute_in_lago",
      "execute_at": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /order_forms/{lago_id}/mark_as_signed`

This endpoint records the customer's signature on an order form, and creates the order that carries the quoted deal out.
Only a `generated` order form can be signed, so a `422` is returned once the order form has been signed, has expired or has been voided.
An `execute_at` landing on or after the day the quoted deal stops being executable is rejected as well, so the order can never be scheduled past the term it bills.
A concurrent write on the same quote is reported as a `422` rather than retried, so a duplicated call can fail while the first one is still in flight.
This is a premium feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "order_form": {
    "signed_document": "data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQKJcfs...",
    "execution_mode": "execute_in_lago",
    "execute_at": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="mark-an-order-form-as-signed-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the order form within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the order form's record within the Lago system.|
|body|body|[OrderFormMarkAsSignedInput](#schemaorderformmarkassignedinput)|false|Mark order form as signed payload|
|» order_form|body|object|false|none|
|» » signed_document|body|string|false|The document signed by the customer, as a base64 data URI (`data:<content_type>;base64,<data>`). Accepted content types are `application/pdf`, `image/jpeg` and `image/png`, for a maximum of 10 MB. Once attached, it is exposed as `signed_document_url` on the order form.|
|» » execution_mode|body|[OrderExecutionModeEnum](#schemaorderexecutionmodeenum)|false|How the order created from the order form is carried out. It becomes mandatory as soon as `execute_at` is provided.|
|» » execute_at|body|string(date-time)|false|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when Lago executes the order created from the order form. It must be in the future, requires `execution_mode` to be set, and must fall strictly before the day the quoted deal stops being executable, otherwise signing is rejected with a `422`. When it is omitted, the order is created but not scheduled, and waits to be executed on demand.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » execution_mode|execute_in_lago|
|» » execution_mode|order_only|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "order_form": {
    "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "number": "OF-2026-0001",
    "status": "generated",
    "void_reason": "manual",
    "expires_at": "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z",
    "signed_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
    "voided_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
    "signed_document_url": "https://api.getlago.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMi/OF-2026-0001",

    "lago_quote_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "lago_quote_version_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "created_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z"
  }
}
```

## Void an order form

<a id="opIdvoidOrderForm"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/order_forms/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/void \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /order_forms/{lago_id}/void`

This endpoint voids an order form, with the `manual` reason, and cascades to the quote version it was generated from, which is voided with the `cascade_of_voided` reason.
Only a `generated` order form can be voided, so a `422` is returned once the order form has been signed, has expired or has already been voided.
A concurrent write on the same quote is reported as a `422` rather than retried, so a duplicated call can fail while the first one is still in flight.
This is a premium feature.

<h3 id="void-an-order-form-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the order form within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the order form's record within the Lago system.|

## Retrieve an order

<a id="opIdfindOrder"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/orders/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /orders/{lago_id}`

This endpoint retrieves a specific order, along with the `billing_snapshot` its execution applies and the `execution_record` of what it produced.
This is a premium feature.

<h3 id="retrieve-an-order-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the order within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the order's record within the Lago system.|

## Execute an order

<a id="opIdexecuteOrder"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.getlago.com/api/v1/orders/1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90/execute \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "order": {
      "execution_mode": "execute_in_lago"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /orders/{lago_id}/execute`

This endpoint carries out an order on demand, without waiting for its `execute_at` schedule. It runs synchronously, so the response carries the resulting status and, when the execution fails, the reason it failed.
An `execute_in_lago` order applies the quoted deal, creating the subscriptions, coupons, wallets or one-off invoice it describes; an `order_only` order is simply marked as executed. What the execution produced is listed in `execution_record`.
Executing is idempotent: an order that has already been executed is returned untouched. An order whose previous execution failed is executed again, and a `422` is returned when the order carries no execution mode and none is provided in the body.
Restating an `execution_mode` that differs from the one stored on the order updates it first, which only succeeds while the order is still `created`: a `failed` order can be retried, but not switched to another mode. That update also re-validates the order's own `execute_at` against the day the quoted deal stops being executable, so a `422` is possible even though no date was sent. An order carrying no `execute_at` is not bounded that way, and a deal whose term has passed then only fails when the execution runs.
A `404` is not limited to an unknown order: when the execution cannot find a catalog record the quote pinned, such as a deleted plan, charge, coupon or the subscription being amended, the missing resource is reported as a `404` and the order is left `failed`.
Concurrency is reported two ways. A mode change losing the race on the quote comes back as a `422` validation error, while the execution itself losing it comes back as a `422` carrying a lock code, because a scheduled execution relies on that error to be retried.
This is a premium feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "order": {
    "execution_mode": "execute_in_lago"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="execute-an-order-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier assigned to the order within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the order's record within the Lago system.|
|body|body|[OrderExecuteInput](#schemaorderexecuteinput)|false|Execute order payload|
|» order|body|object|false|none|
|» » execution_mode|body|[OrderExecutionModeEnum](#schemaorderexecutionmodeenum)|false|How the order is carried out. It is only persisted when it differs from the mode already stored on the order, so restating the current mode never fails. Changing the mode of an order that has already been executed is rejected.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » execution_mode|execute_in_lago|
|» » execution_mode|order_only|

## An alert was resolved

<a id="opIdalertResolved"></a>

`POST alert_resolved`

One or more thresholds that had triggered the alert are no longer in alarm.

Only thresholds with `resolved` in their `notify_on` are announced, and only when Lago recorded an alarm for their code. A threshold that was already in alarm when it was created or opted in is recorded silently, so its first recovery is announced without an earlier `alert.triggered`. Pairing is by threshold code: a threshold replaced by another one with the same code resolves the alarm the first one raised.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "webhook_type": "alert.resolved",
  "object_type": "resolved_alert",
  "organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "resolved_alert": {
    "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "lago_organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "lago_alert_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "lago_subscription_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "external_subscription_id": "sub_1234567890",
    "lago_wallet_id": null,
    "external_customer_id": "cust_1234567890",
    "billable_metric_code": "storage_usage",
    "alert_type": "billable_metric_current_usage_amount",
    "alert_code": "storage_threshold_alert",
    "alert_name": "Storage Usage Alert",
    "current_value": "700.0",
    "previous_value": "1200.0",
    "recovered_thresholds": [
      {
        "code": "warn",
        "value": "99.0",
        "recurring": false
      }
    ],
    "in_alarm_thresholds": [
      "warning"
    ],
    "fully_resolved": false,
    "reason": "recovered",
    "resolved_at": "2025-05-19T10:04:21Z"
  }
}
```

|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|

<h3 id="a-pay-in-advance-fee-has-been-created-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the new fee|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» fee|body|[FeeObject](#schemafeeobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|fee.created|
|» object_type|fee|

<h3 id="a-pay-in-advance-fee-has-been-created-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="a-new-invoice-has-been-emitted-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the new invoice|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» invoice|body|[InvoiceObjectExtended](#schemainvoiceobjectextended)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.created|
|» object_type|invoice|

<h3 id="a-new-invoice-has-been-emitted-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the new invoice|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|

<h3 id="a-new-prepaid-credit-invoice-has-been-emitted-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the new invoice|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» invoice|body|[InvoiceObjectExtended](#schemainvoiceobjectextended)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.paid_credit_added|
|» object_type|invoice|

<h3 id="a-new-prepaid-credit-invoice-has-been-emitted-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="a-new-invoice-pdf-has-been-generated-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the invoice|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» invoice|body|[InvoiceObjectExtended](#schemainvoiceobjectextended)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.generated|
|» object_type|invoice|

<h3 id="a-new-invoice-pdf-has-been-generated-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="a-new-draft-invoice-has-been-emitted-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the new invoice|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» invoice|body|[InvoiceObjectExtended](#schemainvoiceobjectextended)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.drafted|
|» object_type|invoice|

<h3 id="a-new-draft-invoice-has-been-emitted-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## A draft invoice is ready to be finalized

<a id="opIdinvoiceReadyToFinalize"></a>

`POST invoice_ready_to_finalize`

A draft invoice is ready to be finalized (taxes are resolved). Sent when the draft invoice is created if no tax provider call is pending, or once the tax provider has returned taxes for the draft invoice.

<h3 id="a-draft-invoice-is-ready-to-be-finalized-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the draft invoice ready to be finalized|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» invoice|body|[InvoiceObjectExtended](#schemainvoiceobjectextended)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.ready_to_finalize|
|» object_type|invoice|

<h3 id="a-draft-invoice-is-ready-to-be-finalized-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="an-invoice-has-been-voided-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the invoice|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» invoice|body|[InvoiceObjectExtended](#schemainvoiceobjectextended)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.voided|
|» object_type|invoice|

<h3 id="an-invoice-has-been-voided-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="the-payment-status-of-an-invoice-has-been-updated-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the invoice|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» invoice|body|[InvoiceObjectExtended](#schemainvoiceobjectextended)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.payment_status_updated|
|» object_type|invoice|

<h3 id="the-payment-status-of-an-invoice-has-been-updated-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="an-invoice-payment-is-overdue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the invoice|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» invoice|body|[InvoiceObjectExtended](#schemainvoiceobjectextended)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.payment_overdue|
|» object_type|invoice|

<h3 id="an-invoice-payment-is-overdue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="a-payment-attempt-for-an-invoice-has-failed-on-a-payment-provider-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the invoice and of the payment provider error|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» payment_provider_invoice_payment_error|body|[InvoicePaymentFailureObject](#schemainvoicepaymentfailureobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|invoice.payment_failure|
|» object_type|payment_provider_invoice_payment_error|

<h3 id="a-payment-attempt-for-an-invoice-has-failed-on-a-payment-provider-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## An order has been executed

<a id="opIdorderExecuted"></a>

`POST order_executed`

An order has been carried out, and what it produced is listed in `execution_record`. For an `execute_in_lago` order that means the subscriptions, coupons, wallets or one-off invoice the quote described; an `order_only` order records the mode and the timestamp alone.
It is emitted on success only: a failed attempt is rolled back and leaves the order in the `failed` status with the reasons in `execution_record.errors`, without emitting anything.
The `billing_snapshot` returned by the REST endpoints is omitted from this payload, being a heavy blob; retrieve the order to get it.
This is a premium feature.

> Body parameter

## An order form has expired

<a id="opIdorderFormExpired"></a>

`POST order_form_expired`

An order form reached its `expires_at` without being signed, and is no longer actionable. Expiry is detected by an hourly job comparing calendar dates in the customer's timezone, falling back to the billing entity's and then to UTC, so the event is emitted during the day the order form expires rather than at the exact `expires_at` time. It cascades to the quote version the order form was generated from, so a `quote.voided` event with the `cascade_of_expired` reason follows.
This is a premium feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "webhook_type": "order_form.expired",
  "object_type": "order_form",
  "organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "order_form": {
    "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "number": "OF-2026-0001",
    "status": "generated",
    "void_reason": "manual",
    "expires_at": "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z",
    "signed_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
    "voided_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
    "signed_document_url": "https://api.getlago.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMi/OF-2026-0001",
    "lago_organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "lago_customer_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "lago_quote_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "lago_quote_version_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "created_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z"
  }
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|

|body|body|object|false|Details of the expired order form|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|

## An order form has been voided

<a id="opIdorderFormVoided"></a>

`POST order_form_voided`

An order form has been voided before being signed. It cascades to the quote version the order form was generated from, so a `quote.voided` event with the `cascade_of_voided` reason follows.
This is a premium feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "webhook_type": "order_form.voided",
  "object_type": "order_form",
  "organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "order_form": {
    "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "number": "OF-2026-0001",
    "status": "generated",
    "void_reason": "manual",
    "expires_at": "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z",
    "signed_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
    "voided_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
    "signed_document_url": "https://api.getlago.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMi/OF-2026-0001",
    "lago_organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
    "lago_customer_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",

  }
}
```

|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|

|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» payment_request|body|[PaymentRequestObject](#schemapaymentrequestobject)|true|none|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|payment_request.created|
|» object_type|payment_request|

|body|body|object|false|Details of the plan|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» plan|body|[PlanObject](#schemaplanobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|plan.deleted|
|» object_type|plan|

</aside>

## A quote has been voided

<a id="opIdquoteVoided"></a>

`POST quote_voided`

A version of a quote has been voided. It is emitted whichever way the version was voided, so read `version.void_reason` to tell them apart: `manual` for an explicit void, `superseded` when the version was cloned into a new draft, `cascade_of_expired` or `cascade_of_voided` when the order form generated from it expired or was voided.
This is a premium feature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "webhook_type": "quote.voided",
  "object_type": "quote",
  "organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
```

<h3 id="a-subscription-has-been-terminated-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the subscription|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» subscription|body|[SubscriptionWithCustomerObject](#schemasubscriptionwithcustomerobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|subscription.terminated|
|» object_type|subscription|

<h3 id="a-subscription-has-been-terminated-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## A subscription is incomplete and waiting for payment

<a id="opIdsubscriptionIncomplete"></a>

`POST subscription_incomplete`

A payment-gated subscription has been created in the `incomplete` state and is waiting for the gating payment to succeed before it is activated.

<h3 id="a-subscription-is-incomplete-and-waiting-for-payment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the subscription|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» subscription|body|[SubscriptionWithCustomerObject](#schemasubscriptionwithcustomerobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|subscription.incomplete|
|» object_type|subscription|

<h3 id="a-subscription-is-incomplete-and-waiting-for-payment-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## A subscription has been canceled

<a id="opIdsubscriptionCanceled"></a>

`POST subscription_canceled`

A subscription has been canceled before its activation. For payment-gated subscriptions this happens when the gating payment fails or the activation rule expires, in which case the `cancellation_reason` field is set.

<h3 id="a-subscription-has-been-canceled-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the subscription|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» subscription|body|[SubscriptionWithCustomerObject](#schemasubscriptionwithcustomerobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|subscription.canceled|
|» object_type|subscription|

<h3 id="a-subscription-has-been-canceled-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="a-subscription-has-started-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the subscription|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» subscription|body|[SubscriptionWithCustomerObject](#schemasubscriptionwithcustomerobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|subscription.started|
|» object_type|subscription|

<h3 id="a-subscription-has-started-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="a-subscription-has-been-updated-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the subscription|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» subscription|body|[SubscriptionWithCustomerObject](#schemasubscriptionwithcustomerobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|subscription.updated|
|» object_type|subscription|

<h3 id="a-subscription-has-been-updated-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="a-subscription-will-be-terminated-in-the-future-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the subscription|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» subscription|body|[SubscriptionWithCustomerObject](#schemasubscriptionwithcustomerobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|subscription.termination_alert|
|» object_type|subscription|

<h3 id="a-subscription-will-be-terminated-in-the-future-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>
