|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the subscription|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» subscription|body|[SubscriptionWithCustomerObject](#schemasubscriptionwithcustomerobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|subscription.trial_ended|
|» object_type|subscription|

<h3 id="a-subscription-trial-period-has-ended-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="a-usage-threshold-has-been-reached-by-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature|header|string|true|Signature of the webhook payload. The format depends on `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`:<br>`hmac` is the Base64 encoding of an HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload,<br>`jwt` is an RS256 JSON Web Token (a string starting with `eyJ`).|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|header|string|true|Algorithm used to generate the signature|
|X-Lago-Unique-Key|header|string(uuid)|true|Unique id of the webhook. It can be used for idempotency|
|body|body|object|false|Details of the subscription and of the reached threshold|
|» webhook_type|body|string|true|none|
|» object_type|body|string|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|» subscription|body|[SubscriptionWithThresholdObject](#schemasubscriptionwiththresholdobject)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|jwt|
|X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm|hmac|
|» webhook_type|subscription.usage_threshold_reached|
|» object_type|subscription|

<h3 id="a-usage-threshold-has-been-reached-by-a-subscription-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

Billing entity object

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|A unique identifier for the billing entity in the Lago application|
|code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the billing entity|
|default_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The default currency of the billing entity|
|document_locale|string|true|none|The language of the documents generated for this billing entity, in the ISO 639-1 format.|
|document_numbering|string|true|none|The type of document numbering for this billing entity:<br>- `per_customer`: document numbers are unique per customer<br>- `per_billing_entity`: document numbers are unique per billing entity|
|document_number_prefix|string \| null|true|none|The prefix used in document numbers for this billing entity. It is upper cased. When no prefix is given at creation, Lago builds one from the first three letters of the name and the last four characters of the identifier.|
|finalize_zero_amount_invoice|boolean|true|none|Whether to finalize invoices with zero amount for this billing entity|
|invoice_footer|string \| null|true|none|The footer text to be displayed on invoices for this billing entity|
|invoice_grace_period|integer|true|none|The grace period (in days) for invoice finalization|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor|string|true|none|Defines whether the issuing date follows the current billing period's end date or the next period starting date.|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment|string|true|none|The logic applied on top of the subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor rule. You can opt to use the invoice finalization date, that includes any configured grace period.|
|is_default|boolean|true|none|Whether this billing entity is the organization's default billing entity. The default billing entity is the oldest active one, and is used as a fallback whenever no billing entity is provided, for example when an invoice is created. This flag cannot be changed.|
|net_payment_term|integer|true|none|The net payment term (in days) for this billing entity|
|address_line1|string \| null|true|none|The first line of the billing address|
|address_line2|string \| null|true|none|The second line of the billing address|
|phone|string \| null|true|none|The phone number of the billing entity|
|city|string \| null|true|none|The city of the billing address|
|state|string \| null|true|none|The state of the billing address|
|country|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|true|none|The country code of the billing address|
|zipcode|string \| null|true|none|The zipcode of the billing address|
|email|string \| null(email)|true|none|The email address of the billing entity|
|legal_name|string \| null|true|none|The legal name of the billing entity|
|legal_number|string \| null|true|none|The legal registration number of the billing entity|
|tax_identification_number|string \| null|true|none|The tax identification number of the billing entity|
|timezone|[Timezone](#schematimezone)|true|none|The timezone of the billing entity|
|email_settings|[string]|true|none|The email notification settings for this billing entity|
|eu_tax_management|boolean \| null|true|none|Whether EU tax management is enabled for this billing entity. It can only be enabled when the billing entity country is in the European Union.|
|einvoicing|boolean|true|none|Whether e-invoicing is enabled for this billing entity. It can only be enabled when the billing entity country is `FR` or `DE`.|
|logo_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|The URL of the billing entity's logo|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the billing entity was created|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the billing entity was last updated|

```json
{
  "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "name": "TVA",
  "code": "french_standard_vat",
  "description": "French standard VAT",
  "rate": 20,
  "applied_to_organization": true,
  "applied_to_billing_entities_codes": [
    "acme_corp",
    "foo_bar"

}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the tax, created by Lago.|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the tax.|
|code|string|true|none|Unique code used to identify the tax associated with the API request.|
|description|string \| null|true|none|Internal description of the tax.|
|rate|number|true|none|The percentage rate of the tax.|
|applied_to_organization|boolean|true|none|**Deprecated.** **Deprecated.** This field will be removed in a future version. When set to true, it applies the tax to the organization's default billing entity. To apply or remove a tax from any billing entity (including the default one), please use the `PUT /billing_entities/:code` endpoint instead.|
|applied_to_billing_entities_codes|[string]|false|none|The codes of the billing entities the tax is applied to, sorted alphabetically. It is empty when the tax is only attached to customers. This field is only returned by the tax endpoints, not by taxes nested in another object.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Creation date of the tax.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|A unique identifier for the billing entity in the Lago application|
|code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the billing entity|
|default_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The default currency of the billing entity|
|document_locale|string|true|none|The language of the documents generated for this billing entity, in the ISO 639-1 format.|
|document_numbering|string|true|none|The type of document numbering for this billing entity:<br>- `per_customer`: document numbers are unique per customer<br>- `per_billing_entity`: document numbers are unique per billing entity|
|document_number_prefix|string \| null|true|none|The prefix used in document numbers for this billing entity. It is upper cased. When no prefix is given at creation, Lago builds one from the first three letters of the name and the last four characters of the identifier.|
|finalize_zero_amount_invoice|boolean|true|none|Whether to finalize invoices with zero amount for this billing entity|
|invoice_footer|string \| null|true|none|The footer text to be displayed on invoices for this billing entity|
|invoice_grace_period|integer|true|none|The grace period (in days) for invoice finalization|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor|string|true|none|Defines whether the issuing date follows the current billing period's end date or the next period starting date.|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment|string|true|none|The logic applied on top of the subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor rule. You can opt to use the invoice finalization date, that includes any configured grace period.|
|is_default|boolean|true|none|Whether this billing entity is the organization's default billing entity. The default billing entity is the oldest active one, and is used as a fallback whenever no billing entity is provided, for example when an invoice is created. This flag cannot be changed.|
|net_payment_term|integer|true|none|The net payment term (in days) for this billing entity|
|address_line1|string \| null|true|none|The first line of the billing address|
|address_line2|string \| null|true|none|The second line of the billing address|
|phone|string \| null|true|none|The phone number of the billing entity|
|city|string \| null|true|none|The city of the billing address|
|state|string \| null|true|none|The state of the billing address|
|country|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|true|none|The country code of the billing address|
|zipcode|string \| null|true|none|The zipcode of the billing address|
|email|string \| null(email)|true|none|The email address of the billing entity|
|legal_name|string \| null|true|none|The legal name of the billing entity|
|legal_number|string \| null|true|none|The legal registration number of the billing entity|
|tax_identification_number|string \| null|true|none|The tax identification number of the billing entity|
|timezone|[Timezone](#schematimezone)|true|none|The timezone of the billing entity|
|email_settings|[string]|true|none|The email notification settings for this billing entity|
|eu_tax_management|boolean \| null|true|none|Whether EU tax management is enabled for this billing entity. It can only be enabled when the billing entity country is in the European Union.|
|einvoicing|boolean|true|none|Whether e-invoicing is enabled for this billing entity. It can only be enabled when the billing entity country is `FR` or `DE`.|
|logo_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|The URL of the billing entity's logo|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the billing entity was created|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the billing entity was last updated|
|taxes|[[TaxObject](#schemataxobject)]|false|none|none|
|selected_invoice_custom_sections|[[InvoiceCustomSectionObject](#schemainvoicecustomsectionobject)]|false|none|none|

|resource_type|string|true|none|The type of the resource the action was applied to.|
|logged_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date when the action happened, presented in the ISO 8601 datetime format, specifically in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The creation date of the activity log record in the Lago application, presented in the ISO 8601 datetime format, specifically in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|

<h2 id="tocS_ApiLogObject">ApiLogObject</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaapilogobject"></a>

<a id="tocSapilogobject"></a>
<a id="tocsapilogobject"></a>

```json
{
  "api_version": "v1",
  "client": "Lago Ruby v1.26.0",
  "http_method": "post",
  "http_status": 200,
  "logged_at": "2025-03-31T12:31:44Z",
  "request_body": {
    "billable_metric": "{\"name\":\"Storage\",\"code\":\"storage\"}"
  },
  "request_origin": "https://api.getlago.com",
  "request_path": "/api/v1/billable_metrics",
  "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "request_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "request_response": {
    "billable_metric": "{\"lago_id\":\"b9155544-e261-4e92-b54e-f65d7609294c\"}"
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|api_version|string|true|none|Lago API version used in the request.|
|client|string|true|none|The client that made the request, as reported by its user agent.|
|http_method|string|true|none|The HTTP method of the request. Requests made with the GET method are not logged.|
|http_status|integer|true|none|The HTTP status Lago returned for the request.|
|logged_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date when the request was logged, presented in the ISO 8601 datetime format, specifically in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|request_body|object|true|none|The parameters of the request, keyed by their top-level name. Nested values are returned JSON-encoded. When the log is too large to be stored, this object is replaced by a `truncated` key set to `"true"` and an `original_bytesize` key holding the size of the log before truncation.|
|request_origin|string|true|none|The base URL the request was sent to.|
|request_path|string|true|none|The path of the request.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The creation date of the API log record in the Lago application, presented in the ISO 8601 datetime format, specifically in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|request_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier of the API log. It is the identifier of the request, taken from the `X-Request-Id` header when the request carries one, and generated by Lago otherwise.|
|request_response|object \| null|true|none|The body Lago returned for the request, keyed by its top-level name. Nested values are returned JSON-encoded. It is `null` when the response had no body. When the log is too large to be stored, this object is replaced by a `truncated` key set to `"true"` and an `original_bytesize` key holding the size of the log before truncation.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|http_method|post|
|http_method|put|
|http_method|patch|
|http_method|delete|

```json
{
  "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "lago_coupon_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "coupon_code": "startup_deal",
  "coupon_name": "Startup Deal",
  "coupon_description": "I am a coupon description",
  "coupon_status": "active",
  "coupon_deleted_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "lago_customer_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "external_customer_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
  "status": "active",
  "amount_cents": 2000,
  "amount_cents_remaining": 50,
  "amount_currency": "EUR",
  "percentage_rate": null,
  "frequency": "recurring",
  "frequency_duration": 3,
  "frequency_duration_remaining": 1,
  "expiration_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "terminated_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the applied coupon, created by Lago.|
|lago_coupon_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the coupon, created by Lago.|
|coupon_code|string|true|none|Unique code used to identify the coupon.|
|coupon_name|string|true|none|The name of the coupon.|
|coupon_description|string \| null|false|none|The description of the parent coupon.|
|coupon_status|string|true|none|The status of the parent coupon. Can be either `active` or `terminated`.|
|coupon_deleted_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the parent coupon was deleted. If null, the coupon still exists. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard.|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the customer, created by Lago.|
|external_customer_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the coupon. Can be either `active` or `terminated`.|
|amount_cents|integer \| null|false|none|The amount of the coupon in cents. It is set for a coupon with the `fixed_amount` type.|
|amount_cents_remaining|integer \| null|false|none|The remaining amount in cents for a `fixed_amount` coupon with a frequency set to `once`. This field indicates the remaining balance or value that can still be utilized from the coupon.|
|amount_currency|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|false|none|The currency of the coupon amount. It is set for a coupon with the `fixed_amount` type.|
|percentage_rate|string \| null|false|none|The percentage rate of the coupon. It is set for a coupon with the `percentage` type.|
|frequency|string|true|none|The type of frequency for the coupon. It can have three possible values: `once`, `recurring` or `forever`.<br><br>- If set to `once`, the coupon is applicable only for a single use.<br>- If set to `recurring`, the coupon can be used multiple times for recurring billing periods.<br>- If set to `forever`, the coupon has unlimited usage and can be applied indefinitely.|
|frequency_duration|integer \| null|false|none|The number of billing periods to which the coupon applies. It is set when the frequency is `recurring`.|
|frequency_duration_remaining|integer \| null|false|none|The remaining number of billing periods to which the coupon is applicable. This field determines the remaining usage or availability of the coupon based on the remaining billing periods.|
|expiration_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The date and time after which the coupon will stop applying to customer's invoices. Once the expiration date is reached, the coupon will no longer be applicable, and any further invoices generated for the customer will not include the coupon discount.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the coupon was assigned to a customer. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard.|
|terminated_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|This field indicates the specific moment when the coupon amount is fully utilized or when the coupon is removed from the customer's coupon list. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard.|

|terminated_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|This field indicates the specific moment when the coupon amount is fully utilized or when the coupon is removed from the customer's coupon list. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the billable metric created by Lago.|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the billable metric.|
|code|string|true|none|Unique code used to identify the billable metric associated with the API request. This code associates each event with the correct metric.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Internal description of the billable metric.|
|recurring|boolean|true|none|Defines if the billable metric is persisted billing period over billing period.<br><br>- If set to `true`: the accumulated number of units calculated from the previous billing period is persisted to the next billing period.<br>- If set to `false`: the accumulated number of units is reset to 0 at the end of the billing period.<br>- If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|
|rounding_function|string \| null|false|none|Refers to the numeric value or mathematical expression that will be rounded based on the calculated number of billing units. Possible values are `round`, `ceil` and `floor`.|
|rounding_precision|integer \| null|false|none|Specifies the number of decimal places to which the `rounding_function` will be rounded. It can be a positive or negative value.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Creation date of the billable metric.|
|expression|string \| null|false|none|Expression used to calculate the event units. The expression is evaluated for each event and the result is then used to calculate the total aggregated units.|
|field_name|string \| null|false|none|Property of the billable metric used for aggregating usage data. This field is not required for `count_agg`.|
|aggregation_type|string|true|none|Aggregation method used to compute usage for this billable metric.|
|weighted_interval|string \| null|false|none|Parameter exclusively utilized in conjunction with the `weighted_sum_agg` aggregation type. It serves to adjust the aggregation result by assigning weights and proration to the result based on time intervals.|
|filters|[[BillableMetricFilterObject](#schemabillablemetricfilterobject)]|true|none|none|

The expression is evaluated for each event and the result is then used to calculate the total aggregated units.<br>Event values are read with `event.code`, `event.timestamp` and `event.properties.<name>`.<br>Accepted functions are `ceil`, `concat`, `floor`, `greatest`, `least` and `round` as well as `+`, `-`, `/` and `*` operations.<br>`ceil`, `floor` and `round` accept an optional second parameter to specify the number of decimals.<br>|

```json
  "amount_currency": "USD",

  "limited_plans": true,
  "plan_codes": [
    "startup_plan"
  ],

  "billable_metric_codes": [],
  "percentage_rate": null,
  "frequency": "recurring",
  "frequency_duration": 6,
  "expiration": "time_limit",
  "expiration_at": "2022-08-08T23:59:59Z",
  "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "terminated_at": "2022-08-08T23:59:59Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the coupon, created by Lago.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the coupon.|
|code|string|true|none|Unique code used to identify the coupon.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Description of the coupon.|
|coupon_type|string|true|none|The type of the coupon. It can have two possible values: `fixed_amount` or `percentage`.<br><br>- If set to `fixed_amount`, the coupon represents a fixed amount discount.<br>- If set to `percentage`, the coupon represents a percentage-based discount.|
|amount_cents|integer \| null|false|none|The amount of the coupon in cents. This field is required only for coupon with `fixed_amount` type.|
|amount_currency|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|false|none|The currency of the coupon. This field is required only for coupon with `fixed_amount` type.|
|reusable|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the coupon can be reused or not. If set to `true`, the coupon is reusable, meaning it can be applied multiple times to the same customer. If set to `false`, the coupon can only be used once and is not reusable. If not specified, this field is set to `true` by default.|
|limited_plans|boolean|true|none|The coupon is limited to specific plans. The possible values can be `true` or `false`.|
|plan_codes|[string]|false|none|An array of plan codes to which the coupon is applicable. By specifying the plan codes in this field, you can restrict the coupon's usage to specific plans only.|
|limited_billable_metrics|boolean|true|none|The coupon is limited to specific billable metrics. The possible values can be `true` or `false`.|
|billable_metric_codes|[string]|false|none|An array of billable metric codes to which the coupon is applicable. By specifying the billable metric codes in this field, you can restrict the coupon's usage to specific metrics only.|
|percentage_rate|string \| null|false|none|The percentage rate of the coupon. This field is required only for coupons with a `percentage` coupon type.|
|frequency|string|true|none|The type of frequency for the coupon. It can have three possible values: `once`, `recurring`, or `forever`.<br><br>- If set to `once`, the coupon is applicable only for a single use.<br>- If set to `recurring`, the coupon can be used multiple times for recurring billing periods.<br>- If set to `forever`, the coupon has unlimited usage and can be applied indefinitely.|
|frequency_duration|integer \| null|false|none|Specifies the number of billing periods to which the coupon applies. This field is required only for coupons with a `recurring` frequency type.|
|expiration|string|true|none|Specifies the type of expiration for the coupon. It can have two possible values: `time_limit` or `no_expiration`.<br><br>- If set to `time_limit`, the coupon has an expiration based on a specified time limit.<br>- If set to `no_expiration`, the coupon does not have an expiration date and remains valid indefinitely.|
|expiration_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The expiration date and time of the coupon. This field is required only for coupons with `expiration` set to `time_limit`. The expiration date and time should be specified in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard. It indicates the exact moment when the coupon will expire and is no longer valid.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the coupon was created. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard. This field provides the timestamp for the exact moment when the coupon was initially created.|
|terminated_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|This field indicates if the coupon has been terminated and is no longer usable. If it's not null, it won't be removed for existing customers using it, but it prevents the coupon from being applied in the future.|

|name|string|false|none|The name of the coupon.|
|code|string|false|none|Unique code used to identify the coupon.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Description of the coupon.|
|coupon_type|string|false|none|The type of the coupon. It can have two possible values: `fixed_amount` or `percentage`.<br><br>- If set to `fixed_amount`, the coupon represents a fixed amount discount.<br>- If set to `percentage`, the coupon represents a percentage-based discount.|
|amount_cents|integer \| null|false|none|The amount of the coupon in cents. This field is required only for coupon with `fixed_amount` type.|
|amount_currency|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|false|none|The currency of the coupon. This field is required only for coupon with `fixed_amount` type.|
|reusable|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the coupon can be reused or not. If set to `true`, the coupon is reusable, meaning it can be applied multiple times to the same customer. If set to `false`, the coupon can only be used once and is not reusable. If not specified, this field is set to `true` by default.|
|percentage_rate|string \| null|false|none|The percentage rate of the coupon. This field is required only for coupons with a `percentage` coupon type.|
|frequency|string|false|none|The type of frequency for the coupon. It can have three possible values: `once`, `recurring` or `forever`.<br><br>- If set to `once`, the coupon is applicable only for a single use.<br>- If set to `recurring`, the coupon can be used multiple times for recurring billing periods.<br>- If set to `forever`, the coupon has unlimited usage and can be applied indefinitely.|
|frequency_duration|integer \| null|false|none|Specifies the number of billing periods to which the coupon applies. This field is required only for coupons with a `recurring` frequency type.|
|expiration|string|false|none|Specifies the type of expiration for the coupon. It can have two possible values: `time_limit` or `no_expiration`.<br><br>- If set to `time_limit`, the coupon has an expiration based on a specified time limit.<br>- If set to `no_expiration`, the coupon does not have an expiration date and remains valid indefinitely.|
|expiration_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The expiration date and time of the coupon. This field is required only for coupons with `expiration` set to `time_limit`. The expiration date and time should be specified in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard. It indicates the exact moment when the coupon will expire and is no longer valid.|
|applies_to|object \| null|false|none|Set coupon limitations to plans or specific metrics.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the fee within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the fee's record within the Lago system.|
|lago_charge_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the charge that the fee belongs to|
|lago_charge_filter_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the charge filter that the fee belongs to|
|lago_fixed_charge_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the fixed charge that the fee belongs to|
|lago_invoice_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice that the fee belongs to|
|lago_true_up_fee_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the true-up fee when a minimum has been set to the charge. This identifier helps to distinguish and manage the true-up fee associated with the charge, which may be applicable when a minimum threshold or limit is set for the charge amount.|
|lago_true_up_parent_fee_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the parent fee on which the true-up fee is assigned. This identifier establishes the relationship between the parent fee and the associated true-up fee.|
|lago_original_fee_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the fee this fee was derived from. It is set on fees regenerated from an existing fee, and `null` otherwise.|
|lago_subscription_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription, created by Lago. This field is specifically displayed when the fee type is charge or subscription.|
|lago_customer_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer, created by Lago. This field is specifically displayed when the fee type is charge or subscription.|
|external_customer_id|string \| null|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer in your application. This field is specifically displayed when the fee type is charge or subscription.|
|external_subscription_id|string \| null|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription in your application. This field is specifically displayed when the fee type is charge or subscription.|
|amount_cents|integer|true|none|The cost of this specific fee, excluding any applicable taxes.|
|precise_amount|string|false|none|The cost of this specific fee, excluding any applicable taxes, with precision.|
|precise_total_amount|string|false|none|The cost of this specific fee, including any applicable taxes, with precision.|
|amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of this specific fee. It indicates the monetary unit in which the fee's cost is expressed.|
|taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The cost of the tax associated with this specific fee.|
|taxes_precise_amount|string|false|none|The cost of the tax associated with this specific fee, with precision.|
|taxes_rate|number|true|none|The tax rate associated with this specific fee.|
|units|string|true|none|The number of units used to charge the customer. This field indicates the quantity or count of units consumed or utilized in the context of the charge. It helps in determining the basis for calculating the fee or cost associated with the usage of the service or product provided to the customer.|
|precise_unit_amount|string|true|none|The unit amount of the fee per unit, with precision.|
|total_aggregated_units|string \| null|true|none|The total number of units that have been aggregated for this specific fee. It is `null` on fees that do not aggregate units, such as `subscription`, `add_on` and `credit` fees.|
|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The cost of this specific fee, including any applicable taxes.|
|total_amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of this specific fee, including any applicable taxes.|
|events_count|integer \| null|false|none|The number of events that have been sent and used to charge the customer. This field indicates the count or quantity of events that have been processed and considered in the charging process.|
|pay_in_advance|boolean|true|none|Flag that indicates whether the fee was paid in advance. It serves as a boolean value, where `true` represents that the fee was paid in advance (straightaway), and `false` indicates that the fee was not paid in arrears (at the end of the period).|
|invoiceable|boolean|true|none|Flag that indicates whether the fee was included on the invoice. It serves as a boolean value, where `true` represents that the fee was included on the invoice, and `false` indicates that the fee was not included on the invoice.|
|from_date|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The beginning date of the period that the fee covers. It is returned only for `subscription`, `charge`, `add_on` and `fixed_charge` fees. This field indicates the start date of the billing period or subscription period associated with the fee.|
|to_date|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The ending date of the period that the fee covers. It is returned only for `subscription`, `charge`, `add_on` and `fixed_charge` fees. This field indicates the end date of the billing period or subscription period associated with the fee.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|Indicates the payment status of the fee. It represents the current status of the payment associated with the fee. The possible values for this field are `pending`, `succeeded`, `failed` and `refunded`.|
|created_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the fee was created. It is provided in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) format.|
|succeeded_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment for the fee was successfully processed. It is provided in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) format.|
|failed_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment for the fee failed to process. It is provided in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) format.|
|refunded_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the payment for the fee was refunded. It is provided in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) format|
|event_transaction_id|string \| null|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the transaction. This field is specifically displayed when the fee type is `charge` and the payment for the fee is made in advance (`pay_in_advance` is set to `true`).|
|description|string \| null|false|none|The description of the fee.|
|precise_coupons_amount_cents|string|false|none|The coupon amount applied to the fee, with precision.|
|sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The sub total of the fee excluding taxes, in cents.|
|sub_total_excluding_taxes_precise_amount_cents|string|true|none|The sub total of the fee excluding taxes, with precision.|
|amount_details|[FeeAmountDetails](#schemafeeamountdetails)|false|none|List of all unit amount details for calculating the fee.|
|self_billed|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the fee belongs to self-billed invoice. Self-billing is a process where an organization creates the invoice on behalf of the partner.|
|item|object|true|none|Item attached to the fee|
|applied_taxes|[[FeeAppliedTaxObject](#schemafeeappliedtaxobject)]|false|none|List of fee applied taxes|
|pricing_unit_details|[PricingUnitDetailsObject](#schemapricingunitdetailsobject)|false|none|Details about the pricing unit used and amounts for this fee.|
|presentation_breakdowns|[PresentationBreakdownsObject](#schemapresentationbreakdownsobject)|false|none|Array of usage breakdowns split by presentation group keys without affecting pricing or aggregation.|

<h2 id="tocS_CustomerBillingConfiguration">CustomerBillingConfiguration</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacustomerbillingconfiguration"></a>
<a id="schema_CustomerBillingConfiguration"></a>
<a id="tocScustomerbillingconfiguration"></a>
<a id="tocscustomerbillingconfiguration"></a>

```json
{
  "invoice_grace_period": 3,
  "subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor": "next_period_start",
  "subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment": "keep_anchor",
  "payment_provider": "stripe",
  "payment_provider_code": "stripe-eu-1",
  "provider_customer_id": "cus_12345",
  "sync": true,
  "sync_with_provider": true,
  "document_locale": "fr",
  "provider_payment_methods": [
    "card",
    "sepa_debit",
    "us_bank_account",
    "bacs_debit",
    "link",
    "boleto",
    "crypto",
    "customer_balance"
  ]
}
```

Configuration specific to the payment provider, utilized for billing the customer. This object contains settings and parameters necessary for processing payments and invoicing the customer.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice_grace_period|integer \| null|false|none|The grace period, expressed in days, for the invoice. This period refers to the additional time granted to the customer beyond the invoice due date to adjust usage and line items. It is null when the customer has no grace period of its own and falls back to the billing entity. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor|string \| null|false|none|Defines whether the issuing date follows the current billing period's end date or the next period starting date.|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment|string \| null|false|none|The logic applied on top of the subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor rule. You can opt to use the invoice finalization date, that includes any configured grace period.|
|payment_provider|string \| null|false|none|The payment provider utilized to initiate payments for invoices issued by Lago.<br>Accepted values: `stripe`, `adyen`, `cashfree`, `flutterwave`, `gocardless`, `moneyhash` or null. This field is required if you intend to assign a `provider_customer_id`. Send null to detach the customer from its current payment provider.|
|payment_provider_code|string \| null|false|none|Unique code used to identify a payment provider connection.|
|provider_customer_id|string|false|none|The customer ID within the payment provider's system. If this field is not provided, Lago has the option to create a new customer record within the payment provider's system on behalf of the customer|
|sync|boolean|false|none|Set this field to `true` if you want to create the customer in the payment provider synchronously with the customer creation process in Lago. This option is applicable only when the `provider_customer_id` is `null` and the customer is automatically created in the payment provider through Lago. By default, the value is set to `false`|
|sync_with_provider|boolean|false|none|Set this field to `true` if you want to create a customer record in the payment provider's system. This option is applicable only when the `provider_customer_id` is null and the `sync_with_provider` field is set to `true`. By default, the value is set to `false`|
|document_locale|string \| null|false|none|The document locale, specified in the ISO 639-1 format. This field represents the language or locale used for the documents issued by Lago|
|provider_payment_methods|[string]|false|none|Specifies the available payment methods that can be used for this customer when `payment_provider` is set to `stripe`. The `provider_payment_methods` field is an array that allows multiple payment options to be defined. If this field is not explicitly set, the payment methods will be set to `card`. For now, possible values are `card`, `sepa_debit`, `us_bank_account`, `bacs_debit`, `boleto`, `link`, `crypto` and `customer_balance`. Note that when `link` is selected, `card` should also be provided in the array. When `customer_balance` is selected, no other payment can be selected.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor|current_period_end|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor|next_period_start|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_anchor|null|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment|align_with_finalization_date|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment|keep_anchor|
|subscription_invoice_issuing_date_adjustment|null|
|payment_provider|stripe|
|payment_provider|adyen|
|payment_provider|cashfree|
|payment_provider|flutterwave|
|payment_provider|gocardless|
|payment_provider|moneyhash|
|payment_provider|null|

<h2 id="tocS_CustomerMetadata">CustomerMetadata</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacustomermetadata"></a>
<a id="schema_CustomerMetadata"></a>
<a id="tocScustomermetadata"></a>
<a id="tocscustomermetadata"></a>

```json
{
  "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "key": "Purchase Order",
  "value": "123456789",
  "display_in_invoice": true,
  "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z"
}
```

Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to a customer. This can be useful for storing additional information about the customer in a structured format

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|A unique identifier for the customer metadata object in the Lago application. Can be used to update a key-value pair|
|key|string|true|none|The metadata object key|
|value|string|true|none|The metadata object value|
|display_in_invoice|boolean|true|none|Determines whether the item or information should be displayed in the invoice. If set to true, the item or information will be included and visible in the generated invoice. If set to false, the item or information will be excluded and not displayed in the invoice.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the metadata object creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). The creation_date provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the metadata object was created|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the customer's record within the Lago system|
|sequential_id|integer|true|none|The unique identifier assigned to the customer within the organization's scope. This identifier is used to track and reference the customer's order of creation within the organization's system. It ensures that each customer has a distinct `sequential_id` associated with them, allowing for easy identification and sorting based on the order of creation|
|slug|string|true|none|A concise and unique identifier for the customer, formed by combining the Organization's `name`, `id`, and customer's `sequential_id`|
|external_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity associated with the customer.|
|address_line1|string \| null|true|none|The first line of the billing address|
|address_line2|string \| null|true|none|The second line of the billing address|
|applicable_timezone|[Timezone](#schematimezone)|true|none|The customer's applicable timezone, used for billing purposes in their local time.|
|city|string \| null|true|none|The city of the customer's billing address|
|country|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|true|none|Country code of the customer's billing address. Format must be ISO 3166 (alpha-2)|
|currency|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|true|none|Currency of the customer. Format must be ISO 4217|
|email|string \| null(email)|true|none|The email of the customer|
|legal_name|string \| null|true|none|The legal company name of the customer|
|legal_number|string \| null|true|none|The legal company number of the customer|
|logo_url|string \| null|true|none|The logo URL of the customer|
|name|string \| null|true|none|The full name of the customer|
|firstname|string \| null|true|none|First name of the customer|
|lastname|string \| null|true|none|Last name of the customer|
|account_type|string|true|none|The type of the account. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `customer`: the account is a customer.<br>- `partner`: the account is a partner.|
|customer_type|string \| null|true|none|The type of the customer. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `company`: the customer is a company.<br>- `individual`: the customer is an individual.|
|phone|string \| null|true|none|The phone number of the customer|
|state|string \| null|true|none|The state of the customer's billing address|
|tax_identification_number|string \| null|true|none|The tax identification number of the customer|
|timezone|[TimezoneOrNull](#schematimezoneornull)|true|none|The customer's timezone, used for billing purposes in their local time. Overrides the organization's timezone|
|url|string \| null|true|none|The custom website URL of the customer|
|zipcode|string \| null|true|none|The zipcode of the customer's billing address|
|net_payment_term|integer \| null|true|none|The net payment term, expressed in days, specifies the duration within which a customer is expected to remit payment after the invoice is finalized.|
|external_salesforce_id|string \| null|true|none|The customer ID within the Salesforce system|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the customer creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). The creation_date provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the customer object was created|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the customer update, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). The update_date provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the customer object was updated|
|finalize_zero_amount_invoice|string|true|none|Specifies how invoices with a zero total amount should be handled:<br>- `inherit`: (Default) Follows the organization-level configuration.<br>- `finalize`: Invoices are issued and finalized even if the total amount is zero.<br>- `skip`: Invoices with a total amount of zero are not finalized.|
|skip_invoice_custom_sections|boolean|true|none|Set to true to exclude all invoice custom sections from PDF generation for this customer only.|
|billing_configuration|[CustomerBillingConfiguration](#schemacustomerbillingconfiguration)|true|none|Configuration specific to the payment provider, utilized for billing the customer. This object contains settings and parameters necessary for processing payments and invoicing the customer.|
|shipping_address|[Address](#schemaaddress)|true|none|The shipping address of the customer.|
|metadata|[[CustomerMetadata](#schemacustomermetadata)]|true|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_IntegrationCustomer">IntegrationCustomer</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaintegrationcustomer"></a>
<a id="schema_IntegrationCustomer"></a>
<a id="tocSintegrationcustomer"></a>
<a id="tocsintegrationcustomer"></a>

```json
{
  "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "type": "netsuite",
  "integration_code": "netsuite-eu-1",
  "code": "netsuite-eu-1",
  "is_default": true,
  "category": "accounting",
  "external_customer_id": "cus_12345",
  "sync_with_provider": true,
  "subsidiary_id": "2",
  "targeted_object": "contacts",
  "email": "dinesh@piedpiper.example"
}
```

Configuration specific to the accounting and tax integrations. This object contains settings and parameters necessary for syncing documents and payments.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|A unique identifier for the integration customer object in the Lago application.|
|type|string|true|none|The integration type used for accounting, tax and CRM syncs.<br>Accepted values: `netsuite`, `anrok`, `avalara`, `xero`, `hubspot`, `salesforce`.|
|integration_code|string|true|none|Unique code used to identify an integration connection.|
|code|string \| null|true|none|Unique code identifying this integration customer. It defaults to the code of the integration connection.|
|is_default|boolean|true|none|Whether this integration customer is the default one of its category for the customer.|
|category|string \| null|true|none|The category of the integration connection. It is derived from the integration type.<br>Accepted values: `payment`, `tax`, `accounting`, `crm`.|
|external_customer_id|string \| null|true|none|The customer ID within the integration's system. It is `null` when the customer has not been created in the integration's system yet.|
|sync_with_provider|boolean \| null|false|none|Set this field to `true` if you want to create a customer record in the integration's system. This option is applicable only when the `external_customer_id` is null and the `sync_with_provider` field is set to `true`. By default, the value is set to `false`|
|subsidiary_id|string|false|none|This optional field is needed only when working with `netsuite` connection.|
|targeted_object|string \| null|false|none|This optional field is present only when working with `hubspot` connection.|
|email|string \| null|false|none|This optional field is present only when working with `hubspot` connection.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|netsuite|
|type|anrok|
|type|avalara|
|type|xero|
|type|hubspot|
|type|salesforce|
|category|payment|
|category|tax|
|category|accounting|
|category|crm|
|category|null|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the customer's record within the Lago system|
|sequential_id|integer|true|none|The unique identifier assigned to the customer within the organization's scope. This identifier is used to track and reference the customer's order of creation within the organization's system. It ensures that each customer has a distinct `sequential_id` associated with them, allowing for easy identification and sorting based on the order of creation|
|slug|string|true|none|A concise and unique identifier for the customer, formed by combining the Organization's `name`, `id`, and customer's `sequential_id`|
|external_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity associated with the customer.|
|address_line1|string \| null|true|none|The first line of the billing address|
|address_line2|string \| null|true|none|The second line of the billing address|
|applicable_timezone|[Timezone](#schematimezone)|true|none|The customer's applicable timezone, used for billing purposes in their local time.|
|city|string \| null|true|none|The city of the customer's billing address|
|country|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|true|none|Country code of the customer's billing address. Format must be ISO 3166 (alpha-2)|
|currency|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|true|none|Currency of the customer. Format must be ISO 4217|
|email|string \| null(email)|true|none|The email of the customer|
|legal_name|string \| null|true|none|The legal company name of the customer|
|legal_number|string \| null|true|none|The legal company number of the customer|
|logo_url|string \| null|true|none|The logo URL of the customer|
|name|string \| null|true|none|The full name of the customer|
|firstname|string \| null|true|none|First name of the customer|
|lastname|string \| null|true|none|Last name of the customer|
|account_type|string|true|none|The type of the account. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `customer`: the account is a customer.<br>- `partner`: the account is a partner.|
|customer_type|string \| null|true|none|The type of the customer. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `company`: the customer is a company.<br>- `individual`: the customer is an individual.|
|phone|string \| null|true|none|The phone number of the customer|
|state|string \| null|true|none|The state of the customer's billing address|
|tax_identification_number|string \| null|true|none|The tax identification number of the customer|
|timezone|[TimezoneOrNull](#schematimezoneornull)|true|none|The customer's timezone, used for billing purposes in their local time. Overrides the organization's timezone|
|url|string \| null|true|none|The custom website URL of the customer|
|zipcode|string \| null|true|none|The zipcode of the customer's billing address|
|net_payment_term|integer \| null|true|none|The net payment term, expressed in days, specifies the duration within which a customer is expected to remit payment after the invoice is finalized.|
|external_salesforce_id|string \| null|true|none|The customer ID within the Salesforce system|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the customer creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). The creation_date provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the customer object was created|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the customer update, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). The update_date provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the customer object was updated|
|finalize_zero_amount_invoice|string|true|none|Specifies how invoices with a zero total amount should be handled:<br>- `inherit`: (Default) Follows the organization-level configuration.<br>- `finalize`: Invoices are issued and finalized even if the total amount is zero.<br>- `skip`: Invoices with a total amount of zero are not finalized.|
|skip_invoice_custom_sections|boolean|true|none|Set to true to exclude all invoice custom sections from PDF generation for this customer only.|
|billing_configuration|[CustomerBillingConfiguration](#schemacustomerbillingconfiguration)|true|none|Configuration specific to the payment provider, utilized for billing the customer. This object contains settings and parameters necessary for processing payments and invoicing the customer.|
|shipping_address|[Address](#schemaaddress)|true|none|The shipping address of the customer.|
|metadata|[[CustomerMetadata](#schemacustomermetadata)]|true|none|none|
|integration_customers|[[IntegrationCustomer](#schemaintegrationcustomer)]|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_MetadataObject">MetadataObject</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemametadataobject"></a>
<a id="schema_MetadataObject"></a>
<a id="tocSmetadataobject"></a>
<a id="tocsmetadataobject"></a>

```json
{
  "external_id": "ext-123",
  "synced_at": "2024-01-15",
  "source": null
}
```

Custom metadata stored as key-value pairs.
Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**additionalProperties**|string \| null|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_CreditNoteErrorDetailsObject">CreditNoteErrorDetailsObject</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreditnoteerrordetailsobject"></a>
<a id="schema_CreditNoteErrorDetailsObject"></a>
<a id="tocScreditnoteerrordetailsobject"></a>
<a id="tocscreditnoteerrordetailsobject"></a>

```json
{
  "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "error_code": "tax_error",
  "details": {}
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|The credit note error details unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|error_code|string|true|none|The type of the error.|
|details|object|true|none|The details of the error.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|error_code|not_provided|
|error_code|tax_error|
|error_code|tax_voiding_error|
|error_code|invoice_generation_error|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|The credit note unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity associated with the credit note.|
|sequential_id|integer|true|none|The sequential identifier of the credit note, specifically scoped on the associated invoice. It provides a unique numerical identifier for the credit note within the context of the invoice.|
|number|string|true|none|The credit note unique number.|
|lago_invoice_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice that the credit note belongs to|
|invoice_number|string|true|none|The invoice unique number, related to the credit note.|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number of the invoice the credit note belongs to.|
|issuing_date|string(date)|true|none|The date of creation of the credit note. It follows the ISO 8601 date format and provides the specific date when the credit note was created.|
|credit_status|string \| null|true|none|The status of the credit portion of the credit note. It indicates the current state or condition of the credit amount associated with the credit note. The possible values for this field are:<br><br>- `available`: this status indicates that an amount remains available for future usage. The credit can be applied towards future transactions or invoices.<br>- `consumed`: this status indicates that the credit amount has been fully consumed. The remaining amount is 0, indicating that the credit has been utilized in its entirety.<br>- `voided`: this status indicates that the remaining amount of the credit cannot be used any further. The credit has been voided and is no longer available for application or redemption.|
|refund_status|string \| null|true|none|The status of the refund portion of the credit note. It indicates the current state or condition of the refund associated with the credit note. The possible values for this field are:<br><br>- `pending`: this status indicates that the refund is pending execution. The refund request has been initiated but has not been processed or completed yet.<br>- `succeeded`: this status indicates that the refund has been successfully executed. The refund amount has been processed and returned to the customer or the designated recipient.<br>- `failed`: this status indicates that the refund failed to execute. The refund request encountered an error or unsuccessful processing, and the refund amount could not be returned.|
|reason|string|true|none|The reason of the credit note creation.<br>Possible values are `duplicated_charge`, `product_unsatisfactory`, `order_change`, `order_cancellation`, `fraudulent_charge` or `other`.|
|description|string \| null|true|none|The description of the credit note.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the credit note.|
|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total amount of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|precise_total_amount_cents|string|true|none|The total amount of the credit note, expressed in cents, with precision.|
|taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The tax amount of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|precise_taxes_amount_cents|string|true|none|The tax amount of the credit note, expressed in cents, with precision.|
|taxes_rate|number|true|none|The tax rate associated with this specific credit note.|
|sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The subtotal of the credit note excluding any applicable taxes, expressed in cents.|
|balance_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The remaining credit note amount, expressed in cents.|
|credit_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The credited amount of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|refund_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The refunded amount of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|offset_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The offset amount (deducted from the invoice balance) of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|coupons_adjustment_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The pro-rated amount of the coupons applied to the source invoice.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date when the credit note was created. It is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date when the credit note was last updated. It is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|file_url|string \| null|true|none|The PDF file of the credit note. It is `null` while no PDF has been generated.|
|xml_url|string \| null|true|none|The e-invoicing XML file of the credit note. It is `null` while no XML file has been generated.|
|items|[[CreditNoteItemObject](#schemacreditnoteitemobject)]|false|none|Array of credit note's items.|
|applied_taxes|[[CreditNoteAppliedTaxObject](#schemacreditnoteappliedtaxobject)]|false|none|none|
|self_billed|boolean|true|none|Indicates if the credit note belongs to self-billed invoice. Self-billing is a process where an organization creates the invoice on behalf of the partner.|
|customer|[CustomerObject](#schemacustomerobject)|false|none|none|
|metadata|[MetadataObject](#schemametadataobject)|false|none|Custom metadata stored as key-value pairs.<br>Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|
|error_details|[[CreditNoteErrorDetailsObject](#schemacreditnoteerrordetailsobject)]|false|none|The errors raised while the credit note was issued. When the key is present it is always an array, empty when no error was raised.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|The credit note unique identifier, created by Lago.|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity associated with the credit note.|
|sequential_id|integer|true|none|The sequential identifier of the credit note, specifically scoped on the associated invoice. It provides a unique numerical identifier for the credit note within the context of the invoice.|
|number|string|true|none|The credit note unique number.|
|lago_invoice_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice that the credit note belongs to|
|invoice_number|string|true|none|The invoice unique number, related to the credit note.|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number of the invoice the credit note belongs to.|
|issuing_date|string(date)|true|none|The date of creation of the credit note. It follows the ISO 8601 date format and provides the specific date when the credit note was created.|
|credit_status|string \| null|true|none|The status of the credit portion of the credit note. It indicates the current state or condition of the credit amount associated with the credit note. The possible values for this field are:<br><br>- `available`: this status indicates that an amount remains available for future usage. The credit can be applied towards future transactions or invoices.<br>- `consumed`: this status indicates that the credit amount has been fully consumed. The remaining amount is 0, indicating that the credit has been utilized in its entirety.<br>- `voided`: this status indicates that the remaining amount of the credit cannot be used any further. The credit has been voided and is no longer available for application or redemption.|
|refund_status|string \| null|true|none|The status of the refund portion of the credit note. It indicates the current state or condition of the refund associated with the credit note. The possible values for this field are:<br><br>- `pending`: this status indicates that the refund is pending execution. The refund request has been initiated but has not been processed or completed yet.<br>- `succeeded`: this status indicates that the refund has been successfully executed. The refund amount has been processed and returned to the customer or the designated recipient.<br>- `failed`: this status indicates that the refund failed to execute. The refund request encountered an error or unsuccessful processing, and the refund amount could not be returned.|
|reason|string|true|none|The reason of the credit note creation.<br>Possible values are `duplicated_charge`, `product_unsatisfactory`, `order_change`, `order_cancellation`, `fraudulent_charge` or `other`.|
|description|string \| null|true|none|The description of the credit note.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the credit note.|
|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total amount of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|precise_total_amount_cents|string|true|none|The total amount of the credit note, expressed in cents, with precision.|
|taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The tax amount of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|precise_taxes_amount_cents|string|true|none|The tax amount of the credit note, expressed in cents, with precision.|
|taxes_rate|number|true|none|The tax rate associated with this specific credit note.|
|sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The subtotal of the credit note excluding any applicable taxes, expressed in cents.|
|balance_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The remaining credit note amount, expressed in cents.|
|credit_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The credited amount of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|refund_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The refunded amount of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|offset_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The offset amount (deducted from the invoice balance) of the credit note, expressed in cents.|
|coupons_adjustment_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The pro-rated amount of the coupons applied to the source invoice.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date when the credit note was created. It is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date when the credit note was last updated. It is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|file_url|string \| null|true|none|The PDF file of the credit note. It is `null` while no PDF has been generated.|
|xml_url|string \| null|true|none|The e-invoicing XML file of the credit note. It is `null` while no XML file has been generated.|
|items|[[CreditNoteItemObject](#schemacreditnoteitemobject)]|false|none|Array of credit note's items.|
|applied_taxes|[[CreditNoteAppliedTaxObject](#schemacreditnoteappliedtaxobject)]|false|none|none|
|self_billed|boolean|true|none|Indicates if the credit note belongs to self-billed invoice. Self-billing is a process where an organization creates the invoice on behalf of the partner.|
|customer|[CustomerObject](#schemacustomerobject)|false|none|none|
|metadata|[MetadataObject](#schemametadataobject)|false|none|Custom metadata stored as key-value pairs.<br>Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|
|error_details|[[CreditNoteErrorDetailsObject](#schemacreditnoteerrordetailsobject)]|false|none|The errors raised while the credit note was issued. When the key is present it is always an array, empty when no error was raised.|
|customer|[CustomerObject](#schemacustomerobject)|false|none|none|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

This identifier is used to track and reference the customer's order of creation within the organization's system. It ensures that each customer has a distinct `sequential_id` associated with them, allowing for easy identification and sorting based on the order of creation|
|slug|string|true|none|A concise and unique identifier for the customer, formed by combining the Organization's `name`, `id`, and customer's `sequential_id`|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the invoice's record within the Lago system.|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity the invoice was issued from.|
|sequential_id|integer \| null|true|none|This ID helps in uniquely identifying and organizing the invoices associated with a specific customer. It provides a sequential numbering system specific to the customer, allowing for easy tracking and management of invoices within the customer's context. It is assigned when the invoice is finalized, so it is `null` on draft invoices.|
|number|string|true|none|The unique number assigned to the invoice. This number serves as a distinct identifier for the invoice and helps in differentiating it from other invoices in the system.|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number associated with the invoice. It is inherited from the subscription, wallet or wallet transaction the invoice was generated for.|
|issuing_date|string(date)|true|none|The date when the invoice was issued. It is provided in the ISO 8601 date format.|
|payment_dispute_lost_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the payment dispute was lost. It is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It is `null` until a dispute is lost on the invoice.|
|payment_due_date|string \| null(date)|true|none|The payment due date for the invoice, specified in the ISO 8601 date format.|
|payment_overdue|boolean|true|none|Specifies if the payment is considered as overdue.|
|net_payment_term|integer|true|none|The net payment term, expressed in days, specifies the duration within which a customer is expected to remit payment after the invoice is finalized.|
|invoice_type|string|true|none|The type of invoice issued. Possible values are `subscription`, `add_on`, `credit`, `one_off`, `advance_charges` or `progressive_billing`.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the invoice. It indicates the current state of the invoice and can have following values:<br>- `draft`: the invoice is in the draft state, waiting for the end of the grace period to be finalized. During this period, events can still be ingested and added to the invoice.<br>- `finalized`: the invoice has been issued and finalized. In this state, events cannot be ingested or added to the invoice anymore.<br>- `voided`: the invoice has been issued and subsequently voided. In this state, events cannot be ingested or added to the invoice anymore.<br>- `pending`: the invoice remains pending until the taxes are fetched from the external provider.<br>- `failed`: during an attempt of finalization of the invoice, an error happened. This invoice will have an array of error_details, explaining, in which part of the system an error happened and how it's possible to fix it. This invoice can't be edited or updated, only retried. This action will discard current error_details and will create new ones if the finalization failed again.<br>- `deleted`: the draft invoice has been permanently deleted. This status is only returned by the delete endpoint and its webhook; a deleted invoice is no longer retrievable afterwards.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The status of the payment associated with the invoice. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `pending`: the payment is pending, waiting for processing by the payment provider, or the invoice has been issued and its payment status has not been updated through the update endpoint.<br>- `succeeded`: the payment of the invoice has been successfully processed.<br>- `failed`: the payment of the invoice has failed or encountered an error during processing.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the invoice issued.|
|fees_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of fees amount in cents. It calculates the cumulative amount of all the fees associated with the invoice, providing a consolidated value.|
|coupons_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all coupons discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by coupons, expressed in cents.|
|credit_notes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all credit notes discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by credit notes, expressed in cents.|
|sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|Subtotal amount, excluding taxes, expressed in cents.<br>This field depends on the version number. Here are the definitions based on the version:<br>- Version 1: is equal to the sum of `fees_amount_cents`, minus `coupons_amount_cents`, and minus `prepaid_credit_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 2: is equal to the `fees_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 3 & 4: is equal to the `fees_amount_cents`, minus `coupons_amount_cents`.|
|taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The sum of tax amount associated with the invoice, expressed in cents.|
|sub_total_including_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|Subtotal amount, including taxes, expressed in cents.<br>This field depends on the version number. Here are the definitions based on the version:<br>- Version 1: is equal to the `total_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 2: is equal to the sum of `fees_amount_cents` and `taxes_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 3 & 4: is equal to the sum of `sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents` and `taxes_amount_cents`.|
|prepaid_credit_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all prepaid credits discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by prepaid credits, expressed in cents.|
|prepaid_granted_credit_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The portion of prepaid credits discounted on the invoice that originated from granted (free) credits, expressed in cents. Only populated for invoices associated with traceable wallets.|
|prepaid_purchased_credit_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The portion of prepaid credits discounted on the invoice that originated from purchased (paid) credits, expressed in cents. Only populated for invoices associated with traceable wallets.|
|progressive_billing_credit_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The usage already billed in previous invoices. Only apply to `progressive_billing` and `subscription` invoices.|
|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The sum of the amount and taxes amount on the invoice, expressed in cents. It calculates the total financial value of the invoice, including both the original amount and any applicable taxes.|
|total_paid_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount already paid on the invoice, expressed in cents.|
|total_offsetted_credit_note_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount of the invoice settled by finalized credit notes, expressed in cents.|
|total_due_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount still due on the invoice, expressed in cents. It is equal to `total_amount_cents` minus `total_paid_amount_cents` and `total_offsetted_credit_note_amount_cents`, and is `0` for voided invoices.|
|version_number|integer|true|none|The version of the invoice calculation rules applied to this invoice. It determines how the subtotals are computed.|
|self_billed|boolean|true|none|Indicates if the invoice is self-billed. Self-billing is a process where an organization creates the invoice on behalf of the partner. This field specifies whether the invoice is self-billed or not.|
|file_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL that provides direct access to the invoice PDF file. You can use this URL to download or view the PDF document of the invoice. It is `null` while no PDF has been generated, which is the case for draft invoices.|
|xml_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL that provides direct access to the e-invoicing XML file. It is `null` while no XML file has been generated for the invoice.|
|web_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL to the invoice page in the Lago dashboard. It is `null` for invoices that are not visible in the dashboard (for example while still generating). Use it to link users directly to the invoice overview page.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the invoice creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the invoice object was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the invoice update, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the invoice object was last updated.|
|voided_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the invoice was voided, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It is `null` for invoices that have not been voided.|
