### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the invoice's record within the Lago system.|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity the invoice was issued from.|
|sequential_id|integer \| null|true|none|This ID helps in uniquely identifying and organizing the invoices associated with a specific customer. It provides a sequential numbering system specific to the customer, allowing for easy tracking and management of invoices within the customer's context. It is assigned when the invoice is finalized, so it is `null` on draft invoices.|
|number|string|true|none|The unique number assigned to the invoice. This number serves as a distinct identifier for the invoice and helps in differentiating it from other invoices in the system.|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number associated with the invoice. It is inherited from the subscription, wallet or wallet transaction the invoice was generated for.|
|issuing_date|string(date)|true|none|The date when the invoice was issued. It is provided in the ISO 8601 date format.|
|payment_dispute_lost_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the payment dispute was lost. It is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It is `null` until a dispute is lost on the invoice.|
|payment_due_date|string \| null(date)|true|none|The payment due date for the invoice, specified in the ISO 8601 date format.|
|payment_overdue|boolean|true|none|Specifies if the payment is considered as overdue.|
|net_payment_term|integer|true|none|The net payment term, expressed in days, specifies the duration within which a customer is expected to remit payment after the invoice is finalized.|
|invoice_type|string|true|none|The type of invoice issued. Possible values are `subscription`, `add_on`, `credit`, `one_off`, `advance_charges` or `progressive_billing`.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the invoice. It indicates the current state of the invoice and can have following values:<br>- `draft`: the invoice is in the draft state, waiting for the end of the grace period to be finalized. During this period, events can still be ingested and added to the invoice.<br>- `finalized`: the invoice has been issued and finalized. In this state, events cannot be ingested or added to the invoice anymore.<br>- `voided`: the invoice has been issued and subsequently voided. In this state, events cannot be ingested or added to the invoice anymore.<br>- `pending`: the invoice remains pending until the taxes are fetched from the external provider.<br>- `failed`: during an attempt of finalization of the invoice, an error happened. This invoice will have an array of error_details, explaining, in which part of the system an error happened and how it's possible to fix it. This invoice can't be edited or updated, only retried. This action will discard current error_details and will create new ones if the finalization failed again.<br>- `deleted`: the draft invoice has been permanently deleted. This status is only returned by the delete endpoint and its webhook; a deleted invoice is no longer retrievable afterwards.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The status of the payment associated with the invoice. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `pending`: the payment is pending, waiting for processing by the payment provider, or the invoice has been issued and its payment status has not been updated through the update endpoint.<br>- `succeeded`: the payment of the invoice has been successfully processed.<br>- `failed`: the payment of the invoice has failed or encountered an error during processing.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the invoice issued.|
|fees_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of fees amount in cents. It calculates the cumulative amount of all the fees associated with the invoice, providing a consolidated value.|
|coupons_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all coupons discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by coupons, expressed in cents.|
|credit_notes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all credit notes discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by credit notes, expressed in cents.|
|sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|Subtotal amount, excluding taxes, expressed in cents.<br>This field depends on the version number. Here are the definitions based on the version:<br>- Version 1: is equal to the sum of `fees_amount_cents`, minus `coupons_amount_cents`, and minus `prepaid_credit_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 2: is equal to the `fees_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 3 & 4: is equal to the `fees_amount_cents`, minus `coupons_amount_cents`.|
|taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The sum of tax amount associated with the invoice, expressed in cents.|
|sub_total_including_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|Subtotal amount, including taxes, expressed in cents.<br>This field depends on the version number. Here are the definitions based on the version:<br>- Version 1: is equal to the `total_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 2: is equal to the sum of `fees_amount_cents` and `taxes_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 3 & 4: is equal to the sum of `sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents` and `taxes_amount_cents`.|
|prepaid_credit_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all prepaid credits discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by prepaid credits, expressed in cents.|
|prepaid_granted_credit_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The portion of prepaid credits discounted on the invoice that originated from granted (free) credits, expressed in cents. Only populated for invoices associated with traceable wallets.|
|prepaid_purchased_credit_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The portion of prepaid credits discounted on the invoice that originated from purchased (paid) credits, expressed in cents. Only populated for invoices associated with traceable wallets.|
|progressive_billing_credit_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The usage already billed in previous invoices. Only apply to `progressive_billing` and `subscription` invoices.|
|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The sum of the amount and taxes amount on the invoice, expressed in cents. It calculates the total financial value of the invoice, including both the original amount and any applicable taxes.|
|total_paid_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount already paid on the invoice, expressed in cents.|
|total_offsetted_credit_note_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount of the invoice settled by finalized credit notes, expressed in cents.|
|total_due_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount still due on the invoice, expressed in cents. It is equal to `total_amount_cents` minus `total_paid_amount_cents` and `total_offsetted_credit_note_amount_cents`, and is `0` for voided invoices.|
|version_number|integer|true|none|The version of the invoice calculation rules applied to this invoice. It determines how the subtotals are computed.|
|self_billed|boolean|true|none|Indicates if the invoice is self-billed. Self-billing is a process where an organization creates the invoice on behalf of the partner. This field specifies whether the invoice is self-billed or not.|
|file_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL that provides direct access to the invoice PDF file. You can use this URL to download or view the PDF document of the invoice. It is `null` while no PDF has been generated, which is the case for draft invoices.|
|xml_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL that provides direct access to the e-invoicing XML file. It is `null` while no XML file has been generated for the invoice.|
|web_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL to the invoice page in the Lago dashboard. It is `null` for invoices that are not visible in the dashboard (for example while still generating). Use it to link users directly to the invoice overview page.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the invoice creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the invoice object was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the invoice update, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the invoice object was last updated.|
|voided_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the invoice was voided, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It is `null` for invoices that have not been voided.|
|customer|[CustomerObject](#schemacustomerobject)|false|none|The customer on which the invoice applies. It refers to the customer account or entity associated with the invoice.|
|metadata|[[InvoiceMetadataObject](#schemainvoicemetadataobject)]|false|none|none|
|applied_taxes|[[InvoiceAppliedTaxObject](#schemainvoiceappliedtaxobject)]|false|none|none|
|applied_invoice_custom_sections|[[InvoiceAppliedInvoiceCustomSectionObject](#schemainvoiceappliedinvoicecustomsectionobject)]|false|none|The invoice custom sections applied to this invoice for PDF generation.|
|applied_usage_thresholds|[[AppliedUsageThresholdObject](#schemaappliedusagethresholdobject)]|false|none|none|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|The unique identifier of the payment, created by Lago.|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the customer, created by Lago.|
|external_customer_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|invoice_ids|[string(uuid)]|true|none|List of invoice IDs associated with the payment.|
|invoice_numbers|[string]|true|none|List of invoice numbers associated with the payment.|
|lago_payable_id|string(uuid)|true|none|The unique identifier of the paid resource, created by Lago.|
|payable_type|string|true|none|The type of the paid resource, associated with the `lago_payable_id`.|
|amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount of the payment in cents.|
|amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the payment amount.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the payment within the payment provider. It differs from one payment provider to another. It is always `succeeded` for a manual payment.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The payment status, normalized by Lago so that it is the same for every payment provider.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of payment.|
|reference|string \| null|true|none|Reference for the payment. Set on manual payments only; it is always `null` for payments collected through a payment provider.|
|payment_provider_code|string \| null|true|none|Code of the payment provider. It is `null` for manual payments, which are not attached to a payment provider.|
|payment_provider_type|string \| null|true|none|The type of payment provider. It is `null` for manual payments, which are not attached to a payment provider.|
|external_payment_id|string \| null|true|none|**Deprecated.** **Deprecated.** Use `provider_payment_id` instead. It holds the same value.|
|provider_payment_id|string \| null|true|none|Unique identifier of the payment within the payment provider (if applicable).|
|provider_customer_id|string \| null|true|none|Unique identifier of the customer within the payment provider. It is `null` for manual payments.|
|next_action|object|true|none|The next action to be taken by the customer to complete the payment. Should usually be empty, except when receiving the `payment.requires_action` webhook.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of the payment in Lago's database, not on the payment provider. On a manual payment recorded with `paid_at`, it holds the `paid_at` value instead of the time the payment was recorded.|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethodObject](#schemapaymentmethodobject)|false|none|The payment method used for the payment. It is only sent on the `payment.succeeded` webhook, and only when a payment method is attached to the payment.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the payment request, created by Lago.|
|email|string \| null(email)|true|none|The email address used for sending dunning notifications. It defaults to the customer's own email address, and is `null` when the customer has none.|
|amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount the payment request collects, expressed in cents. It is the sum of the amounts still due on the invoices it covers, minus the credit notes offset against those invoices.|
|amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the payment request.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The status of the payment associated with the payment request. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `pending`: the payment has not been processed yet. A payment request starts with this status.<br>- `succeeded`: the payment of the payment request has been successfully processed.<br>- `failed`: the payment of the payment request has failed or encountered an error during processing.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the payment request was created. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard. This field provides the timestamp for the exact moment when the payment request was initially created.|
|customer|[CustomerBaseObject](#schemacustomerbaseobject)|true|none|The customer on which the payment request applies. It refers to the customer account or entity associated with the payment request.|
|invoices|[[InvoiceBaseObject](#schemainvoicebaseobject)]|true|none|The overdue invoices the payment request collects the payment for.|

```json
  "expires_at": "2022-08-10T00:00:00Z",
  "created_at": "2022-08-08T00:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2022-08-08T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the activation rule within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the activation rule. Only `payment` is currently supported. A `payment` rule gates the subscription activation on a successful payment of the first invoice.|
|timeout_hours|integer|true|none|The number of hours the subscription stays in the `incomplete` state waiting for the payment to succeed before it is automatically canceled.|
|status|string|true|none|The evaluation status of the activation rule:<br>- `inactive`: the rule has not been evaluated yet.<br>- `pending`: the rule is applicable and is waiting to be satisfied (e.g. waiting for the payment).<br>- `satisfied`: the rule has been satisfied and no longer blocks activation.<br>- `declined`: the rule was applicable but was declined.<br>- `failed`: the rule could not be satisfied (e.g. the payment failed).<br>- `expired`: the rule was not satisfied before its timeout elapsed.<br>- `not_applicable`: the rule did not apply to this subscription.|
|expires_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the rule expires, after which an unsatisfied rule causes the subscription to be canceled. Represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). Null until the rule starts being evaluated.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The creation date of the activation rule, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The last update date of the activation rule, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|payment|
|status|inactive|
|status|pending|
|status|satisfied|
|status|declined|
|status|failed|
|status|expired|
|status|not_applicable|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the subscription's record within the Lago system|
|external_id|string|true|none|The subscription external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the customer's record within the Lago system|
|external_customer_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|billing_entity_code|string|false|none|The code of the billing entity associated with the subscription.|
|billing_time|string|true|none|The billing time for the subscription, which can be set as either `anniversary` or `calendar`. If not explicitly provided, it will default to `calendar`. The billing time determines the timing of recurring billing cycles for the subscription. By specifying `anniversary`, the billing cycle will be based on the specific date the subscription started (billed fully), while `calendar` sets the billing cycle at the first day of the week/month/year (billed with proration).|
|name|string \| null|true|none|The display name of the subscription on an invoice. This field allows for customization of the subscription's name for billing purposes, especially useful when a single customer has multiple subscriptions using the same plan.|
|plan_code|string|true|none|The unique code representing the plan to be attached to the customer. This code must correspond to the `code` property of one of the active plans.|
|plan_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The base cost of the related plan, excluding any applicable taxes, that is billed on a recurring basis.|
|plan_amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the related plan. It indicates the monetary unit in which the plan's cost, including taxes and usage-based charges, is expressed.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the subscription, which can have the following values:<br>- `active`: the subscription is currently active and applied to the customer.<br>- `canceled`: the subscription has been stopped before its activation. This can occur when two consecutive downgrades have been applied to a customer, when a subscription with a pending status is terminated, or when a payment-gated subscription fails to be paid (or its activation rule expires) before activation. When caused by payment gating, the `cancellation_reason` field is set.<br>- `incomplete`: the subscription was created with a payment activation rule and is waiting for the gating payment to succeed before it becomes `active`. It is automatically `canceled` if the payment fails or the activation rule expires.<br>- `pending`: a previous subscription has been downgraded, and the current one is awaiting automatic activation at the end of the billing period.<br>- `terminated`: the subscription is no longer active.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The creation date of the subscription, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). This date provides a timestamp indicating when the subscription was initially created.|
|canceled_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The cancellation date of the subscription. This field is not null when the subscription is `canceled`. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|started_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The effective start date of the subscription. This field can be null if the subscription is `pending` or `canceled`. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|ending_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The effective end date of the subscription. If this field is set to null, the subscription will automatically renew. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format, and use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|subscription_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The anniversary date and time of the initial subscription. This date serves as the basis for billing subscriptions with `anniversary` billing time. The `anniversary_date` should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|terminated_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The termination date of the subscription. This field is not null when the subscription is `terminated`. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)|
|previous_plan_code|string \| null|true|none|The code identifying the previous plan associated with this subscription.|
|next_plan_code|string \| null|true|none|The code identifying the next plan in the case of a downgrade.|
|downgrade_plan_date|string \| null(date)|true|none|The date when the plan will be downgraded, represented in ISO 8601 date format.|
|trial_ended_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the free trial is ended, represented in ISO 8601 date format.|
|current_billing_period_started_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the current billing period started, represented in ISO 8601 date format.|
|current_billing_period_ending_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the current billing period ends, represented in ISO 8601 date format.|
|on_termination_credit_note|string \| null|true|none|When a pay-in-advance subscription is terminated before the end of its billing period, we generate a credit note for the unused subscription time by default.<br>This field allows you to control the behavior of the credit note generation:<br><br>- `credit`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. The unused amount is credited back to the customer.<br>- `refund`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. If the invoice is paid or partially paid, the unused paid amount is refunded; any unpaid unused amount is credited back to the customer.<br>- `offset`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. If the invoice is paid or partially paid, the unused paid amount is refunded; any unpaid unused amount is applied to the invoice reducing its amount due.<br>- `skip`: No credit note is generated for the unused subscription time.<br><br>_Note: This field is only applicable to pay-in-advance plans and will be `null` for pay-in-arrears plans._<br>|
|on_termination_invoice|string|true|none|When a subscription is terminated before the end of its billing period, we generate an invoice for the unbilled usage.<br>This field allows you to control the behavior of the invoice generation:<br><br>- `generate`: An invoice is generated for the unbilled usage.<br>- `skip`: No invoice is generated for the unbilled usage.<br>|
|applied_invoice_custom_sections|[[AppliedInvoiceCustomSectionObject](#schemaappliedinvoicecustomsectionobject)]|false|none|The invoice custom sections applied to invoices generated by this subscription. Only returned when creating, retrieving, updating or terminating a subscription, not when listing subscriptions and not in subscription webhooks.|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|true|none|The payment method assigned to this subscription for processing payments.|
|consolidate_invoice|boolean|true|none|Controls whether this subscription is eligible to be grouped with other subscriptions of the same customer on a consolidated recurring invoice.<br><br>- `true` (default): the subscription is included in the customer's standard invoice grouping (by billing entity, currency and payment method).<br>- `false`: the subscription is excluded from consolidation and always billed on its own dedicated invoice, regardless of other grouping criteria.<br>|
|progressive_billing_disabled|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether progressive billing is switched off for this subscription, regardless of any usage thresholds defined on the plan (including thresholds inherited from a parent plan when the subscription runs on a plan override).<br><br>When `true`, no progressive billing invoice is issued for this subscription.<br>|
|cancellation_reason|string \| null|true|none|The reason a payment-gated subscription was canceled while still `incomplete`. Null unless the subscription was canceled before activation.<br><br>- `payment_failed`: the gating payment failed.<br>- `timeout`: the activation rule expired before the payment succeeded.<br>- `manual`: the incomplete subscription was canceled on demand, via a terminate request with `status=incomplete`.<br>|
|activated_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when a payment-gated subscription was activated (i.e. moved from `incomplete` to `active` once the gating payment succeeded), represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). Null while the subscription is still `incomplete`.<br>|
|activation_rules|[[SubscriptionActivationRuleObject](#schemasubscriptionactivationruleobject)]|true|none|The activation rules attached to the subscription. A payment activation rule gates activation on a successful first payment, keeping the subscription in the `incomplete` state until the payment succeeds or the rule expires.<br>|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number associated with the subscription. It will be added to invoices generated for this subscription.|

Object that represents rule for wallet recurring transactions.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|A unique identifier for the recurring transaction rule in the Lago application. Can be used to update a recurring transaction rule.|
|trigger|string|true|none|The trigger. Possible values are `interval` or `threshold`.|
|method|string|true|none|The method used for recurring top-up. Possible values are `fixed` or `target`.|
|interval|string \| null|true|none|The interval used for recurring top-up. It represents the frequency at which automatic top-up occurs. The interval can be one of the following values: `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semiannual` or `yearly`. It is `null` when the trigger is `threshold` and no interval was set.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the recurring transaction rule. Possible values are `active` or `terminated`.|
|threshold_credits|string|true|none|The threshold for recurring top-ups is the value at which an automatic top-up is triggered. For example, if this threshold is set at 10 credits, an automatic top-up will occur whenever the wallet balance falls to or below 10 credits. Required only when trigger is set to `threshold`.|
|paid_credits|string|true|none|The number of paid credits. Required only if there is no granted credits.|
|granted_credits|string|true|none|The number of free granted credits. Required only if there is no paid credits.|
|grants_target_top_up|boolean \| null|true|none|Applies only to `target` rules. When `true`, the recurring top-up grants free credits to reach the target ongoing balance instead of creating a paid top-up (and bypasses the paid top-up minimum). When `false`, the gap is filled with a paid top-up. `null` for `fixed` rules. Defaults to `false` for target rules when omitted.|
|started_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The effective start date for recurring top-ups. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|target_ongoing_balance|string \| null|true|none|The target ongoing balance is the value set for the ongoing balance to be reached by the automatic top-up. Required only when trigger is set to `target`.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the recurring transaction rule creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|expiration_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The expiration date and time for this specific recurring transaction rule. It follows the ISO 8601 datetime format and is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|invoice_requires_successful_payment|boolean|true|none|A boolean setting that, when set to true, delays issuing an invoice for a wallet top-up until a successful payment is made; if false, the invoice is issued immediately upon wallet top-up, regardless of the payment status. Default value of false.|
|transaction_metadata|[object]|true|none|This field allows you to store a list of key-value pairs containing additional information or custom attributes. These key-value pairs will populate the metadata of the wallet transactions triggered by this rule.|
|transaction_name|string \| null|true|none|The name of the wallet transactions triggered by this rule. It will appear on the invoice as the label for the fee. If not set, the label on the invoice will fallback to either `Prepaid credits - {{wallet_name}}` if the wallet name is set, or `Prepaid credits`.|
|ignore_paid_top_up_limits|boolean|true|none|When true, this rule can top up the wallet with transactions that exceed the paid top-up limits. Defaults to false.|
|applied_invoice_custom_sections|[[AppliedInvoiceCustomSectionObject](#schemaappliedinvoicecustomsectionobject)]|true|none|The invoice custom sections applied to invoices generated by this recurring transaction rule.|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|true|none|The payment method assigned to this recurring transaction rule for processing top-up payments.|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number associated with this recurring transaction rule. It will be added to invoices generated for the resulting wallet top-ups. If not set, falls back to the wallet's `purchase_order_number`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|trigger|interval|
|trigger|threshold|
|method|fixed|
|method|target|
|interval|weekly|
|interval|monthly|
|interval|quarterly|
|interval|semiannual|
|interval|yearly|
|interval|null|
|status|active|
|status|terminated|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the wallet within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the wallet's record within the Lago system.|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the customer's record within the Lago system.|
|external_customer_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The code of the billing entity associated with the wallet.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the wallet. Possible values are `active` or `terminated`.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the wallet.|
|name|string \| null|true|none|The name of the wallet.|
|code|string \| null|true|none|The code of the wallet.|
|priority|integer|true|none|Wallet priority for ordering when a customer has multiple wallets. Allowed values: 1-50, where 1 is highest priority and 50 is lowest. Defaults to 50. Wallets with the same priority are applied by expiration date, soonest first, with wallets without an expiration date last, then by creation date, oldest first.|
|rate_amount|string|true|none|The rate of conversion between credits and the amount in the specified currency. It indicates the ratio or factor used to convert credits into the corresponding monetary value in the currency of the transaction.|
|credits_balance|string|true|none|The current wallet balance expressed in credits. This reflects the available balance after all transactions are settled.|
|balance_cents|integer|true|none|The current wallet balance expressed in cents. This reflects the available balance after all transactions are settled.|
|consumed_credits|string|true|none|The number of consumed credits.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the wallet creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|expiration_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time that determines when the wallet will expire. It follows the ISO 8601 datetime format and is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|last_balance_sync_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time of the last balance top-up. It follows the ISO 8601 datetime format and is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|last_consumed_credit_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time of the last credits consumption. It follows the ISO 8601 datetime format and is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|terminated_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date of termination of the wallet. It follows the ISO 8601 datetime format and is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|invoice_requires_successful_payment|boolean|true|none|A boolean setting that, when set to true, delays issuing an invoice for a wallet top-up until a successful payment is made; if false, the invoice is issued immediately upon wallet top-up, regardless of the payment status. Default value of false.|
|applies_to|object|false|none|Limitations that restrict where the wallet credits apply. They can be set on fee types, on billable metrics, or on both.|
|recurring_transaction_rules|[[WalletRecurringTransactionRule](#schemawalletrecurringtransactionrule)]|false|none|List of recurring transaction rules. Only one recurring rule is allowed per wallet. Only the rules that are currently active are returned, so a rule that was terminated or that has passed its `expiration_at` is left out.|
|ongoing_balance_cents|integer|true|none|The ongoing wallet balance expressed in cents. This represents the `balance_cents` minus the `ongoing_usage_balance_cents`, showing the real time balance after accounting for current usage including taxes.|
|ongoing_usage_balance_cents|integer|true|none|The ongoing usage balance of the wallet, expressed in cents. This reflects all current usage and draft invoices including taxes.|
|credits_ongoing_balance|string|true|none|The ongoing wallet balance expressed in credits. This represents the `credits_balance` minus the `credits_ongoing_usage_balance`, showing the real time balance after accounting for current usage including taxes.|
|credits_ongoing_usage_balance|string|true|none|The ongoing usage balance of the wallet, expressed in credits. This reflects all current usage and draft invoices including taxes.|
|paid_top_up_min_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The minimum amount, in cents, of a single paid top-up transaction.|
|paid_top_up_max_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The maximum amount, in cents, of a single paid top-up transaction.|
|applied_invoice_custom_sections|[[AppliedInvoiceCustomSectionObject](#schemaappliedinvoicecustomsectionobject)]|false|none|The invoice custom sections applied to invoices generated by this wallet.|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|true|none|The payment method assigned to this wallet for processing top-up payments.|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number associated with the wallet. It will be added to invoices generated for wallet top-ups, unless a more specific purchase order number is set on the wallet transaction or recurring transaction rule that triggered the top-up.|
|metadata|[MetadataObject](#schemametadataobject)|false|none|Custom metadata stored as key-value pairs.<br>Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

Configuration for invoice custom sections to apply to invoices generated by this resource.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|skip_invoice_custom_sections|boolean|false|none|Set to `true` to exclude all invoice custom sections from PDF generation for invoices related to this resource. When `true`, `invoice_custom_section_codes` is ignored.|
|invoice_custom_section_codes|[string]|false|none|List of unique codes identifying the invoice custom sections to apply. These override the default invoice custom sections configured at the customer or billing entity level.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

Opting in to `resolved` additionally sends an `alert.resolved` webhook when the value returns past the threshold, and requires the threshold to carry a code that is unique within the alert. Not available on recurring thresholds.|

  - [`standard`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/standard)

|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total amount in cents, tax included.|
|charges_usage|[[CustomerChargeUsageObject](#schemacustomerchargeusageobject)]|true|none|Array of charges that comprise the current usage. It contains detailed information about individual charge items associated with the usage.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|units|string|true|none|The number of units consumed by the customer for a specific charge item.|
|projected_units|string|true|none|The projected number of units that can be consumed by the customer for a specific charge item.|
|events_count|integer|true|none|The quantity of usage events that have been recorded for a particular charge during the specified time period. These events may also be referred to as the number of transactions in some contexts.|
|amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount in cents, tax excluded, consumed by the customer for a specific charge item.|
|projected_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The projected amount in cents, tax excluded, that can be consumed by the customer for a specific charge item.|
|amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of a usage item consumed by the customer.|
|pricing_unit_details|[UsagePricingUnitDetailsObject](#schemausagepricingunitdetailsobject)|false|none|Details about the pricing unit used for charge usage.|
|charge|object|true|none|Object listing all the properties for a specific charge item.|
|billable_metric|object|true|none|The related billable metric object.|
|filters|[CustomerProjectedChargeFiltersUsageObject](#schemacustomerprojectedchargefiltersusageobject)|false|none|Array of filter object, representing multiple dimensions for a charge item.|
|grouped_usage|[CustomerProjectedChargeGroupedUsageObject](#schemacustomerprojectedchargegroupedusageobject)|true|none|Array of aggregated fees, grouped by the event properties defined in a `standard` charge model.|
|presentation_breakdowns|[PresentationBreakdownsObject](#schemapresentationbreakdownsobject)|false|none|Array of usage breakdowns split by presentation group keys without affecting pricing or aggregation.|
|projected_presentation_breakdowns|[PresentationBreakdownsObject](#schemapresentationbreakdownsobject)|false|none|Array of usage breakdowns split by presentation group keys without affecting pricing or aggregation.|

|Property|Value|

|projected_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The projected amount in cents, tax excluded.|
|taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The tax amount in cents.|
|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total amount in cents, tax included.|
|charges_usage|[[CustomerProjectedChargeUsageObject](#schemacustomerprojectedchargeusageobject)]|true|none|Array of charges that comprise the current usage. It contains detailed information about individual charge items associated with the usage.|

<h2 id="tocS_EventObject">EventObject</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->

```json
{
  "lago_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",

  "lago_customer_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "code": "storage",
  "timestamp": "2022-04-29T08:59:51.123Z",
  "precise_total_amount_cents": "1234.56",
  "properties": {
    "gb": 10
  },
  "lago_subscription_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "external_subscription_id": "sub_1234567890",
  "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string \| null|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the event within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the event's record within the Lago system. It is an opaque identifier and is not guaranteed to be a UUID; on organizations using the ClickHouse events store it is a composite string.|
|transaction_id|string|true|none|This field represents a unique identifier for the event. It is crucial for ensuring idempotency, meaning that each event can be uniquely identified and processed without causing any unintended side effects.|
|lago_customer_id|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the customer's record within the Lago system|
|code|string|true|none|The code that identifies a targeted billable metric. It is essential that this code matches the `code` property of one of your active billable metrics. If the provided code does not correspond to any active billable metric, it will be ignored during the process.|
|timestamp|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time at which the event occurred, in ISO 8601 format with millisecond precision and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). When no timestamp is sent on the event, it is set to the time of event reception.|
|precise_total_amount_cents|string \| null|false|none|The precise total amount that was sent in the event payload. This field is used by the `dynamic` pricing model.|
|properties|object|false|none|This field represents additional properties associated with the event, which are utilized in the calculation of the final fee. This object becomes mandatory when the targeted billable metric employs a `sum_agg`, `max_agg`, or `unique_count_agg` aggregation method. However, when using a simple `count_agg`, this object is not required.|
|lago_subscription_id|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the subscription's record within the Lago system|
|external_subscription_id|string|true|none|The unique identifier of the subscription within your application, as sent on the event. It is the value Lago uses to attach the event to a subscription.|
|created_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The creation date of the event's record in the Lago application, presented in the ISO 8601 datetime format, specifically in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It provides the precise timestamp of when the event's record was created within the Lago application|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|transaction_id|string|true|none|This field represents a unique identifier for the event.<br>It is crucial for ensuring idempotency, meaning that each event can be uniquely identified and processed without causing any unintended side effects.<br><br>WARNING: If the Lago organization is configured to use the new Clickhouse-based event pipeline (designed for high-volume processing), the idempotency logic is handled differently.<br>Event uniqueness is maintained with both `transaction_id` and `timestamp` fields.<br>If a new event arrives with identical values for these two fields as an existing event, the new one will overwrite the previous event rather than being rejected.<br>|
|external_subscription_id|string|true|none|The unique identifier of the subscription in your application. This field is mandatory in order to link events to the correct customer subscription.|
|code|string|true|none|The code that identifies a targeted billable metric. It is essential that this code matches the `code` property of one of your active billable metrics. If the provided code does not correspond to any active billable metric, it will be ignored during the process.|
|timestamp|integer \| string|false|none|This field captures the Unix timestamp in seconds indicating the occurrence of the event in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).<br>If this timestamp is not provided, the API will automatically set it to the time of event reception.<br>You can also provide milliseconds precision by appending decimals to the timestamp.<br>|
|precise_total_amount_cents|string \| null|false|none|The precise total amount in cents with precision used by the `dynamic` pricing model to compute the usage amount.|
|properties|object \| null|false|none|This field represents additional properties associated with the event, which are utilized in the calculation of the final fee. This object becomes mandatory when the targeted billable metric employs a `sum_agg`, `max_agg`, or `unique_count_agg` aggregation method. However, when using a simple `count_agg`, this object is not required.|

|external_customer_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer in your application. This field is specifically displayed when the fee type is charge or subscription.|
|external_subscription_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription in your application. This field is specifically displayed when the fee type is charge or subscription.|
|amount_cents|integer|true|none|The cost of this specific fee, excluding any applicable taxes.|
|precise_amount|number|false|none|The cost of this specific fee, excluding any applicable taxes, with precision.|
|precise_total_amount|number|false|none|The cost of this specific fee, including any applicable taxes, with precision.|
|amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of this specific fee. It indicates the monetary unit in which the fee's cost is expressed.|
|taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The cost of the tax associated with this specific fee.|
|taxes_precise_amount|number|false|none|The cost of the tax associated with this specific fee, with precision.|
|taxes_rate|number|true|none|The tax rate associated with this specific fee.|
|units|string|true|none|The number of units used to charge the customer. This field indicates the quantity or count of units consumed or utilized in the context of the charge. It helps in determining the basis for calculating the fee or cost associated with the usage of the service or product provided to the customer.|
|description|null|false|none|none|
|precise_unit_amount|number|true|none|The unit amount of the fee per unit, with precision.|
|precise_coupons_amount_cents|string|false|none|The coupon amount applied to the estimated instant fee. It is always `0.0`.|
|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The cost of this specific fee, including any applicable taxes.|
|total_amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of this specific fee, including any applicable taxes.|
|events_count|integer|false|none|The number of events that have been sent and used to charge the customer. This field indicates the count or quantity of events that have been processed and considered in the charging process.|
|pay_in_advance|boolean|true|none|Flag that indicates whether the fee was paid in advance. It serves as a boolean value, where `true` represents that the fee was paid in advance (straightaway), and `false` indicates that the fee was not paid in arrears (at the end of the period).|
|invoiceable|boolean|true|none|Flag that indicates whether the fee was included on the invoice. It serves as a boolean value, where `true` represents that the fee was included on the invoice, and `false` indicates that the fee was not included on the invoice.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|Indicates the payment status of the fee. It represents the current status of the payment associated with the fee. The value is always `pending`.|
|created_at|null|false|none|none|
|succeeded_at|null|false|none|none|
|failed_at|null|false|none|none|
|refunded_at|null|false|none|none|
|event_transaction_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier assigned to the transaction. This field is specifically displayed when the fee type is `charge` and the payment for the fee is made in advance (`pay_in_advance` is set to `true`).|
|amount_details|null|false|none|none|
|item|object|true|none|Item attached to the fee|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_subscription_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription, created by Lago.|
|external_subscription_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription in your application.|
|lago_plan_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the plan, created by Lago.|
|subscription_from_datetime|string(date-time)|true|none|The beginning date of the subscription billing period. This field indicates the start date of the billing period associated with the subscription fee.|
|subscription_to_datetime|string(date-time)|true|none|The ending date of the subscription billing period. This field indicates the end date of the billing period associated with the subscription fee.|
|charges_from_datetime|string(date-time)|true|none|The beginning date of the period that covers the charge fees. It is applicable only to the `charge` fees attached to the subscription. This field indicates the start date of the billing period or subscription period associated with the fees.|
|charges_to_datetime|string(date-time)|true|none|The ending date of the period that covers the charge fees. It is applicable only to the `charge` fees attached to the subscription. This field indicates the end date of the billing period or subscription period associated with the fees.|
|fixed_charges_from_datetime|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The beginning date of the period that covers the fixed charge fees. It is `null` when the billing period carries no fixed charge, for example on an `advance_charges` invoice.|
|fixed_charges_to_datetime|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|The ending date of the period that covers the fixed charge fees. It is `null` when the billing period carries no fixed charge, for example on an `advance_charges` invoice.|
|invoicing_reason|string|true|none|The reason explaining why this subscription appears on the invoice.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|invoicing_reason|subscription_starting|
|invoicing_reason|subscription_periodic|
|invoicing_reason|subscription_terminating|
|invoicing_reason|in_advance_charge|
|invoicing_reason|in_advance_charge_periodic|
|invoicing_reason|progressive_billing|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the invoice's record within the Lago system.|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The unique code of the billing entity the invoice was issued from.|
|sequential_id|integer \| null|true|none|This ID helps in uniquely identifying and organizing the invoices associated with a specific customer. It provides a sequential numbering system specific to the customer, allowing for easy tracking and management of invoices within the customer's context. It is assigned when the invoice is finalized, so it is `null` on draft invoices.|
|number|string|true|none|The unique number assigned to the invoice. This number serves as a distinct identifier for the invoice and helps in differentiating it from other invoices in the system.|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number associated with the invoice. It is inherited from the subscription, wallet or wallet transaction the invoice was generated for.|
|issuing_date|string(date)|true|none|The date when the invoice was issued. It is provided in the ISO 8601 date format.|
|payment_dispute_lost_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the payment dispute was lost. It is expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It is `null` until a dispute is lost on the invoice.|
|payment_due_date|string \| null(date)|true|none|The payment due date for the invoice, specified in the ISO 8601 date format.|
|payment_overdue|boolean|true|none|Specifies if the payment is considered as overdue.|
|net_payment_term|integer|true|none|The net payment term, expressed in days, specifies the duration within which a customer is expected to remit payment after the invoice is finalized.|
|invoice_type|string|true|none|The type of invoice issued. Possible values are `subscription`, `add_on`, `credit`, `one_off`, `advance_charges` or `progressive_billing`.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the invoice. It indicates the current state of the invoice and can have following values:<br>- `draft`: the invoice is in the draft state, waiting for the end of the grace period to be finalized. During this period, events can still be ingested and added to the invoice.<br>- `finalized`: the invoice has been issued and finalized. In this state, events cannot be ingested or added to the invoice anymore.<br>- `voided`: the invoice has been issued and subsequently voided. In this state, events cannot be ingested or added to the invoice anymore.<br>- `pending`: the invoice remains pending until the taxes are fetched from the external provider.<br>- `failed`: during an attempt of finalization of the invoice, an error happened. This invoice will have an array of error_details, explaining, in which part of the system an error happened and how it's possible to fix it. This invoice can't be edited or updated, only retried. This action will discard current error_details and will create new ones if the finalization failed again.<br>- `deleted`: the draft invoice has been permanently deleted. This status is only returned by the delete endpoint and its webhook; a deleted invoice is no longer retrievable afterwards.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The status of the payment associated with the invoice. It can have one of the following values:<br>- `pending`: the payment is pending, waiting for processing by the payment provider, or the invoice has been issued and its payment status has not been updated through the update endpoint.<br>- `succeeded`: the payment of the invoice has been successfully processed.<br>- `failed`: the payment of the invoice has failed or encountered an error during processing.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the invoice issued.|
|fees_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of fees amount in cents. It calculates the cumulative amount of all the fees associated with the invoice, providing a consolidated value.|
|coupons_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all coupons discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by coupons, expressed in cents.|
|credit_notes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all credit notes discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by credit notes, expressed in cents.|
|sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|Subtotal amount, excluding taxes, expressed in cents.<br>This field depends on the version number. Here are the definitions based on the version:<br>- Version 1: is equal to the sum of `fees_amount_cents`, minus `coupons_amount_cents`, and minus `prepaid_credit_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 2: is equal to the `fees_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 3 & 4: is equal to the `fees_amount_cents`, minus `coupons_amount_cents`.|
|taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The sum of tax amount associated with the invoice, expressed in cents.|
|sub_total_including_taxes_amount_cents|integer|true|none|Subtotal amount, including taxes, expressed in cents.<br>This field depends on the version number. Here are the definitions based on the version:<br>- Version 1: is equal to the `total_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 2: is equal to the sum of `fees_amount_cents` and `taxes_amount_cents`.<br>- Version 3 & 4: is equal to the sum of `sub_total_excluding_taxes_amount_cents` and `taxes_amount_cents`.|
|prepaid_credit_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total sum of all prepaid credits discounted on the invoice. It calculates the cumulative discount amount applied by prepaid credits, expressed in cents.|
|prepaid_granted_credit_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The portion of prepaid credits discounted on the invoice that originated from granted (free) credits, expressed in cents. Only populated for invoices associated with traceable wallets.|
|prepaid_purchased_credit_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The portion of prepaid credits discounted on the invoice that originated from purchased (paid) credits, expressed in cents. Only populated for invoices associated with traceable wallets.|
|progressive_billing_credit_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The usage already billed in previous invoices. Only apply to `progressive_billing` and `subscription` invoices.|
|total_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The sum of the amount and taxes amount on the invoice, expressed in cents. It calculates the total financial value of the invoice, including both the original amount and any applicable taxes.|
|total_paid_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount already paid on the invoice, expressed in cents.|
|total_offsetted_credit_note_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount of the invoice settled by finalized credit notes, expressed in cents.|
|total_due_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount still due on the invoice, expressed in cents. It is equal to `total_amount_cents` minus `total_paid_amount_cents` and `total_offsetted_credit_note_amount_cents`, and is `0` for voided invoices.|
|version_number|integer|true|none|The version of the invoice calculation rules applied to this invoice. It determines how the subtotals are computed.|
|self_billed|boolean|true|none|Indicates if the invoice is self-billed. Self-billing is a process where an organization creates the invoice on behalf of the partner. This field specifies whether the invoice is self-billed or not.|
|file_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL that provides direct access to the invoice PDF file. You can use this URL to download or view the PDF document of the invoice. It is `null` while no PDF has been generated, which is the case for draft invoices.|
|xml_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL that provides direct access to the e-invoicing XML file. It is `null` while no XML file has been generated for the invoice.|
|web_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|Contains the URL to the invoice page in the Lago dashboard. It is `null` for invoices that are not visible in the dashboard (for example while still generating). Use it to link users directly to the invoice overview page.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the invoice creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the invoice object was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the invoice update, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It provides a standardized and internationally recognized timestamp for when the invoice object was last updated.|
|voided_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the invoice was voided, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). It is `null` for invoices that have not been voided.|
|customer|[CustomerObject](#schemacustomerobject)|false|none|The customer on which the invoice applies. It refers to the customer account or entity associated with the invoice.|
|metadata|[[InvoiceMetadataObject](#schemainvoicemetadataobject)]|false|none|none|
|applied_taxes|[[InvoiceAppliedTaxObject](#schemainvoiceappliedtaxobject)]|false|none|none|
|applied_invoice_custom_sections|[[InvoiceAppliedInvoiceCustomSectionObject](#schemainvoiceappliedinvoicecustomsectionobject)]|false|none|The invoice custom sections applied to this invoice for PDF generation.|
|applied_usage_thresholds|[[AppliedUsageThresholdObject](#schemaappliedusagethresholdobject)]|false|none|none|
|billing_periods|[[BillingPeriodObject](#schemabillingperiodobject)]|false|none|none|
|credits|[[CreditObject](#schemacreditobject)]|false|none|none|
|fees|[[FeeObject](#schemafeeobject)]|false|none|none|
|subscriptions|[[SubscriptionObject](#schemasubscriptionobject)]|false|none|none|
|error_details|[[ErrorDetailObject](#schemaerrordetailobject)]|false|none|none|

|subscription_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The anniversary date and time of the initial subscription. This date serves as the basis for billing subscriptions with `anniversary` billing time. The `anniversary_date` should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|billing_time|string|false|none|The billing time for the subscription, which can be set as either `anniversary` or `calendar`. If not explicitly provided, it will default to `calendar`. The billing time determines the timing of recurring billing cycles for the subscription. By specifying `anniversary`, the billing cycle will be based on the specific date the subscription started (billed fully), while `calendar` sets the billing cycle at the first day of the week/month/year (billed with proration).|
|coupons|[object]|false|none|none|
|subscriptions|object|false|none|none|
|billing_entity_code|string|false|none|The code of the billing entity to which will be associated a customer if the external_id is not provided. If billing_entity_code is not provided, default billing_entity of organization will be used.|

<h2 id="tocS_OrderFormStatusEnum">OrderFormStatusEnum</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorderformstatusenum"></a>
<a id="schema_OrderFormStatusEnum"></a>
<a id="tocSorderformstatusenum"></a>
<a id="tocsorderformstatusenum"></a>

```json
"generated"
```

The status of the order form. It can be any of the following values:
  - `generated`: the order form is waiting for the customer's signature.
  - `signed`: the customer has signed, and an order has been created from the order form.
  - `expired`: the order form reached its `expires_at` without being signed.
  - `voided`: the order form has been voided before being signed.

Only a `generated` order form is actionable. Reaching `expired` or `voided` also voids the quote version the order form was generated from; signing does not, since the deal it quotes goes on to be executed.

<h2 id="tocS_OrderFormVoidReasonEnum">OrderFormVoidReasonEnum</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorderformvoidreasonenum"></a>
<a id="schema_OrderFormVoidReasonEnum"></a>
<a id="tocSorderformvoidreasonenum"></a>
<a id="tocsorderformvoidreasonenum"></a>

```json
"manual"
```

The reason why the order form is no longer actionable. It is `null` unless the `status` is `voided` or `expired`. It can be any of the following values:
  - `manual`: the order form has been voided explicitly, through the API or the Lago user interface.
  - `expired`: the order form reached its `expires_at` without being signed.
  - `invalid`: reserved for an order form Lago voids because it can no longer be executed. No flow writes it yet.

```json
  "signed_document_url": "https://api.getlago.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMi/OF-2026-0001",
  "lago_organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "lago_customer_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "lago_quote_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "lago_quote_version_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "created_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the order form, created by Lago.|
|number|string|true|none|The unique number assigned to the order form by Lago.|
|status|[OrderFormStatusEnum](#schemaorderformstatusenum)|true|none|The status of the order form. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `generated`: the order form is waiting for the customer's signature.<br>  - `signed`: the customer has signed, and an order has been created from the order form.<br>  - `expired`: the order form reached its `expires_at` without being signed.<br>  - `voided`: the order form has been voided before being signed.<br><br>Only a `generated` order form is actionable. Reaching `expired` or `voided` also voids the quote version the order form was generated from; signing does not, since the deal it quotes goes on to be executed.<br>|
|void_reason|[OrderFormVoidReasonEnum](#schemaorderformvoidreasonenum)|true|none|The reason why the order form is no longer actionable. It is `null` unless the `status` is `voided` or `expired`. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `manual`: the order form has been voided explicitly, through the API or the Lago user interface.<br>  - `expired`: the order form reached its `expires_at` without being signed.<br>  - `invalid`: reserved for an order form Lago voids because it can no longer be executed. No flow writes it yet.<br>|
|expires_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) after which the order form is meant to expire. It is `null` when the order form never expires. It is validated when the quote is approved, where a value on or after the day the quoted deal stops being executable is rejected rather than clamped. Expiry is then swept hourly and compared by calendar date, so signing keeps succeeding until the sweep moves the order form to `expired`.|
|signed_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order form was marked as signed. It is `null` unless the `status` is `signed`.|
|voided_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order form stopped being actionable. It is set both when the order form is voided and when it expires, and is `null` otherwise.|
|signed_document_url|string \| null(uri)|true|none|The URL of the signed document attached to the order form. It is `null` when no document was uploaded.|
|lago_organization_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the customer the order form is addressed to, created by Lago.|
|lago_quote_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the quote the order form comes from, created by Lago.|
|lago_quote_version_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the approved quote version the order form was generated from, created by Lago. A quote version carries at most one order form.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order form was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order form was last updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|generated|
|status|signed|
|status|expired|
|status|voided|
|void_reason|null|
|void_reason|manual|
|void_reason|expired|
|void_reason|invalid|

<h2 id="tocS_OrderExecutionModeEnum">OrderExecutionModeEnum</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorderexecutionmodeenum"></a>
<a id="schema_OrderExecutionModeEnum"></a>
<a id="tocSorderexecutionmodeenum"></a>
<a id="tocsorderexecutionmodeenum"></a>

```json
"execute_in_lago"
```

How the order created from the order form is carried out. It can be any of the following values:
  - `execute_in_lago`: Lago applies the quoted deal itself, creating the subscriptions, coupons, wallets or one-off invoice it describes.
  - `order_only`: Lago records the order without applying it, leaving the execution to your own systems.

<h2 id="tocS_OrderFormMarkAsSignedInput">OrderFormMarkAsSignedInput</h2>

```json
{
  "order_form": {
    "signed_document": "data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQKJcfs...",
    "execution_mode": "execute_in_lago",
    "execute_at": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

Parameters available when marking an order form as signed. Every parameter is optional, so an empty body records the signature without attaching a document, and creates an order that is not scheduled for execution.

<h2 id="tocS_OrderStatusEnum">OrderStatusEnum</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorderstatusenum"></a>
<a id="schema_OrderStatusEnum"></a>
<a id="tocSorderstatusenum"></a>
<a id="tocsorderstatusenum"></a>

```json
"created"
```

The status of the order. It can be any of the following values:
  - `created`: the order has been created from a signed order form and is waiting to be executed.
  - `executed`: the order has been carried out. What it produced is listed in `execution_record`.
  - `failed`: the execution was attempted and rolled back. The reasons are listed in `execution_record.errors`. Lago does not retry on its own, so a new attempt has to be triggered through the execute endpoint.

<h2 id="tocS_QuoteOrderTypeEnum">QuoteOrderTypeEnum</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaquoteordertypeenum"></a>
<a id="schema_QuoteOrderTypeEnum"></a>
<a id="tocSquoteordertypeenum"></a>
<a id="tocsquoteordertypeenum"></a>

```json
"subscription_creation"
```

The commercial motion the quote describes. It can be any of the following values:
  - `subscription_creation`: the quote creates one or more subscriptions.
  - `subscription_amendment`: the quote amends an existing subscription, named by the quote's own `lago_subscription_id`.
  - `one_off`: the quote bills add-ons once, without any subscription.

<h2 id="tocS_OrderExecutionModeEnumOrNull">OrderExecutionModeEnumOrNull</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorderexecutionmodeenumornull"></a>
<a id="schema_OrderExecutionModeEnumOrNull"></a>
<a id="tocSorderexecutionmodeenumornull"></a>
<a id="tocsorderexecutionmodeenumornull"></a>

```json
"execute_in_lago"
```

How the order is carried out. It is `null` while the order has neither been scheduled nor executed. It can be any of the following values:
  - `execute_in_lago`: Lago applies the quoted deal itself, creating the subscriptions, coupons, wallets or one-off invoice it describes.
  - `order_only`: Lago records the order without applying it, leaving the execution to your own systems.

<h2 id="tocS_OrderExecutionRecordObject">OrderExecutionRecordObject</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorderexecutionrecordobject"></a>
<a id="schema_OrderExecutionRecordObject"></a>
<a id="tocSorderexecutionrecordobject"></a>
<a id="tocsorderexecutionrecordobject"></a>

```json
{
  "executed_at": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z",
  "execution_mode": "execute_in_lago",
  "invoice_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "subscription_ids": [
    "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
  ],
  "terminated_subscription_ids": [
    "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
  ],
  "applied_coupon_ids": [
    "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
  ],
  "wallet_ids": [
    "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
  ],
  "errors": [
    "plan_not_found"
  ]
}
```

A trace of what the execution produced. Every key is always present, whichever the order type, so a reader never has to tell a missing key from an empty one; the keys that do not apply keep their empty value.

Which ones are filled depends on the `order_type` of the quote, and only for an `execute_in_lago` order: `invoice_id` for `one_off`, `subscription_ids` with `applied_coupon_ids` and `wallet_ids` for `subscription_creation`, and the same plus `terminated_subscription_ids` for `subscription_amendment`. An `order_only` order records the mode and the timestamp alone.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|executed_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the execution succeeded. It is `null` until then, and stays `null` on a failed attempt.|
|execution_mode|[OrderExecutionModeEnumOrNull](#schemaorderexecutionmodeenumornull)|true|none|The mode the execution ran in.|
|invoice_id|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the one-off invoice created by the execution, created by Lago. Only for a `one_off` order.|
|subscription_ids|[string(uuid)]|true|none|Unique identifiers of the subscriptions created by the execution, created by Lago.|
|terminated_subscription_ids|[string(uuid)]|true|none|Unique identifiers of the subscriptions terminated by the execution, created by Lago. Only for a `subscription_amendment` order, and only when the amendment took effect immediately and terminated the subscription it replaced. It stays empty for an amendment scheduled for the next billing period.|
|applied_coupon_ids|[string(uuid)]|true|none|Unique identifiers of the coupons applied to the customer by the execution, created by Lago.|
|wallet_ids|[string(uuid)]|true|none|Unique identifiers of the prepaid credit wallets created by the execution, created by Lago.|
|errors|[string]|true|none|The reasons why the execution failed. It is empty unless the `status` is `failed`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|execution_mode|null|
|execution_mode|execute_in_lago|
|execution_mode|order_only|

|overrides|object \| null|false|none|The deviations from the coupon snapshot negotiated on the quote. Only the properties set here are overridden.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

A snapshot of everything the quote bills. Unlike the rest of the Lago API, the keys nested in this object are camelCased: the object is stored and returned as it is authored in the Lago user interface.

Which top-level keys are present depends on the `order_type` of the parent quote:
  - `one_off`: `addOns`.
  - `subscription_creation` and `subscription_amendment`: `plans`, plus the optional `coupons` and `walletCredits`.

Every entry pins the catalog record it was built from through its `id` and its `payload`, so that an approved quote keeps billing what was approved even if the catalog changes afterwards. The optional `overrides` object carries the deviations from that record negotiated on the quote.

This object is the single source of truth for the term of the deal. Three of its nested dates bound that term, because the execution flow refuses them once past: `plans[].payload.endDate`, `walletCredits[].payload.expirationAt` and the `expirationAt` of a wallet credit's recurring top-up rule. The earliest of them is the day the deal stops being executable, and both the signing window and the execution date must fall strictly before it. A `one_off` quote carries none of them and is never bounded.

On a `draft` version this object may be incomplete: only the properties documented as required below are enforced on every save, the others are enforced when the version is approved.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|addOns|[[QuoteBillingItemAddOnObject](#schemaquotebillingitemaddonobject)]|false|none|The add-ons billed once by a `one_off` quote. At least one entry is required to approve the version.|
|plans|[[QuoteBillingItemPlanObject](#schemaquotebillingitemplanobject)]|false|none|The plans subscribed to, or amended, by a `subscription_creation` or `subscription_amendment` quote. At least one entry is required to approve the version.|
|coupons|[[QuoteBillingItemCouponObject](#schemaquotebillingitemcouponobject)]|false|none|The coupons applied to the customer when the quote is executed.|
|walletCredits|[[QuoteBillingItemWalletCreditObject](#schemaquotebillingitemwalletcreditobject)]|false|none|The prepaid credit wallets created for the customer when the quote is executed.|
