### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the order, created by Lago.|
|number|string|true|none|The unique number assigned to the order by Lago.|
|status|[OrderStatusEnum](#schemaorderstatusenum)|true|none|The status of the order. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `created`: the order has been created from a signed order form and is waiting to be executed.<br>  - `executed`: the order has been carried out. What it produced is listed in `execution_record`.<br>  - `failed`: the execution was attempted and rolled back. The reasons are listed in `execution_record.errors`. Lago does not retry on its own, so a new attempt has to be triggered through the execute endpoint.<br>|
|order_type|[QuoteOrderTypeEnum](#schemaquoteordertypeenum)|true|none|The commercial motion the quote describes. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `subscription_creation`: the quote creates one or more subscriptions.<br>  - `subscription_amendment`: the quote amends an existing subscription, named by the quote's own `lago_subscription_id`.<br>  - `one_off`: the quote bills add-ons once, without any subscription.<br>|
|execution_mode|[OrderExecutionModeEnumOrNull](#schemaorderexecutionmodeenumornull)|true|none|How the order is carried out. It is `null` while the order has neither been scheduled nor executed. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `execute_in_lago`: Lago applies the quoted deal itself, creating the subscriptions, coupons, wallets or one-off invoice it describes.<br>  - `order_only`: Lago records the order without applying it, leaving the execution to your own systems.<br>|
|currency|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|true|none|The currency the order is denominated in, inherited from the quote version it comes from.|
|executed_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order was executed. It is `null` unless the `status` is `executed`.|
|execution_record|[OrderExecutionRecordObject](#schemaorderexecutionrecordobject)|true|none|A trace of what the execution produced. Every key is always present, whichever the order type, so a reader never has to tell a missing key from an empty one; the keys that do not apply keep their empty value.<br><br>Which ones are filled depends on the `order_type` of the quote, and only for an `execute_in_lago` order: `invoice_id` for `one_off`, `subscription_ids` with `applied_coupon_ids` and `wallet_ids` for `subscription_creation`, and the same plus `terminated_subscription_ids` for `subscription_amendment`. An `order_only` order records the mode and the timestamp alone.<br>|
|lago_organization_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the customer the order was placed for, created by Lago.|
|lago_order_form_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the signed order form the order comes from, created by Lago. An order form carries at most one order.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order was last updated.|
|billing_snapshot|[QuoteBillingItems](#schemaquotebillingitems)|true|none|The billing items of the quote version the order comes from, as they stood when it was approved. This is what the execution applies. It is omitted from the webhook payloads, being a heavy blob.|


The custom billing settings for your organization.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice_footer|string \| null|false|none|The customer invoice message that appears at the bottom of each billing documents. It accepts up to 600 characters.|
|invoice_grace_period|integer|false|none|The grace period, expressed in days, for finalizing the invoice. This period refers to the additional time granted to your customers beyond the invoice due date to adjust usage and line items. Can be overwritten by the customer's grace period. This is a premium feature, the value is ignored without a premium license.|
|document_locale|string|false|none|The locale of the billing documents, expressed in the ISO 639-1 format. This field indicates the language or regional variant used for the documents content issued or the embeddable customer portal.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the organization within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the organization's record within the Lago system|
|name|string|true|none|The name of your organization.|
|slug|string|true|none|A concise and unique identifier for your organization, derived from its `name`. It contains between 3 and 40 characters, limited to lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and it starts and ends with a letter or a digit.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of creation of your organization, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|webhook_url|string|true|none|The URL of the first webhook endpoint of your organization. This URL allows your organization to receive important messages, notifications, or data from the Lago system. It is an empty string when your organization has no webhook endpoint yet.|
|webhook_urls|[string]|true|none|The array containing your webhooks URLs.|
|country|[CountryOrNull](#schemacountryornull)|true|none|The country of your organization.|
|default_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The default currency of an organization.|
|address_line1|string \| null|true|none|The first line of your organization's billing address.|
|address_line2|string \| null|true|none|The second line of your organization's billing address.|
|state|string \| null|true|none|The state of your organization's billing address.|
|zipcode|string \| null|true|none|The zipcode of your organization's billing address.|
|email|string \| null(email)|true|none|The email address of your organization used to bill your customers.|
|city|string \| null|true|none|The city of your organization's billing address.|
|legal_name|string \| null|true|none|The legal name of your organization.|
|legal_number|string \| null|true|none|The legal number of your organization.|
|document_numbering|string|true|none|This parameter configures the method of incrementing invoice numbers for your customers.<br><br>- `per_customer`: Invoice numbers are incremented individually for each customer. This means every customer will have their own unique sequence of invoice numbers, separate from other customers. It ensures that each customer's invoice numbers follow a distinct and isolated numbering pattern.<br>- `per_organization`: Invoice number incrementation is made across your entire organization. Rather than individual sequences for each customer, all invoices within the organization follow a single, unified numbering system. This creates a continuous and organization-wide sequence for all invoice numbers. Invoices are incremented per month (dynamic value used is YYYYMM), and invoice numbers are reset at the end of each month.<br><br>The default value for `document_numbering` is set to `per_customer`, meaning that, unless changed, invoice numbers will increment uniquely for each customer.|
|document_number_prefix|string|true|none|Sets the prefix for invoices and credit notes. Default is the first three letters of your organization name plus the last four characters of your organization ID. Customizable within 1-10 characters, and automatically capitalized by Lago.|
|net_payment_term|integer|true|none|The net payment term, expressed in days, specifies the duration within which a customer is expected to remit payment after the invoice is finalized.|
|tax_identification_number|string \| null|true|none|The tax identification number of your organization.|
|timezone|[Timezone](#schematimezone)|true|none|Your organization's timezone, used for billing purposes in your own local time. Can be overwritten by the customer's timezone.|
|email_settings|[string]|true|none|Represents the email settings of the organization. It allows you to define which documents are sent by email. The field value determines the types of documents that trigger email notifications. Possible values are `invoice.finalized`, `credit_note.created` and `payment_receipt.created`.|
|billing_configuration|[OrganizationBillingConfiguration](#schemaorganizationbillingconfiguration)|true|none|The custom billing settings for your organization.|
|taxes|[[TaxObject](#schemataxobject)]|false|none|List of default organization taxes|
|finalize_zero_amount_invoice|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether invoices with a zero total amount should be finalized. If set to true, zero amount invoices will be finalized. If set to false, zero amount invoices will not be finalized.|
|events_store|string|true|none|The store that holds the events of your organization. It is `clickhouse` when the ClickHouse event store is enabled for your organization, and `postgres` otherwise.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the minimum commitment, created by Lago.|
|plan_code|string|false|none|The unique code representing the plan to be attached to the customer.|
|amount_cents|integer|true|none|The amount of the minimum commitment in cents.|
|invoice_display_name|string \| null|false|none|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the default name will be used as the display name.|
|interval|string|false|none|The interval used for recurring billing. It represents the frequency at which subscription billing occurs. The interval can be one of the following values: `yearly`, `semiannual`, `quarterly`, `monthly` or `weekly`.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the minimum commitment was created. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard. This field provides the timestamp for the exact moment when the minimum commitment was initially created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time when the minimum commitment was updated. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard. This field provides the timestamp for the exact moment when the minimum commitment was initially created.|
|taxes|[[TaxObject](#schemataxobject)]|false|none|All taxes applied to the minimum commitment.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|interval|weekly|
|interval|monthly|
|interval|quarterly|
|interval|semiannual|
|interval|yearly|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|grouped_by|[string]|false|none|**Deprecated.** **Deprecated.** Replaced by `pricing_group_keys`.<br>The list of event properties that are used to group the events on the invoice for a `standard` charge model.|
|pricing_group_keys|[string]|false|none|The list of event properties that are used to group the events on the invoice.|
|graduated_ranges|[object]|false|none|Graduated ranges, sorted from bottom to top tiers, used for a `graduated` charge model.|
|graduated_percentage_ranges|[object]|false|none|Graduated percentage ranges, sorted from bottom to top tiers, used for a `graduated_percentage` charge model.|
|amount|string|false|none|- The unit price, excluding tax, for a `standard` charge model. It is expressed as a decimal value.<br>- The amount, excluding tax, for a complete set of units in a `package` charge model. It is expressed as a decimal value.|
|free_units|integer|false|none|The quantity of units that are provided free of charge for each billing period in a `package` charge model. This field specifies the number of units that customers can use without incurring any additional cost during each billing cycle.|
|package_size|integer|false|none|The quantity of units included in each pack or set for a `package` charge model. It indicates the number of units that are bundled together as a single package or set within the pricing structure.|
|rate|string|false|none|The percentage rate that is applied to the amount of each transaction for a `percentage` charge model. It is expressed as a decimal value.|
|fixed_amount|string|false|none|The fixed fee that is applied to each transaction for a `percentage` charge model. It is expressed as a decimal value.|
|free_units_per_events|integer \| null|false|none|The count of transactions that are not impacted by the `percentage` rate and fixed fee in a percentage charge model. This field indicates the number of transactions that are exempt from the calculation of charges based on the specified percentage rate and fixed fee.|
|free_units_per_total_aggregation|string \| null|false|none|The transaction amount that is not impacted by the `percentage` rate and fixed fee in a percentage charge model. This field indicates the portion of the transaction amount that is exempt from the calculation of charges based on the specified percentage rate and fixed fee.|
|per_transaction_max_amount|string \| null(^[0-9]+.?[0-9]*$)|false|none|Specifies the maximum allowable spending for a single transaction. Working as a transaction cap.|
|per_transaction_min_amount|string \| null(^[0-9]+.?[0-9]*$)|false|none|Specifies the minimum allowable spending for a single transaction. Working as a transaction floor.|
|volume_ranges|[object]|false|none|Volume ranges, sorted from bottom to top tiers, used for a `volume` charge model.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of charge, created by Lago.|
|lago_billable_metric_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the billable metric created by Lago.|
|code|string|false|none|Unique code identifying the charge within the plan.|
|billable_metric_code|string|true|none|Unique code identifying a billable metric.|
|invoice_display_name|string \| null|false|none|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the actual charge will be used as the default display name.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the charge was created. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard.|
|charge_model|[ChargeModelEnum](#schemachargemodelenum)|true|none|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the final fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - [`dynamic`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/dynamic)<br>  - [`graduated_percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated-percentage)<br>  - [`graduated`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated)<br>  - [`package`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/package)<br>  - [`percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/percentage)<br>  - [`standard`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/standard)<br>  - [`volume`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/volume)<br>|
|pay_in_advance|boolean|true|none|This field determines the billing timing for this specific usage-based charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately. Conversely, when set to `false`, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of each billing period.|
|invoiceable|boolean|true|none|This field specifies whether the charge should be included in a proper invoice. If set to `false`, no invoice will be issued for this charge. You can only set it to `false` when `pay_in_advance` is `true`.|
|regroup_paid_fees|string \| null|true|none|This setting can only be configured if `pay_in_advance` is `true` and `invoiceable` is `false`.<br>This field determines whether and when the charge fee should be included in<br>the invoice. If `null`, no invoice will be issued for this charge fee.<br>If `invoice`, an invoice will be generated at the end of the period,<br>consolidating all charge fees with a succeeded payment status.|
|prorated|boolean|true|none|Specifies whether a charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.<br>- If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|
|min_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The minimum spending amount required for the charge, measured in cents and excluding any applicable taxes. It indicates the minimum amount that needs to be charged for each billing period.|
|properties|[ChargeObjectProperties](#schemachargeobjectproperties)|true|none|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the charge.|
|filters|[[ChargeFilterObject](#schemachargefilterobject)]|true|none|List of filters used to apply differentiated pricing based on additional event properties.|
|taxes|[[TaxObject](#schemataxobject)]|false|none|All taxes applied to the charge.|
|applied_pricing_unit|object \| null|false|none|The pricing unit applied to the charge.|
|accepts_target_wallet|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the charge accepts a target wallet for prepaid credits deduction.<br>When `true`, events may include a `target_wallet_code` in their `properties` to direct credit deduction to a specific wallet.<br>This field requires a premium integration.|
|lago_parent_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier of the parent charge (if this is an override).|

|charge_model|package|
|charge_model|percentage|

|charge_model|volume|

|regroup_paid_fees|invoice|

Plan-scoped endpoints always return the plan-level units.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the plan created by Lago.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the plan.|
|invoice_display_name|string \| null|false|none|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the plan will be used as the default display name.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the plan was created. It is expressed in UTC format according to the ISO 8601 datetime standard. This field provides the timestamp for the exact moment when the plan was initially created.|
|code|string|true|none|The code of the plan. It serves as a unique identifier associated with a particular plan. The code is typically used for internal or system-level identification purposes, like assigning a subscription, for instance.|
|interval|string|true|none|The interval used for recurring billing. It represents the frequency at which subscription billing occurs. The interval can be one of the following values: `yearly`, `semiannual`, `quarterly`, `monthly` or `weekly`.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|The description on the plan.|
|amount_cents|integer|true|none|The base cost of the plan, excluding any applicable taxes, that is billed on a recurring basis. This value is defined at 0 if your plan is a pay-as-you-go plan.|
|amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the plan. It indicates the monetary unit in which the plan's cost, including taxes and usage-based charges, is expressed.|
|trial_period|number \| null|false|none|The duration in days during which the base cost of the plan is offered for free.|
|pay_in_advance|boolean|false|none|This field determines the billing timing for the plan. When set to `true`, the base cost of the plan is due at the beginning of each billing period. Conversely, when set to `false`, the base cost of the plan is due at the end of each billing period.|
|bill_charges_monthly|boolean \| null|false|none|This field, when set to `true`, enables to invoice usage-based charges on monthly basis, even if the cadence of the plan is yearly or semiannual. This allows customers to pay charges overage on a monthly basis. This can be set to true only if the plan's interval is `yearly` or `semiannual`.|
|bill_fixed_charges_monthly|boolean \| null|false|none|This field, when set to `true`, enables to invoice fixed charges on monthly basis, even if the cadence of the plan is yearly or semiannual. This allows customers to pay fixed charges on a monthly basis. This can be set to true only if the plan's interval is `yearly` or `semiannual`.|
|parent_id|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier of the parent plan, created by Lago. It is set on plans that override a parent plan for a single subscription, and `null` on standard plans.|
|pending_deletion|boolean|false|none|This field is set to `true` when the plan is scheduled for deletion but still attached to subscriptions that have to be billed first.|
|minimum_commitment|[MinimumCommitmentObject](#schemaminimumcommitmentobject)|false|none|none|
|charges|[[ChargeObject](#schemachargeobject)]|false|none|Additional usage-based charges for this plan.|
|fixed_charges|[[FixedChargeObject](#schemafixedchargeobject)]|false|none|List of fixed charges for this plan. Only returned when creating, retrieving, updating or deleting a plan. It is not returned when listing plans, in the plan webhooks, or on the plan nested in a subscription.|
|taxes|[[TaxObject](#schemataxobject)]|false|none|All taxes applied to the plan.|
|usage_thresholds|[[UsageThresholdObject](#schemausagethresholdobject)]|false|none|List of usage thresholds applied to the plan.|
|applicable_usage_thresholds|[[ApplicableUsageThreshold](#schemaapplicableusagethreshold)]|false|none|List of usage thresholds that actually apply to the plan. For an overriding plan these are inherited from its parent plan; for a standard plan they match `usage_thresholds`. It is not returned in the plan webhooks.|
|entitlements|[[PlanEntitlement](#schemaplanentitlement)]|false|none|List of all feature entitlements and their privileges available for this plan. It is not returned with the `plan.deleted` webhook, nor on the plan nested in a subscription.|
|metadata|[MetadataObject](#schemametadataobject)|false|none|Custom metadata stored as key-value pairs.<br>Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice_display_name|string|false|none|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the actual charge will be used as the default display name.|
|min_amount_cents|integer|false|none|The minimum spending amount required for the charge, measured in cents and excluding any applicable taxes. It indicates the minimum amount that needs to be charged for each billing period.|
|properties|[ChargeObjectProperties](#schemachargeobjectproperties)|false|none|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the charge.|
|filters|[[ChargeFilterInput](#schemachargefilterinput)]|false|none|List of filters used to apply differentiated pricing based on additional event properties.|
|tax_codes|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|none|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|applied_pricing_unit|object|false|none|The pricing unit to apply to the charge.|
|billable_metric_id|string(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier of the billable metric created by Lago.|
|code|string|false|none|Unique code identifying the charge within the plan.|
|charge_model|[ChargeModelEnum](#schemachargemodelenum)|false|none|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the final fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - [`dynamic`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/dynamic)<br>  - [`graduated_percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated-percentage)<br>  - [`graduated`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/graduated)<br>  - [`package`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/package)<br>  - [`percentage`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/percentage)<br>  - [`standard`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/standard)<br>  - [`volume`](https://docs.getlago.com/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/volume)<br>|
|pay_in_advance|boolean|false|none|This field determines the billing timing for this specific usage-based charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately. Conversely, when set to false, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of each billing period.|
|invoiceable|boolean|false|none|This field specifies whether the charge should be included in a proper invoice. If set to false, no invoice will be issued for this charge. You can only set it to `false` when `pay_in_advance` is `true`.|
|regroup_paid_fees|string \| null|false|none|This setting can only be configured if `pay_in_advance` is `true` and `invoiceable` is `false`.<br>This field determines whether and when the charge fee should be included in<br>the invoice. If `null`, no invoice will be issued for this charge fee.<br>If `invoice`, an invoice will be generated at the end of the period,<br>consolidating all charge fees with a succeeded payment status.|
|prorated|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether a charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.<br>- If not defined in the request, default value is `false`.|
|accepts_target_wallet|boolean \| null|false|none|Specifies whether the charge accepts a target wallet for prepaid credits deduction.<br>When set to `true`, events may include a `target_wallet_code` in their `properties` to direct credit deduction to a specific wallet.<br>If no `target_wallet_code` is provided on the event, the standard wallet selection logic is applied.<br>If the `target_wallet_code` does not match an existing wallet, no credits will be applied for that event.<br><br>This field requires a premium integration.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|charge_model|dynamic|
|charge_model|graduated|
|charge_model|graduated_percentage|
|charge_model|package|
|charge_model|percentage|
|charge_model|standard|
|charge_model|volume|
|regroup_paid_fees|null|
|regroup_paid_fees|invoice|

|values|object|true|none|List of possible filter values. The key and values must match one of the billable metric filters.|

|invoice_display_name|string \| null|false|none|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the add-on will be used as the default display name.|
|units|string|false|none|The quantity of units for the fixed charge.|
|apply_units_immediately|boolean|false|none|When set to `true`, the fixed charge units are applied immediately for active subscriptions. When set to `false`, the units are applied at the next billing period.|
|properties|[ChargeProperties](#schemachargeproperties)|false|none|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the fixed charge.|
|tax_codes|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|none|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|invoice_display_name|string \| null|false|none|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the add-on will be used as the default display name.|
|units|string|false|none|The quantity of units for the fixed charge.|
|apply_units_immediately|boolean|false|none|When set to `true`, the fixed charge units are applied immediately for active subscriptions. When set to `false`, the units are applied at the next billing period.|
|properties|[ChargeProperties](#schemachargeproperties)|false|none|List of all thresholds utilized for calculating the fixed charge.|
|tax_codes|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|none|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|add_on_id|string(uuid)|false|none|Unique identifier of the add-on. Either add_on_id or add_on_code is required.|
|add_on_code|string|false|none|Unique code identifying an add-on. Either add_on_id or add_on_code is required.|
|code|string|false|none|Unique code identifying the fixed charge within the plan.|
|charge_model|[FixedChargeModelEnum](#schemafixedchargemodelenum)|false|none|Specifies the pricing model used for the calculation of the fixed charge fee. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `standard`<br>  - `graduated`<br>  - `volume`<br>|
|pay_in_advance|boolean|false|none|This field determines the billing timing for this fixed charge. When set to `true`, the charge is due and invoiced immediately at the beginning of the billing period. When set to `false`, the charge is due and invoiced at the end of the billing period.|
|prorated|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether a fixed charge is prorated based on the remaining number of days in the billing period or billed fully.<br><br>- If set to `true`, the charge is prorated based on the remaining days in the current billing period.<br>- If set to `false`, the charge is billed in full.|

|number|string|true|none|The unique number assigned to the quote by Lago.|
|order_type|[QuoteOrderTypeEnum](#schemaquoteordertypeenum)|true|none|The commercial motion the quote describes. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `subscription_creation`: the quote creates one or more subscriptions.<br>  - `subscription_amendment`: the quote amends an existing subscription, named by the quote's own `lago_subscription_id`.<br>  - `one_off`: the quote bills add-ons once, without any subscription.<br>|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the customer the quote is addressed to, created by Lago.|
|lago_subscription_id|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the subscription the quote amends, created by Lago. It is set only when the `order_type` is `subscription_amendment`.|
|lago_organization_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the quote was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the quote was last updated.|

<h2 id="tocS_QuoteVersionStatusEnum">QuoteVersionStatusEnum</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaquoteversionstatusenum"></a>
<a id="schema_QuoteVersionStatusEnum"></a>
<a id="tocSquoteversionstatusenum"></a>
<a id="tocsquoteversionstatusenum"></a>

```json
"draft"
```

The status of the quote version. It can be any of the following values:
  - `draft`: the version is still editable.
  - `approved`: the version has been approved and an order form has been generated from it.
  - `voided`: the version is no longer actionable.

A quote has at most one version in `draft` or `approved` status at any time; all the other versions are `voided`.

<h2 id="tocS_QuoteVersionVoidReasonEnum">QuoteVersionVoidReasonEnum</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaquoteversionvoidreasonenum"></a>
<a id="schema_QuoteVersionVoidReasonEnum"></a>
<a id="tocSquoteversionvoidreasonenum"></a>
<a id="tocsquoteversionvoidreasonenum"></a>

```json
"manual"
```

The reason why the quote version was voided. It is `null` unless the `status` is `voided`. It can be any of the following values:
  - `manual`: voided explicitly, through the API or the Lago user interface.
  - `superseded`: voided because the version was cloned into a new draft.
  - `cascade_of_expired`: voided because the order form generated from the version expired.
  - `cascade_of_voided`: voided because the order form generated from the version was voided.

```json
  "version": 1,
  "status": "draft",
  "currency": "USD",
  "billing_entity_code": "acme_corp",
  "void_reason": "manual",
  "approved_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "voided_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "created_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-04-29T08:59:51Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the quote version, created by Lago.|
|lago_quote_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the quote the version belongs to, created by Lago.|
|lago_organization_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|version|integer|true|none|The number of the version within the quote. It starts at 1 and increases by 1 for every new version created by cloning.|
|status|[QuoteVersionStatusEnum](#schemaquoteversionstatusenum)|true|none|The status of the quote version. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `draft`: the version is still editable.<br>  - `approved`: the version has been approved and an order form has been generated from it.<br>  - `voided`: the version is no longer actionable.<br><br>A quote has at most one version in `draft` or `approved` status at any time; all the other versions are `voided`.<br>|
|currency|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|true|none|The currency the version is quoted in.|
|billing_entity_code|string \| null|true|none|Unique code identifying the billing entity that issues the deal. It is resolved rather than stored: the version's own entity when it names one, then the entity of the subscription being amended for a `subscription_amendment` quote, then the customer's own. It is `null` when none of them resolves. An amendment cannot name an entity itself, since the subscription it restates is already bound to one, and naming one on an amendment is rejected.|
|void_reason|[QuoteVersionVoidReasonEnum](#schemaquoteversionvoidreasonenum)|true|none|The reason why the quote version was voided. It is `null` unless the `status` is `voided`. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `manual`: voided explicitly, through the API or the Lago user interface.<br>  - `superseded`: voided because the version was cloned into a new draft.<br>  - `cascade_of_expired`: voided because the order form generated from the version expired.<br>  - `cascade_of_voided`: voided because the order form generated from the version was voided.<br>|
|approved_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the version was approved. It is `null` unless the `status` is `approved`.|
|voided_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the version was voided. It is `null` unless the `status` is `voided`.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the version was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the version was last updated.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the quote version, created by Lago.|
|lago_quote_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the quote the version belongs to, created by Lago.|
|lago_organization_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the organization, created by Lago.|
|version|integer|true|none|The number of the version within the quote. It starts at 1 and increases by 1 for every new version created by cloning.|
|status|[QuoteVersionStatusEnum](#schemaquoteversionstatusenum)|true|none|The status of the quote version. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `draft`: the version is still editable.<br>  - `approved`: the version has been approved and an order form has been generated from it.<br>  - `voided`: the version is no longer actionable.<br><br>A quote has at most one version in `draft` or `approved` status at any time; all the other versions are `voided`.<br>|
|currency|[CurrencyOrNull](#schemacurrencyornull)|true|none|The currency the version is quoted in.|
|billing_entity_code|string \| null|true|none|Unique code identifying the billing entity that issues the deal. It is resolved rather than stored: the version's own entity when it names one, then the entity of the subscription being amended for a `subscription_amendment` quote, then the customer's own. It is `null` when none of them resolves. An amendment cannot name an entity itself, since the subscription it restates is already bound to one, and naming one on an amendment is rejected.|
|void_reason|[QuoteVersionVoidReasonEnum](#schemaquoteversionvoidreasonenum)|true|none|The reason why the quote version was voided. It is `null` unless the `status` is `voided`. It can be any of the following values:<br>  - `manual`: voided explicitly, through the API or the Lago user interface.<br>  - `superseded`: voided because the version was cloned into a new draft.<br>  - `cascade_of_expired`: voided because the order form generated from the version expired.<br>  - `cascade_of_voided`: voided because the order form generated from the version was voided.<br>|
|approved_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the version was approved. It is `null` unless the `status` is `approved`.|
|voided_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the version was voided. It is `null` unless the `status` is `voided`.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the version was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the version was last updated.|
|content|string \| null|true|none|The HTML body of the quote document, as authored in the Lago user interface. It may reference the entries of `billing_items` through their `localId`.|
|billing_items|[QuoteBillingItems](#schemaquotebillingitems)|true|none|A snapshot of everything the quote bills. Unlike the rest of the Lago API, the keys nested in this object are camelCased: the object is stored and returned as it is authored in the Lago user interface.<br><br>Which top-level keys are present depends on the `order_type` of the parent quote:<br>  - `one_off`: `addOns`.<br>  - `subscription_creation` and `subscription_amendment`: `plans`, plus the optional `coupons` and `walletCredits`.<br><br>Every entry pins the catalog record it was built from through its `id` and its `payload`, so that an approved quote keeps billing what was approved even if the catalog changes afterwards. The optional `overrides` object carries the deviations from that record negotiated on the quote.<br><br>This object is the single source of truth for the term of the deal. Three of its nested dates bound that term, because the execution flow refuses them once past: `plans[].payload.endDate`, `walletCredits[].payload.expirationAt` and the `expirationAt` of a wallet credit's recurring top-up rule. The earliest of them is the day the deal stops being executable, and both the signing window and the execution date must fall strictly before it. A `one_off` quote carries none of them and is never bounded.<br><br>On a `draft` version this object may be incomplete: only the properties documented as required below are enforced on every save, the others are enforced when the version is approved.<br>|


Parameters available when approving a quote version.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|expires_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the order form generated by the approval expires. It must be in the future, and must fall strictly before the day the quoted deal stops being executable, otherwise the approval is rejected with a `422`. That boundary is the earliest of the `endDate` of any quoted plan and the `expirationAt` of any quoted wallet credit or recurring top-up rule. A `one_off` quote carries none of them, so its signing window is never bounded. When `expires_at` is omitted, the order form never expires.|

Based plan overrides.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount_cents|integer|false|none|The base cost of the plan, excluding any applicable taxes, that is billed on a recurring basis. This value is defined at 0 if your plan is a pay-as-you-go plan.|
|amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|false|none|The currency of the plan. It indicates the monetary unit in which the plan's cost, including taxes and usage-based charges, is expressed.|
|description|string|false|none|The description on the plan.|
|invoice_display_name|string|false|none|Specifies the name that will be displayed on an invoice. If no value is set for this field, the name of the plan will be used as the default display name.|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the plan.|
|tax_codes|[TaxCodes](#schemataxcodes)|false|none|List of unique code used to identify the taxes.|
|trial_period|number|false|none|The duration in days during which the base cost of the plan is offered for free.|
|minimum_commitment|[MinimumCommitmentInput](#schemaminimumcommitmentinput)|false|none|Minimum commitment for this plan.|
|charges|[object]|false|none|Additional usage-based charges for this plan.|
|fixed_charges|[object]|false|none|Fixed charge overrides for the subscription. When `plan_overrides` contains only `fixed_charges` and every entry contains only `id`, `units`, and optionally `apply_units_immediately`, the units are recorded as a per-subscription override without creating a plan override, and subscription-scoped reads return these units. If any entry carries other fields, or `plan_overrides` contains any other key, the request is applied as a full plan override for the subscription instead.|
|usage_thresholds|[[UsageThresholdInput](#schemausagethresholdinput)]|false|none|**Deprecated.** **Deprecated.** Managing usage thresholds through `plan_overrides` is deprecated and its behavior is inconsistent: an empty array does not reliably clear thresholds (it is ignored the first time a subscription is overridden), and it never affects thresholds inherited from a parent plan. Use the top-level `usage_thresholds` array on the subscription instead, or `progressive_billing_disabled` to switch progressive billing off.<br>|
|metadata|[MetadataInput](#schemametadatainput)|false|none|Metadata to set as key-value pairs. Keys are strings (max 100 characters), values can be strings (max 255 characters) or null.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the activation rule. Only `payment` is currently supported. A `payment` rule gates the subscription activation on a successful payment of the first invoice.|
|timeout_hours|integer|false|none|The number of hours the subscription stays in the `incomplete` state waiting for the payment to succeed before it is automatically canceled. Must be a positive integer or zero.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|payment|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|authorization|object|false|none|Optionally, you can create a pre-authorization on the customer's card before creating a subscription. This process places a temporary hold (capture) for a specified amount on the customer's account, but does not actually withdraw the funds.<br><br>Important notes:<br>  - The final amount due for the subscription is not known at the time of creation; it is determined only after the invoice is finalized.<br>  - The payment intent generated for pre-authorization cannot be reused, as the final invoice amount may exceed the authorized amount.<br>  - The payment intent is canceled immediately after creation, but this cancellation occurs asynchronously.<br>  - For these reasons, it is recommended to use a small amount (such as $1) for pre-authorization. While this does not guarantee sufficient funds for the final payment, it helps reduce the likelihood of payment errors.<br>|
|subscription|object|true|none|none|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|config|object|true|none|Extra configuration of the privilege. It is empty unless the value type is `select`.|
|value|integer \| boolean \| string|true|none|Applicable value for this subscription (override_value if set, plan_value otherwise). Type depends on the privilege's value_type.|
|plan_value|integer \| boolean \| string \| null|true|none|Value assigned to this privilege in the plan. Type depends on the privilege's value_type. Null when the privilege only exists as a subscription override.|
|override_value|integer \| boolean \| string \| null|true|none|Value assigned to this subscription specifically. Type depends on the privilege's value_type. Null if no override is set.|

|value_type|boolean|
|value_type|string|

|privileges|[[SubscriptionEntitlementPrivilegeObject](#schemasubscriptionentitlementprivilegeobject)]|true|none|Privileges associated with this feature. Each privilege shows the plan value and any subscription override.|
|overrides|object|true|none|Privilege values set on this subscription only. Each key is a privilege code and each value is the subscription override. Privileges that use the plan value are not listed.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the subscription's record within the Lago system|
|external_id|string|true|none|The subscription external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the customer's record within the Lago system|
|external_customer_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|billing_entity_code|string|false|none|The code of the billing entity associated with the subscription.|
|billing_time|string|true|none|The billing time for the subscription, which can be set as either `anniversary` or `calendar`. If not explicitly provided, it will default to `calendar`. The billing time determines the timing of recurring billing cycles for the subscription. By specifying `anniversary`, the billing cycle will be based on the specific date the subscription started (billed fully), while `calendar` sets the billing cycle at the first day of the week/month/year (billed with proration).|
|name|string \| null|true|none|The display name of the subscription on an invoice. This field allows for customization of the subscription's name for billing purposes, especially useful when a single customer has multiple subscriptions using the same plan.|
|plan_code|string|true|none|The unique code representing the plan to be attached to the customer. This code must correspond to the `code` property of one of the active plans.|
|plan_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The base cost of the related plan, excluding any applicable taxes, that is billed on a recurring basis.|
|plan_amount_currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The currency of the related plan. It indicates the monetary unit in which the plan's cost, including taxes and usage-based charges, is expressed.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the subscription, which can have the following values:<br>- `active`: the subscription is currently active and applied to the customer.<br>- `canceled`: the subscription has been stopped before its activation. This can occur when two consecutive downgrades have been applied to a customer, when a subscription with a pending status is terminated, or when a payment-gated subscription fails to be paid (or its activation rule expires) before activation. When caused by payment gating, the `cancellation_reason` field is set.<br>- `incomplete`: the subscription was created with a payment activation rule and is waiting for the gating payment to succeed before it becomes `active`. It is automatically `canceled` if the payment fails or the activation rule expires.<br>- `pending`: a previous subscription has been downgraded, and the current one is awaiting automatic activation at the end of the billing period.<br>- `terminated`: the subscription is no longer active.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The creation date of the subscription, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). This date provides a timestamp indicating when the subscription was initially created.|
|canceled_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The cancellation date of the subscription. This field is not null when the subscription is `canceled`. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|started_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The effective start date of the subscription. This field can be null if the subscription is `pending` or `canceled`. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|ending_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The effective end date of the subscription. If this field is set to null, the subscription will automatically renew. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format, and use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|subscription_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The anniversary date and time of the initial subscription. This date serves as the basis for billing subscriptions with `anniversary` billing time. The `anniversary_date` should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|terminated_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The termination date of the subscription. This field is not null when the subscription is `terminated`. This date should be provided in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)|
|previous_plan_code|string \| null|true|none|The code identifying the previous plan associated with this subscription.|
|next_plan_code|string \| null|true|none|The code identifying the next plan in the case of a downgrade.|
|downgrade_plan_date|string \| null(date)|true|none|The date when the plan will be downgraded, represented in ISO 8601 date format.|
|trial_ended_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the free trial is ended, represented in ISO 8601 date format.|
|current_billing_period_started_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the current billing period started, represented in ISO 8601 date format.|
|current_billing_period_ending_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the current billing period ends, represented in ISO 8601 date format.|
|on_termination_credit_note|string \| null|true|none|When a pay-in-advance subscription is terminated before the end of its billing period, we generate a credit note for the unused subscription time by default.<br>This field allows you to control the behavior of the credit note generation:<br><br>- `credit`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. The unused amount is credited back to the customer.<br>- `refund`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. If the invoice is paid or partially paid, the unused paid amount is refunded; any unpaid unused amount is credited back to the customer.<br>- `offset`: A credit note is generated for the unused subscription time. If the invoice is paid or partially paid, the unused paid amount is refunded; any unpaid unused amount is applied to the invoice reducing its amount due.<br>- `skip`: No credit note is generated for the unused subscription time.<br><br>_Note: This field is only applicable to pay-in-advance plans and will be `null` for pay-in-arrears plans._<br>|
|on_termination_invoice|string|true|none|When a subscription is terminated before the end of its billing period, we generate an invoice for the unbilled usage.<br>This field allows you to control the behavior of the invoice generation:<br><br>- `generate`: An invoice is generated for the unbilled usage.<br>- `skip`: No invoice is generated for the unbilled usage.<br>|
|applied_invoice_custom_sections|[[AppliedInvoiceCustomSectionObject](#schemaappliedinvoicecustomsectionobject)]|false|none|The invoice custom sections applied to invoices generated by this subscription. Only returned when creating, retrieving, updating or terminating a subscription, not when listing subscriptions and not in subscription webhooks.|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|true|none|The payment method assigned to this subscription for processing payments.|
|consolidate_invoice|boolean|true|none|Controls whether this subscription is eligible to be grouped with other subscriptions of the same customer on a consolidated recurring invoice.<br><br>- `true` (default): the subscription is included in the customer's standard invoice grouping (by billing entity, currency and payment method).<br>- `false`: the subscription is excluded from consolidation and always billed on its own dedicated invoice, regardless of other grouping criteria.<br>|
|progressive_billing_disabled|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether progressive billing is switched off for this subscription, regardless of any usage thresholds defined on the plan (including thresholds inherited from a parent plan when the subscription runs on a plan override).<br><br>When `true`, no progressive billing invoice is issued for this subscription.<br>|
|cancellation_reason|string \| null|true|none|The reason a payment-gated subscription was canceled while still `incomplete`. Null unless the subscription was canceled before activation.<br><br>- `payment_failed`: the gating payment failed.<br>- `timeout`: the activation rule expired before the payment succeeded.<br>- `manual`: the incomplete subscription was canceled on demand, via a terminate request with `status=incomplete`.<br>|
|activated_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when a payment-gated subscription was activated (i.e. moved from `incomplete` to `active` once the gating payment succeeded), represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). Null while the subscription is still `incomplete`.<br>|
|activation_rules|[[SubscriptionActivationRuleObject](#schemasubscriptionactivationruleobject)]|true|none|The activation rules attached to the subscription. A payment activation rule gates activation on a successful first payment, keeping the subscription in the `incomplete` state until the payment succeeds or the rule expires.<br>|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number associated with the subscription. It will be added to invoices generated for this subscription.|
|plan|[PlanObject](#schemaplanobject)|false|none|none|
|applicable_usage_thresholds|[[ApplicableUsageThreshold](#schemaapplicableusagethreshold)]|false|none|List of usage thresholds applicable to this subscription. Not returned when terminating a subscription.|
|entitlements|[[SubscriptionEntitlementObject](#schemasubscriptionentitlementobject)]|false|none|The feature entitlements of the subscription. Only returned when creating or retrieving a subscription.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the lifetime usage record within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the lifetime usage record within the Lago system|
|lago_subscription_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the subscription record within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the subscription record within the Lago system|
|external_subscription_id|string|true|none|The subscription external unique identifier (provided by your own application).|
|external_historical_usage_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The historical usage amount in cents for the subscription (provided by your own application).|
|invoiced_usage_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The total invoiced usage amount in cents for the subscription.|
|current_usage_amount_cents|integer|true|none|The current usage amount in cents for the subscription on the current billing period.|
|from_datetime|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The recording start date and time of the subscription lifetime usage. The date and time must be in ISO 8601 format.|
|to_datetime|string(date-time)|true|none|The recording end date and time of the subscription lifetime usage. The date and time must be in ISO 8601 format.|
|usage_thresholds|[[LifetimeUsageThresholdObject](#schemalifetimeusagethresholdobject)]|false|none|Array of usage thresholds that apply to the subscription. Thresholds attached to the subscription take precedence over the ones attached to its plan. This array is returned only when at least one threshold applies.|

|lago_wallet_id|null|true|none|Always null. An alert returned by the subscription endpoints is never attached to a wallet.|
|wallet_code|null|true|none|Always null. An alert returned by the subscription endpoints is never attached to a wallet.|
|billable_metric|[BillableMetricObject](#schemabillablemetricobject) \| null|true|none|The billable metric associated with the alert. Null unless the alert type is based on a billable metric.|
|alert_type|string|true|none|The type of alert.|
|code|string|true|none|Unique code used to identify the alert.|
|name|string \| null|true|none|The name of the alert.|
|direction|string|true|none|Indicates whether the alert is triggered when the monitored metric goes above or below the threshold. Lago sets it from the alert type and you cannot change it. A subscription alert is always `increasing`.|
|previous_value|string|true|none|When the system checked if this alert should be triggered, this value was retrieved and checked against the thresholds. Returned as a string formatted as a BigDecimal.|
|last_processed_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the system checked if this alert should be triggered. Null until it's processed for the first time.|
|thresholds|[[AlertThresholdObject](#schemaalertthresholdobject)]|true|none|Array of thresholds associated with the alert.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time in UTC (ISO 8601) when the alert was created.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|alert_type|current_usage_amount|
|alert_type|billable_metric_current_usage_amount|
|alert_type|billable_metric_current_usage_units|
|alert_type|lifetime_usage_amount|
|alert_type|billable_metric_lifetime_usage_units|
|direction|increasing|
|direction|decreasing|

```json
    "payment_method_type": "provider",
    "payment_method_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90"
  },
  "purchase_order_number": "PO-123"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the wallet transaction within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the wallet transaction's record within the Lago system.|
|lago_wallet_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the wallet within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the wallet's record within the Lago system.|
|billing_entity_code|string|true|none|The code of the billing entity associated with the wallet transaction. Falls back to the wallet's billing entity when the transaction does not carry one.|
|lago_invoice_id|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice associated with this wallet transaction. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the invoice's record within the Lago system.|
|lago_credit_note_id|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the credit note associated with this wallet transaction. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the invoice's record within the Lago system.|
|lago_voided_invoice_id|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier of the invoice that was voided and triggered the creation of this inbound wallet transaction. Only present for inbound transactions on traceable wallets that were created as a result of an invoice void.|
|status|string|true|none|The status of the wallet transaction. Possible values are `pending`, `settled` or `failed`.|
|source|string|true|none|The source field represents the origin or trigger of the wallet transaction. Possible values are `manual`, `interval`, `threshold`|
|transaction_status|string|true|none|The transaction status of the wallet transaction. Possible values are `purchased` (with pending or settled status), `granted` (without invoice_id), `voided` or `invoiced`.|
|transaction_type|string|true|none|The type of transaction. Possible values are `inbound` (increasing the balance) or `outbound` (decreasing the balance).|
|amount|string|true|none|The amount of credits based on the rate and the currency.|
|credit_amount|string|true|none|The number of credits used in the wallet transaction.|
|invoice_requires_successful_payment|boolean|true|none|A boolean setting that, when set to true, delays issuing an invoice for a wallet top-up until a successful payment is made; if false, the invoice is issued immediately upon wallet top-up, regardless of the payment status. Default value of false.|
|metadata|[object]|true|none|This field allows you to store a list of key-value pairs that hold additional information or custom attributes related to the data.|
|remaining_amount_cents|integer \| null|true|none|The remaining unconsumed amount of an inbound wallet transaction, expressed in cents. Only present for inbound transactions on traceable wallets. Tracks how much of the original credited amount has not yet been consumed by outbound transactions.|
|remaining_credit_amount|string \| null|true|none|The remaining unconsumed amount of an inbound wallet transaction, expressed in credits. Only present for inbound transactions on traceable wallets.|
|priority|integer|true|none|The priority of the wallet transaction, used to determine the order in which inbound transactions are consumed. Lower values are consumed first.|
|settled_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when wallet transaction is settled, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|failed_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The date when the wallet transaction failed, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the wallet transaction creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|
|name|string \| null|true|none|The name of the wallet transaction. It will appear on the invoice as the label for the fee. If not set, the label on the invoice will fallback to either `Prepaid credits - {{wallet_name}}` if the wallet name is set, or `Prepaid credits`.|
|applied_invoice_custom_sections|[[AppliedInvoiceCustomSectionObject](#schemaappliedinvoicecustomsectionobject)]|false|none|The invoice custom sections applied to invoices generated by this wallet transaction.|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethodReference](#schemapaymentmethodreference)|true|none|The payment method assigned to this wallet transaction for processing the payment.|
|purchase_order_number|string \| null|true|none|The purchase order number associated with this wallet transaction. It will be added to invoices generated for the resulting wallet top-up. If not set, falls back to the wallet's `purchase_order_number`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|pending|
|status|settled|
|status|failed|
|source|manual|
|source|interval|
|source|threshold|
|transaction_status|purchased|
|transaction_status|granted|
|transaction_status|voided|
|transaction_status|invoiced|
|transaction_type|inbound|
|transaction_type|outbound|

```json
  "lago_organization_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "webhook_url": "https://foo.bar",
  "signature_algo": "hmac",
  "name": "EC2-production",
  "event_types": [
    "invoice.voided",
    "customer.created"
  ],
  "created_at": "2022-04-29T08:59:51Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the webhook endpoint within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the webhook endpoint's record within the Lago system.|
|lago_organization_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the organization attached to the webhook endpoint within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the organization's record within the Lago system.|
|webhook_url|string|true|none|The URL of the webhook endpoint.|
|signature_algo|string|true|none|The algorithm used to sign the webhook payload.|
|name|string \| null|true|none|The name of the webhook endpoint.|
|event_types|[string]|true|none|The list of event types sent to this webhook endpoint. When the value is `null`, every event type is sent. When the value is an empty array, no event is sent.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date of the webhook endpoint creation, represented in ISO 8601 datetime format and expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|signature_algo|jwt|
|signature_algo|hmac|

<h2 id="tocS_AlertCrossedThresholdObject">AlertCrossedThresholdObject</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaalertcrossedthresholdobject"></a>

<a id="tocsalertcrossedthresholdobject"></a>

```json
{
  "code": "warn",
  "value": "99.0",
  "recurring": false
}
```

A threshold line of the alert, as it was recorded when the webhook was sent.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|string \| null|true|none|Code identifying the threshold inside the alert. Null when the threshold has no code.|
|value|string|true|none|The value of the threshold line, formatted as a BigDecimal.<br><br>The unit depends on the alert type: `billable_metric_current_usage_units` and `billable_metric_lifetime_usage_units` are expressed in units, `wallet_credits_balance` and `wallet_credits_ongoing_balance` in credits, and all other types in cents.|
|recurring|boolean|true|none|True when the line comes from the recurring threshold of the alert. A recurring threshold produces one line per step, so several lines can share the same code.|

<h2 id="tocS_CreditNotePaymentProviderRefundError">CreditNotePaymentProviderRefundError</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreditnotepaymentproviderrefunderror"></a>
<a id="schema_CreditNotePaymentProviderRefundError"></a>
<a id="tocScreditnotepaymentproviderrefunderror"></a>
<a id="tocscreditnotepaymentproviderrefunderror"></a>

```json
{
  "lago_credit_note_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "lago_customer_id": "1a901a90-1a90-1a90-1a90-1a901a901a90",
  "external_customer_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
  "provider_customer_id": "5eb02857-a71e-4ea2-bcf9-57d3a41bc6ba",
  "payment_provider": "stripe",
  "payment_provider_code": "Stripe Prod",
  "provider_error": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_credit_note_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the credit note within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the credit note record within the Lago system.|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the customer's record within the Lago system.|
|external_customer_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|provider_customer_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the customer within the payment provider|
|payment_provider|string|true|none|The type of payment provider code|
|payment_provider_code|string|false|none|Code of the payment provider|
|provider_error|string \| object|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|payment_provider|adyen|
|payment_provider|cashfree|
|payment_provider|gocardless|
|payment_provider|stripe|

```json
  }
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lago_invoice_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the invoice within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the invoice's record within the Lago system.|
|lago_customer_id|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier assigned to the customer within the Lago application. This ID is exclusively created by Lago and serves as a unique identifier for the customer's record within the Lago system.|
|external_customer_id|string|true|none|The customer external unique identifier (provided by your own application)|
|provider_customer_id|string \| null|true|none|Unique identifier of the customer within the payment provider. It is `null` when the payment failed before the payment provider was called.|
|payment_provider|string \| null|true|none|The payment provider of the customer. It is `null` when the customer has no payment provider.|
|payment_provider_code|string \| null|true|none|Code of the payment provider connection of the customer. It is `null` when the customer has no payment provider.|
|provider_error|null \| object|true|none|The error returned by the payment provider. It is `null` when the payment failed before the payment provider was called.|
|error_details|object \| null|true|none|Extra details about the failure. It carries `code` set to `customer_must_have_payment_provider` when a payment is retried for a customer without a payment provider, and the details of the provider exception when one was raised. It is `null` when the failure carries no extra details.|

|payment_provider|cashfree|
|payment_provider|gocardless|
|payment_provider|moneyhash|
|payment_provider|stripe|
|payment_provider|null|
